verses.textZh: 犹大王约雅敬在位第三年，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来到耶路撒冷，把城围困。
verses.textZhCnvs: 犹大王约雅敬在位第三年，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来到耶路撒冷，把城围困。
verses.textZhCuv: 犹大王约雅敬在位第三年，巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒来到耶路撒冷，将城围困。
verses.textEnNiv: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textEnEsv: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textEnNlt: During the third year of King Jehoiakim’s reign in Judah, King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textEnNasb: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.
verses.textEn: In the third year of the reign of Jehoiakim king of Judah, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to Jerusalem and besieged it.

verses.textZh: 主把犹大王约雅敬和神殿中的一部分器物交在尼布甲尼撒手里，他就把这些器物带到示拿地的神庙那里，存放在庙中的宝库里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主把犹大王约雅敬和神殿中的一部分器物交在尼布甲尼撒手里，他就把这些器物带到示拿地的神庙那里，存放在庙中的宝库里。
verses.textZhCuv: 主将犹大王约雅敬，并神殿中器皿的几分交付他手。他就把这器皿带到示拿地，收入他神的庙里，放在他神的库中。
verses.textEnNiv: And the Lord delivered Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, along with some of the articles from the temple of God. These he carried off to the temple of his god in Babylonia and put in the treasure house of his god.
verses.textEnEsv: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the vessels of the house of God. And he brought them to the land of Shinar, to the house of his god, and placed the vessels in the treasury of his god.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the Lord gave Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, with some of the articles of the house of God, which he carried into the land of Shinar to the house of his god; and he brought the articles into the treasure house of his god.
verses.textEnNlt: The Lord gave him victory over King Jehoiakim of Judah and permitted him to take some of the sacred objects from the Temple of God. So Nebuchadnezzar took them back to the land of Babylonia and placed them in the treasure-house of his god.
verses.textEnNasb: And the Lord handed Jehoiakim king of Judah over to him, along with some of the vessels of the house of God; and he brought them to the land of Shinar, to the house of his god, and he brought the vessels into the treasury of his god.
verses.textEn: And the Lord delivered Jehoiakim king of Judah into his hand, along with some of the articles from the temple of God. These he carried off to the temple of his god in Babylonia and put in the treasure house of his god.

verses.textZh: 王吩咐他的太监长亚施毘拿说："你要从以色列人中，把一些王室的后裔和贵族带进来；
verses.textZhCnvs: 王吩咐他的太监长亚施毘拿说："你要从以色列人中，把一些王室的后裔和贵族带进来；
verses.textZhCuv: 王吩咐太监长亚施毗拿，从以色列人的宗室和贵胄中带进几个人来，
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz, chief of his court officials, to bring into the king’s service some of the Israelites from the royal family and the nobility—
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king commanded Ashpenaz, his chief eunuch, to bring some of the people of Israel, both of the royal family and of the nobility,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king instructed Ashpenaz, the master of his eunuchs, to bring some of the children of Israel and some of the king’s descendants and some of the nobles,
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz, his chief of staff, to bring to the palace some of the young men of Judah’s royal family and other noble families, who had been brought to Babylon as captives.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king told Ashpenaz, the chief of his officials, to bring in some of the sons of Israel, including some of the royal family and of the nobles,
verses.textEn: Then the king ordered Ashpenaz, chief of his court officials, to bring into the king’s service some of the Israelites from the royal family and the nobility—

verses.textZh: 这些年轻人必须没有残疾、英俊、足智多才、有高度学习能力、明察事理，而且他们必须有能力可以在王宫里工作。你要教他们学习迦勒底的文学和语言。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这些年轻人必须没有残疾、英俊、足智多才、有高度学习能力、明察事理，而且他们必须有能力可以在王宫里工作。你要教他们学习迦勒底的文学和语言。"
verses.textZhCuv: 就是年少没有残疾、相貌俊美、通达各样学问、知识聪明俱备、足能侍立在王宫里的，要教他们迦勒底的文字言语。
verses.textEnNiv: young men without any physical defect, handsome, showing aptitude for every kind of learning, well informed, quick to understand, and qualified to serve in the king’s palace. He was to teach them the language and literature of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnEsv: youths without blemish, of good appearance and skillful in all wisdom, endowed with knowledge, understanding learning, and competent to stand in the king’s palace, and to teach them the literature and language of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNkjv: young men in whom therewas no blemish, but good-looking, gifted in all wisdom, possessing knowledge and quick to understand, who had ability to serve in the king’s palace, and whom they might teach the language and literature of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEnNlt: "Select only strong, healthy, and good-looking young men," he said. "Make sure they are well versed in every branch of learning, are gifted with knowledge and good judgment, and are suited to serve in the royal palace. Train these young men in the language and literature of Babylon. "
verses.textEnNasb: youths in whom there was no impairment, who were good-looking, suitable for instruction in every kind of expertise, endowed with understanding and discerning knowledge, and who had ability to serve in the king’s court; and he ordered Ashpenaz to teach them the literature and language of the Chaldeans.
verses.textEn: young men without any physical defect, handsome, showing aptitude for every kind of learning, well informed, quick to understand, and qualified to serve in the king’s palace. He was to teach them the language and literature of the Babylonians.

verses.textZh: 王指定每日给他们一份御用的佳肴美酒；又教养他们三年。期满以后，他们就侍立在王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王指定每日给他们一份御用的佳肴美酒；又教养他们三年。期满以后，他们就侍立在王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 王派定将自己所用的膳和所饮的酒，每日赐他们一分，养他们三年。满了三年，好叫他们在王面前侍立。
verses.textEnNiv: The king assigned them a daily amount of food and wine from the king’s table. They were to be trained for three years, and after that they were to enter the king’s service.
verses.textEnEsv: The king assigned them a daily portion of the food that the king ate, and of the wine that he drank. They were to be educated for three years, and at the end of that time they were to stand before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king appointed for them a daily provision of the king’s delicacies and of the wine which he drank, and three years of training for them, so that at the end of thattime they might serve before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: The king assigned them a daily ration of food and wine from his own kitchens. They were to be trained for three years, and then they would enter the royal service.
verses.textEnNasb: The king also allotted for them a daily ration from the king’s choice food and from the wine which he drank, and ordered that they be educated for three years, at the end of which they were to enter the king’s personal service.
verses.textEn: The king assigned them a daily amount of food and wine from the king’s table. They were to be trained for three years, and after that they were to enter the king’s service.

verses.textZh: 他们中间有犹大人但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们中间有犹大人但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们中间有犹大族的人：但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅。
verses.textEnNiv: Among those who were chosen were some from Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.
verses.textEnEsv: Among these were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah of the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now from among those of the sons of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
verses.textEnNlt: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah were four of the young men chosen, all from the tribe of Judah.
verses.textEnNasb: Now among them from the sons of Judah were Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
verses.textEn: Among those who were chosen were some from Judah: Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

verses.textZh: 太监长给他们起了新的名字，称但以理为伯提沙撒，哈拿尼雅为沙得拉，米沙利为米煞，亚撒利雅为亚伯尼歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 太监长给他们起了新的名字，称但以理为伯提沙撒，哈拿尼雅为沙得拉，米沙利为米煞，亚撒利雅为亚伯尼歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 太监长给他们起名：称但以理为伯提沙撒，称哈拿尼雅为沙得拉，称米沙利为米煞，称亚撒利雅为亚伯尼歌。
verses.textEnNiv: The chief official gave them new names: to Daniel, the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.
verses.textEnEsv: And the chief of the eunuchs gave them names: Daniel he called Belteshazzar, Hananiah he called Shadrach, Mishael he called Meshach, and Azariah he called Abednego.
verses.textEnNkjv: To them the chief of the eunuchs gave names: he gave Daniel thename Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abed-Nego.
verses.textEnNlt: The chief of staff renamed them with these Babylonian names: Daniel was called Belteshazzar. Hananiah was called Shadrach. Mishael was called Meshach. Azariah was called Abednego.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the commander of the officials assigned new names to them; and to Daniel he assigned the name Belteshazzar, to Hananiah Shadrach, to Mishael Meshach, and to Azariah Abed-nego.
verses.textEn: The chief official gave them new names: to Daniel, the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

verses.textZh: 但以理决心不让御用的佳肴美酒玷污自己，所以求太监长帮助他，使他不用玷污自己。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理决心不让御用的佳肴美酒玷污自己，所以求太监长帮助他，使他不用玷污自己。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理却立志不以王的膳和王所饮的酒玷污自己，所以求太监长容他不玷污自己。
verses.textEnNiv: But Daniel resolved not to defile himself with the royal food and wine, and he asked the chief official for permission not to defile himself this way.
verses.textEnEsv: But Daniel resolved that he would not defile himself with the king’s food, or with the wine that he drank. Therefore he asked the chief of the eunuchs to allow him not to defile himself.
verses.textEnNkjv: But Daniel purposed in his heart that he would not defile himself with the portion of the king’s delicacies, nor with the wine which he drank; therefore he requested of the chief of the eunuchs that he might not defile himself.
verses.textEnNlt: But Daniel was determined not to defile himself by eating the food and wine given to them by the king. He asked the chief of staff for permission not to eat these unacceptable foods.
verses.textEnNasb: But Daniel made up his mind that he would not defile himself with the king’s choice food or with the wine which he drank; so he sought permission from the commander of the officials that he might not defile himself.
verses.textEn: But Daniel resolved not to defile himself with the royal food and wine, and he asked the chief official for permission not to defile himself this way.

verses.textZh: 于是神使但以理在太监长面前得着恩惠和同情。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是神使但以理在太监长面前得着恩惠和同情。
verses.textZhCuv: 神使但以理在太监长眼前蒙恩惠，受怜悯。
verses.textEnNiv: Now God had caused the official to show favor and compassion to Daniel,
verses.textEnEsv: And God gave Daniel favor and compassion in the sight of the chief of the eunuchs,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now God had brought Daniel into the favor and goodwill of the chief of the eunuchs.
verses.textEnNlt: Now God had given the chief of staff both respect and affection for Daniel.
verses.textEnNasb: Now God granted Daniel favor and compassion in the sight of the commander of the officials.
verses.textEn: Now God had caused the official to show favor and compassion to Daniel,

verses.textZh: 只是太监长对但以理说："我惧怕我主我王，他已指定了你们应用的饮食；如果他见到你们的面色比你们同岁的年轻人憔悴难看，你们就使我的头在王面前保不住了。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 只是太监长对但以理说："我惧怕我主我王，他已指定了你们应用的饮食；如果他见到你们的面色比你们同岁的年轻人憔悴难看，你们就使我的头在王面前保不住了。"
verses.textZhCuv: 太监长对但以理说：「我惧怕我主我王，他已经派定你们的饮食，倘若他见你们的面貌比你们同岁的少年人肌瘦，怎么好呢？这样，你们就使我的头在王那里难保。」
verses.textEnNiv: but the official told Daniel, "I am afraid of my lord the king, who has assigned your food and drink. Why should he see you looking worse than the other young men your age? The king would then have my head because of you."
verses.textEnEsv: and the chief of the eunuchs said to Daniel, "I fear my lord the king, who assigned your food and your drink; for why should he see that you were in worse condition than the youths who are of your own age? So you would endanger my head with the king."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the chief of the eunuchs said to Daniel, "I fear my lord the king, who has appointed your food and drink. For why should he see your faces looking worse than the young men who are your age? Then you would endanger my head before the king."
verses.textEnNlt: But he responded, "I am afraid of my lord the king, who has ordered that you eat this food and wine. If you become pale and thin compared to the other youths your age, I am afraid the king will have me beheaded."
verses.textEnNasb: The commander of the officials said to Daniel, "I am afraid of my lord the king, who has allotted your food and your drink; for why should he see your faces looking gaunt in comparison to the youths who are your own age? Then you would make me forfeit my head to the king."
verses.textEn: but the official told Daniel, "I am afraid of my lord the king, who has assigned your food and drink. Why should he see you looking worse than the other young men your age? The king would then have my head because of you."

verses.textZh: 后来但以理对太监长分派看管但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅的人说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来但以理对太监长分派看管但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅的人说：
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理对太监长所派管理但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅的委办说：
verses.textEnNiv: Daniel then said to the guard whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Daniel said to the steward whom the chief of the eunuchs had assigned over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.textEnNkjv: So Daniel said to the steward whom the chief of the eunuchs had set over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.textEnNlt: Daniel spoke with the attendant who had been appointed by the chief of staff to look after Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah.
verses.textEnNasb: But Daniel said to the overseer whom the commander of the officials had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah,
verses.textEn: Daniel then said to the guard whom the chief official had appointed over Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah,

verses.textZh: "请你试试仆人十天，容我们只吃素菜、喝清水。
verses.textZhCnvs: "请你试试仆人十天，容我们只吃素菜、喝清水。
verses.textZhCuv: 「求你试试仆人们十天，给我们素菜吃，白水喝，
verses.textEnNiv: "Please test your servants for ten days: Give us nothing but vegetables to eat and water to drink.
verses.textEnEsv: "Test your servants for ten days; let us be given vegetables to eat and water to drink.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Please test your servants for ten days, and let them give us vegetables to eat and water to drink.
verses.textEnNlt: "Please test us for ten days on a diet of vegetables and water," Daniel said.
verses.textEnNasb: "Please put your servants to the test for ten days, and let us be given some vegetables to eat and water to drink.
verses.textEn: "Please test your servants for ten days: Give us nothing but vegetables to eat and water to drink.

verses.textZh: 然后，请你观察我们的容貌，和那些享用王的佳肴的年轻人的容貌，就照着你观察的结果，待你的仆人吧！"
verses.textZhCnvs: 然后，请你观察我们的容貌，和那些享用王的佳肴的年轻人的容貌，就照着你观察的结果，待你的仆人吧！"
verses.textZhCuv: 然后看看我们的面貌和用王膳那少年人的面貌，就照你所看的待仆人吧！」
verses.textEnNiv: Then compare our appearance with that of the young men who eat the royal food, and treat your servants in accordance with what you see."
verses.textEnEsv: Then let our appearance and the appearance of the youths who eat the king’s food be observed by you, and deal with your servants according to what you see."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then let our appearance be examined before you, and the appearance of the young men who eat the portion of the king’s delicacies; and as you see fit, so deal with your servants."
verses.textEnNlt: "At the end of the ten days, see how we look compared to the other young men who are eating the king’s food. Then make your decision in light of what you see."
verses.textEnNasb: Then let our appearance be examined in your presence and the appearance of the youths who are eating the king’s choice food; and deal with your servants according to what you see."
verses.textEn: Then compare our appearance with that of the young men who eat the royal food, and treat your servants in accordance with what you see."

verses.textZh: 看管他们的人就允准他们的这个要求，试试他们十天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看管他们的人就允准他们的这个要求，试试他们十天。
verses.textZhCuv: 委办便允准他们这件事，试看他们十天。
verses.textEnNiv: So he agreed to this and tested them for ten days.
verses.textEnEsv: So he listened to them in this matter, and tested them for ten days.
verses.textEnNkjv: So he consented with them in this matter, and tested them ten days.
verses.textEnNlt: The attendant agreed to Daniel’s suggestion and tested them for ten days.
verses.textEnNasb: So he listened to them in this matter, and put them to the test for ten days.
verses.textEn: So he agreed to this and tested them for ten days.

verses.textZh: 过了十天，见他们的容貌比所有享用王的佳肴的年轻人，更加俊美健壮。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了十天，见他们的容貌比所有享用王的佳肴的年轻人，更加俊美健壮。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了十天，见他们的面貌比用王膳的一切少年人更加俊美肥胖。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of the ten days they looked healthier and better nourished than any of the young men who ate the royal food.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of ten days it was seen that they were better in appearance and fatter in flesh than all the youths who ate the king’s food.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at the end of ten days their features appeared better and fatter in flesh than all the young men who ate the portion of the king’s delicacies.
verses.textEnNlt: At the end of the ten days, Daniel and his three friends looked healthier and better nourished than the young men who had been eating the food assigned by the king.
verses.textEnNasb: And at the end of ten days their appearance seemed better, and they were fatter than all the youths who had been eating the king’s choice food.
verses.textEn: At the end of the ten days they looked healthier and better nourished than any of the young men who ate the royal food.

verses.textZh: 看管他们的人就撤去指定给他们享用的佳肴美酒，让他们吃素菜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 看管他们的人就撤去指定给他们享用的佳肴美酒，让他们吃素菜。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是委办撤去派他们用的膳，饮的酒，给他们素菜吃。
verses.textEnNiv: So the guard took away their choice food and the wine they were to drink and gave them vegetables instead.
verses.textEnEsv: So the steward took away their food and the wine they were to drink, and gave them vegetables.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus the steward took away their portion of delicacies and the wine that they were to drink, and gave them vegetables.
verses.textEnNlt: So after that, the attendant fed them only vegetables instead of the food and wine provided for the others.
verses.textEnNasb: So the overseer continued to withhold their choice food and the wine they were to drink, and kept giving them vegetables.
verses.textEn: So the guard took away their choice food and the wine they were to drink and gave them vegetables instead.

verses.textZh: 这四个年轻人在各种文字和学问上，神都赐他们知识和聪明；但以理并且能明白一切异象和异梦。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这四个年轻人在各种文字和学问上，神都赐他们知识和聪明；但以理并且能明白一切异象和异梦。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四个少年人，神在各样文字学问 上赐给他们聪明知识；但以理又明白各样的异象和梦兆。
verses.textEnNiv: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding of all kinds of literature and learning. And Daniel could understand visions and dreams of all kinds.
verses.textEnEsv: As for these four youths, God gave them learning and skill in all literature and wisdom, and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for these four young men, God gave them knowledge and skill in all literature and wisdom; and Daniel had understanding in all visions and dreams.
verses.textEnNlt: God gave these four young men an unusual aptitude for understanding every aspect of literature and wisdom. And God gave Daniel the special ability to interpret the meanings of visions and dreams.
verses.textEnNasb: And as for these four youths, God gave them knowledge and intelligence in every kind of literature and expertise; Daniel even understood all kinds of visions and dreams.
verses.textEn: To these four young men God gave knowledge and understanding of all kinds of literature and learning. And Daniel could understand visions and dreams of all kinds.

verses.textZh: 到了王吩咐带所有年轻人进宫的日子，太监长就领他们到尼布甲尼撒王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 到了王吩咐带所有年轻人进宫的日子，太监长就领他们到尼布甲尼撒王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒王预定带进少年人来的日期满了，太监长就把他们带到王面前。
verses.textEnNiv: At the end of the time set by the king to bring them into his service, the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnEsv: At the end of the time, when the king had commanded that they should be brought in, the chief of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now at the end of the days, when the king had said that they should be brought in, the chief of the eunuchs brought them in before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNlt: When the training period ordered by the king was completed, the chief of staff brought all the young men to King Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEnNasb: Then at the end of the days which the king had specified for presenting them, the commander of the officials presented them before Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.textEn: At the end of the time set by the king to bring them into his service, the chief official presented them to Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.textZh: 王和他们谈话，发现他们所有的人中，没有一个比得上但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅的；他们四人就侍立在王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王和他们谈话，发现他们所有的人中，没有一个比得上但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅的；他们四人就侍立在王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 王与他们谈论，见少年人中无一人能比但以理、哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅，所以留他们在王面前侍立。
verses.textEnNiv: The king talked with them, and he found none equal to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah; so they entered the king’s service.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king spoke with them, and among all of them none was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. Therefore they stood before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king interviewed them, and among them all none was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; therefore they served before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: The king talked with them, and no one impressed him as much as Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah. So they entered the royal service.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king talked with them, and out of them all not one was found like Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah; so they entered the king’s personal service.
verses.textEn: The king talked with them, and he found none equal to Daniel, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah; so they entered the king’s service.

verses.textZh: 王考问他们一切智慧和聪明的事，就发现他们比全国所有的术士和用法术的更胜十倍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王考问他们一切智慧和聪明的事，就发现他们比全国所有的术士和用法术的更胜十倍。
verses.textZhCuv: 王考问他们一切事，就见他们的智慧聪明比通国的术士和用法术的胜过十倍。
verses.textEnNiv: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his whole kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: And in every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king inquired of them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters that were in all his kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in all matters of wisdom and understanding about which the king examined them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and astrologers who were in all his realm.
verses.textEnNlt: Whenever the king consulted them in any matter requiring wisdom and balanced judgment, he found them ten times more capable than any of the magicians and enchanters in his entire kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: As for every matter of expertise and understanding about which the king consulted them, he found them ten times better than all the soothsayer priests and conjurers who were in all his realm.
verses.textEn: In every matter of wisdom and understanding about which the king questioned them, he found them ten times better than all the magicians and enchanters in his whole kingdom.

verses.textZh: 直到古列王元年，但以理还在。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到古列王元年，但以理还在。
verses.textZhCuv: 到塞鲁士王元年，但以理还在。
verses.textEnNiv: And Daniel remained there until the first year of King Cyrus.
verses.textEnEsv: And Daniel was there until the first year of King Cyrus.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus Daniel continued until the first year of King Cyrus.
verses.textEnNlt: Daniel remained in the royal service until the first year of the reign of King Cyrus.
verses.textEnNasb: And Daniel continued until the first year of Cyrus the king.
verses.textEn: And Daniel remained there until the first year of King Cyrus.

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他作了梦，因此心里烦乱，不能入睡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他作了梦，因此心里烦乱，不能入睡。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒在位第二年，他做了梦，心里烦乱，不能睡觉。
verses.textEnNiv: In the second year of his reign, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; his mind was troubled and he could not sleep.
verses.textEnEsv: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; his spirit was troubled, and his sleep left him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now in the second year of Nebuchadnezzar’s reign, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; and his spirit was so troubled that his sleep left him.
verses.textEnNlt: One night during the second year of his reign, Nebuchadnezzar had such disturbing dreams that he couldn’t sleep.
verses.textEnNasb: Now in the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; and his spirit was troubled and his sleep left him.
verses.textEn: In the second year of his reign, Nebuchadnezzar had dreams; his mind was troubled and he could not sleep.

verses.textZh: 于是王吩咐人把术士、用法术的、行邪术的和迦勒底人都召来，要他们把王的梦告诉王。他们来了，站在王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王吩咐人把术士、用法术的、行邪术的和迦勒底人都召来，要他们把王的梦告诉王。他们来了，站在王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 王吩咐人将术士、用法术的、行邪术的，和迦勒底人召来，要他们将王的梦告诉王，他们就来站在王前。
verses.textEnNiv: So the king summoned the magicians, enchanters, sorcerers and astrologers to tell him what he had dreamed. When they came in and stood before the king,
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be summoned to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king gave the command to call the magicians, the astrologers, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans to tell the king his dreams. So they came and stood before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: He called in his magicians, enchanters, sorcerers, and astrologers, and he demanded that they tell him what he had dreamed. As they stood before the king,
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king gave orders to call in the soothsayer priests, the conjurers, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans, to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.
verses.textEn: So the king summoned the magicians, enchanters, sorcerers and astrologers to tell him what he had dreamed. When they came in and stood before the king,

verses.textZh: 王对他们说："我作了一个梦，心里烦乱，我要知道这是甚么梦。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对他们说："我作了一个梦，心里烦乱，我要知道这是甚么梦。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对他们说：「我做了一梦，心里烦乱，要知道这是什么梦。」
verses.textEnNiv: he said to them, "I have had a dream that troubles me and I want to know what it means. "
verses.textEnEsv: And the king said to them, "I had a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream."
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king said to them, "I have had a dream, and my spirit is anxious to know the dream."
verses.textEnNlt: he said, "I have had a dream that deeply troubles me, and I must know what it means."
verses.textEnNasb: The king said to them, "I had a dream, and my spirit is anxious to understand the dream."
verses.textEn: he said to them, "I have had a dream that troubles me and I want to know what it means. "

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人用亚兰话对王说："愿王万岁！请把那梦告诉仆人，我们好解释梦的意思。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人用亚兰话对王说："愿王万岁！请把那梦告诉仆人，我们好解释梦的意思。"
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人用亚兰的言语对王说：「愿王万岁！请将那梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then the astrologers answered the king, "May the king live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will interpret it."
verses.textEnEsv: Then the Chaldeans said to the king in Aramaic, "O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic, "O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will give the interpretation."
verses.textEnNlt: Then the astrologers answered the king in Aramaic, "Long live the king! Tell us the dream, and we will tell you what it means."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in Aramaic: "O king, live forever! Tell the dream to your servants, and we will declare the interpretation."
verses.textEn: Then the astrologers answered the king, "May the king live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will interpret it."

verses.textZh: 王回答迦勒底人说："我已经定旨：如果你们不把那梦和梦的意思向我说明，就必被碎尸万段，你们的家必成为废墟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王回答迦勒底人说："我已经定旨：如果你们不把那梦和梦的意思向我说明，就必被碎尸万段，你们的家必成为废墟。
verses.textZhCuv: 王回答迦勒底人说：「梦我已经忘了 ，你们若不将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必被凌迟，你们的房屋必成为粪堆；
verses.textEnNiv: The king replied to the astrologers, "This is what I have firmly decided: If you do not tell me what my dream was and interpret it, I will have you cut into pieces and your houses turned into piles of rubble.
verses.textEnEsv: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, "The word from me is firm: if you do not make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you shall be torn limb from limb, and your houses shall be laid in ruins.
verses.textEnNkjv: The king answered and said to the Chaldeans, "My decision is firm: if you do not make known the dream to me, and its interpretation, you shall be cut in pieces, and your houses shall be made an ash heap.
verses.textEnNlt: But the king said to the astrologers, "I am serious about this. If you don’t tell me what my dream was and what it means, you will be torn limb from limb, and your houses will be turned into heaps of rubble!
verses.textEnNasb: The king replied to the Chaldeans, "The command from me is firm: if you do not make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be torn limb from limb and your houses will be turned into a rubbish heap.
verses.textEn: The king replied to the astrologers, "This is what I have firmly decided: If you do not tell me what my dream was and interpret it, I will have you cut into pieces and your houses turned into piles of rubble.

verses.textZh: 如果你们能把那梦和梦的意思向我解释，就必从我这里得礼物、奖赏和大尊荣，所以你们要把梦和梦的意思向我解释。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们能把那梦和梦的意思向我解释，就必从我这里得礼物、奖赏和大尊荣，所以你们要把梦和梦的意思向我解释。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若将梦和梦的讲解告诉我，就必从我这里得赠品和赏赐，并大尊荣。现在你们要将梦和梦的讲解告诉我。」
verses.textEnNiv: But if you tell me the dream and explain it, you will receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. So tell me the dream and interpret it for me."
verses.textEnEsv: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you shall receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation."
verses.textEnNkjv: However, if you tell the dream and its interpretation, you shall receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore tell me the dream and its interpretation."
verses.textEnNlt: But if you tell me what I dreamed and what the dream means, I will give you many wonderful gifts and honors. Just tell me the dream and what it means!"
verses.textEnNasb: But if you declare the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts and a reward and great honor; therefore declare to me the dream and its interpretation."
verses.textEn: But if you tell me the dream and explain it, you will receive from me gifts and rewards and great honor. So tell me the dream and interpret it for me."

verses.textZh: 他们第二次回答王说："请王把梦告诉仆人，我们好解释梦的意思。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们第二次回答王说："请王把梦告诉仆人，我们好解释梦的意思。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他们第二次对王说：「请王将梦告诉仆人，仆人就可以讲解。」
verses.textEnNiv: Once more they replied, "Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will interpret it."
verses.textEnEsv: They answered a second time and said, "Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show its interpretation."
verses.textEnNkjv: They answered again and said, "Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will give its interpretation."
verses.textEnNlt: They said again, "Please, Your Majesty. Tell us the dream, and we will tell you what it means."
verses.textEnNasb: They answered a second time and said, "Let the king tell the dream to his servants, and we will declare the interpretation."
verses.textEn: Once more they replied, "Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will interpret it."

verses.textZh: 王回答说："我清楚知道你们企图拖延时间，因为你们看出我已经定旨。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王回答说："我清楚知道你们企图拖延时间，因为你们看出我已经定旨。
verses.textZhCuv: 王回答说：「我准知道你们是故意迟延，因为你们知道那梦我已经忘了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king answered, "I am certain that you are trying to gain time, because you realize that this is what I have firmly decided:
verses.textEnEsv: The king answered and said, "I know with certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see that the word from me is firm—
verses.textEnNkjv: The king answered and said, "I know for certain that you would gain time, because you see that my decision is firm:
verses.textEnNlt: The king replied, "I know what you are doing! You’re stalling for time because you know I am serious when I say,
verses.textEnNasb: The king replied, "I know for certain that you are trying to buy time, because you have perceived that the command from me is firm,
verses.textEn: Then the king answered, "I am certain that you are trying to gain time, because you realize that this is what I have firmly decided:

verses.textZh: 如果你们不把那梦向我说明，只有一个办法对付你们。你们串通在我面前胡言乱语，希望时势有所改变。你们现在要把梦告诉我，好使我知道你们真能把梦的意思向我解释。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果你们不把那梦向我说明，只有一个办法对付你们。你们串通在我面前胡言乱语，希望时势有所改变。你们现在要把梦告诉我，好使我知道你们真能把梦的意思向我解释。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们若不将梦告诉我，只有一法待你们；因为你们预备了谎言乱语向我说，要等候时势改变。现在你们要将梦告诉我，因我知道你们能将梦的讲解告诉我。」
verses.textEnNiv: If you do not tell me the dream, there is only one penalty for you. You have conspired to tell me misleading and wicked things, hoping the situation will change. So then, tell me the dream, and I will know that you can interpret it for me."
verses.textEnEsv: if you do not make the dream known to me, there is but one sentence for you. You have agreed to speak lying and corrupt words before me till the times change. Therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can show me its interpretation."
verses.textEnNkjv: if you do not make known the dream to me, thereisonly one decree for you! For you have agreed to speak lying and corrupt words before me till the time has changed. Therefore tell me the dream, and I shall know that you can give me its interpretation."
verses.textEnNlt: ‘If you don’t tell me the dream, you are doomed.’ So you have conspired to tell me lies, hoping I will change my mind. But tell me the dream, and then I’ll know that you can tell me what it means."
verses.textEnNasb: that if you do not make the dream known to me, there is only one decree for you. For you have agreed together to speak lying and corrupt words before me until the situation is changed; therefore tell me the dream, so that I may know that you can declare to me its interpretation."
verses.textEn: If you do not tell me the dream, there is only one penalty for you. You have conspired to tell me misleading and wicked things, hoping the situation will change. So then, tell me the dream, and I will know that you can interpret it for me."

verses.textZh: 迦勒底人在王面前回答说："世上没有人能把王所问的事说出来，因为从来没有一个伟大和有权势的君王向术士、用法术的和迦勒底人询问过这样的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 迦勒底人在王面前回答说："世上没有人能把王所问的事说出来，因为从来没有一个伟大和有权势的君王向术士、用法术的和迦勒底人询问过这样的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 迦勒底人在王面前回答说：「世上没有人能将王所问的事说出来；因为没有君王、大臣、掌权的向术士，或用法术的，或迦勒底人问过这样的事。
verses.textEnNiv: The astrologers answered the king, "There is no one on earth who can do what the king asks! No king, however great and mighty, has ever asked such a thing of any magician or enchanter or astrologer.
verses.textEnEsv: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, "There is not a man on earth who can meet the king’s demand, for no great and powerful king has asked such a thing of any magician or enchanter or Chaldean.
verses.textEnNkjv: The Chaldeans answered the king, and said, "There is not a man on earth who can tell the king’s matter; therefore no king, lord, or ruler has ever asked such things of any magician, astrologer, or Chaldean.
verses.textEnNlt: The astrologers replied to the king, "No one on earth can tell the king his dream! And no king, however great and powerful, has ever asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or astrologer!
verses.textEnNasb: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, "There is no person on earth who could declare the matter to the king, because no great king or ruler has ever asked anything like this of any soothsayer priest, sorcerer, or Chaldean.
verses.textEn: The astrologers answered the king, "There is no one on earth who can do what the king asks! No king, however great and mighty, has ever asked such a thing of any magician or enchanter or astrologer.

verses.textZh: 王所问的事很难答，除了那不和世人同住的神明以外，没有人能在王面前把这事说出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王所问的事很难答，除了那不和世人同住的神明以外，没有人能在王面前把这事说出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王所问的事甚难。除了不与世人同居的神明，没有人在王面前能说出来。」
verses.textEnNiv: What the king asks is too difficult. No one can reveal it to the king except the gods, and they do not live among humans."
verses.textEnEsv: The thing that the king asks is difficult, and no one can show it to the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh."
verses.textEnNkjv: Itis a difficult thing that the king requests, and there is no other who can tell it to the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh."
verses.textEnNlt: The king’s demand is impossible. No one except the gods can tell you your dream, and they do not live here among people."
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, the thing which the king demands is difficult, and there is no one else who could declare it to the king except gods, whose dwelling place is not with mortal flesh."
verses.textEn: What the king asks is too difficult. No one can reveal it to the king except the gods, and they do not live among humans."

verses.textZh: 因此，王大发烈怒，下令杀绝巴比伦所有的智慧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，王大发烈怒，下令杀绝巴比伦所有的智慧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此，王气忿忿地大发烈怒，吩咐灭绝巴比伦所有的哲士。
verses.textEnNiv: This made the king so angry and furious that he ordered the execution of all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Because of this the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: For this reason the king was angry and very furious, and gave the command to destroy all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: The king was furious when he heard this, and he ordered that all the wise men of Babylon be executed.
verses.textEnNasb: Because of this, the king became angry and extremely furious, and he gave orders to kill all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEn: This made the king so angry and furious that he ordered the execution of all the wise men of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 于是王的御旨发出，要把智慧人都杀死；人就寻找但以理和他的同伴，要杀死他们。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王的御旨发出，要把智慧人都杀死；人就寻找但以理和他的同伴，要杀死他们。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是命令发出，哲士将要见杀，人就寻找但以理和他的同伴，要杀他们。
verses.textEnNiv: So the decree was issued to put the wise men to death, and men were sent to look for Daniel and his friends to put them to death.
verses.textEnEsv: So the decree went out, and the wise men were about to be killed; and they sought Daniel and his companions, to kill them.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the decree went out, and they began killing the wise men; and they sought Daniel and his companions, to kill them.
verses.textEnNlt: And because of the king’s decree, men were sent to find and kill Daniel and his friends.
verses.textEnNasb: So the decree was issued that the wise men be killed; and they looked for Daniel and his friends, to kill them.
verses.textEn: So the decree was issued to put the wise men to death, and men were sent to look for Daniel and his friends to put them to death.

verses.textZh: 那时，王的护卫长亚略出来，要杀死巴比伦的智慧人，但以理就婉转机敏地向他询问；
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，王的护卫长亚略出来，要杀死巴比伦的智慧人，但以理就婉转机敏地向他询问；
verses.textZhCuv: 王的护卫长亚略出来，要杀巴比伦的哲士，但以理就用婉言回答他，
verses.textEnNiv: When Arioch, the commander of the king’s guard, had gone out to put to death the wise men of Babylon, Daniel spoke to him with wisdom and tact.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Daniel replied with prudence and discretion to Arioch, the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then with counsel and wisdom Daniel answered Arioch, the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon;
verses.textEnNlt: When Arioch, the commander of the king’s guard, came to kill them, Daniel handled the situation with wisdom and discretion.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Daniel replied with discretion and discernment to Arioch, the captain of the king’s bodyguard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon;
verses.textEn: When Arioch, the commander of the king’s guard, had gone out to put to death the wise men of Babylon, Daniel spoke to him with wisdom and tact.

verses.textZh: 但以理对王的护卫长亚略说："王的命令为甚么这样严厉呢？"亚略就把这事告诉但以理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理对王的护卫长亚略说："王的命令为甚么这样严厉呢？"亚略就把这事告诉但以理。
verses.textZhCuv: 向王的护卫长亚略说：「王的命令为何这样紧急呢？」亚略就将情节告诉但以理。
verses.textEnNiv: He asked the king’s officer, "Why did the king issue such a harsh decree?" Arioch then explained the matter to Daniel.
verses.textEnEsv: He declared to Arioch, the king’s captain, "Why is the decree of the king so urgent?" Then Arioch made the matter known to Daniel.
verses.textEnNkjv: he answered and said to Arioch the king’s captain, "Why is the decree from the king so urgent?" Then Arioch made the decision known to Daniel.
verses.textEnNlt: He asked Arioch, "Why has the king issued such a harsh decree?" So Arioch told him all that had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: he said to Arioch, the king’s officer, "For what reason is the decree from the king so harsh?" Then Arioch informed Daniel of the matter.
verses.textEn: He asked the king’s officer, "Why did the king issue such a harsh decree?" Arioch then explained the matter to Daniel.

verses.textZh: 但以理就进去，求王宽限，使他可以把那梦的意思为王解释。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理就进去，求王宽限，使他可以把那梦的意思为王解释。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理遂进去求王宽限，就可以将梦的讲解告诉王。
verses.textEnNiv: At this, Daniel went in to the king and asked for time, so that he might interpret the dream for him.
verses.textEnEsv: And Daniel went in and requested the king to appoint him a time, that he might show the interpretation to the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: So Daniel went in and asked the king to give him time, that he might tell the king the interpretation.
verses.textEnNlt: Daniel went at once to see the king and requested more time to tell the king what the dream meant.
verses.textEnNasb: So Daniel went in and requested of the king that he would give him a grace period, so that he might declare the interpretation to the king.
verses.textEn: At this, Daniel went in to the king and asked for time, so that he might interpret the dream for him.

verses.textZh: 但以理回到自己的家里，把这事告诉他的同伴哈拿尼雅、米沙利和亚撒利雅，
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理回到自己的家里，把这事告诉他的同伴哈拿尼雅、米沙利和亚撒利雅，
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理回到他的居所，将这事告诉他的同伴哈拿尼雅、米沙利、亚撒利雅，
verses.textEnNiv: Then Daniel returned to his house and explained the matter to his friends Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.
verses.textEnEsv: Then Daniel went to his house and made the matter known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Daniel went to his house, and made the decision known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions,
verses.textEnNlt: Then Daniel went home and told his friends Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah what had happened.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Daniel went to his house and informed his friends, Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah, about the matter,
verses.textEn: Then Daniel returned to his house and explained the matter to his friends Hananiah, Mishael and Azariah.

verses.textZh: 要他们为这隐秘的事祈求天上的神怜悯，免得但以理和他的同伴与巴比伦其余的智慧人一同灭亡。
verses.textZhCnvs: 要他们为这隐秘的事祈求天上的神怜悯，免得但以理和他的同伴与巴比伦其余的智慧人一同灭亡。
verses.textZhCuv: 要他们祈求天上的神施怜悯，将这奥秘的事指明，免得但以理和他的同伴与巴比伦其余的哲士一同灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: He urged them to plead for mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that he and his friends might not be executed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: and told them to seek mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that Daniel and his companions might not be destroyed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: that they might seek mercies from the God of heaven concerning this secret, so that Daniel and his companions might not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: He urged them to ask the God of heaven to show them his mercy by telling them the secret, so they would not be executed along with the other wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: so that they might request compassion from the God of heaven concerning this secret, so that Daniel and his friends would not be killed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEn: He urged them to plead for mercy from the God of heaven concerning this mystery, so that he and his friends might not be executed with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 于是这隐秘的事在夜间的异象中给但以理显明了。但以理就称颂天上的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是这隐秘的事在夜间的异象中给但以理显明了。但以理就称颂天上的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 这奥秘的事就在夜间异象中给但以理显明，但以理便称颂天上的神。
verses.textEnNiv: During the night the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision. Then Daniel praised the God of heaven
verses.textEnEsv: Then the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. So Daniel blessed the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: That night the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision. Then Daniel praised the God of heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a night vision. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven;
verses.textEn: During the night the mystery was revealed to Daniel in a vision. Then Daniel praised the God of heaven

verses.textZh: 但以理说： "愿神的名得称颂，从永远直到永远， 因为智慧和能力都是属他的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理说： "愿神的名得称颂，从永远直到永远， 因为智慧和能力都是属他的。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理说：「神的名是应当称颂的！从亘古直到永远，因为智慧能力都属乎他。
verses.textEnNiv: and said: "Praise be to the name of God for ever and ever; wisdom and power are his.
verses.textEnEsv: Daniel answered and said: "Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, to whom belong wisdom and might.
verses.textEnNkjv: Daniel answered and said: "Blessed be the name of God forever and ever, For wisdom and might are His.
verses.textEnNlt: He said, "Praise the name of God forever and ever, for he has all wisdom and power.
verses.textEnNasb: Daniel said, "May the name of God be blessed forever and ever, For wisdom and power belong to Him.
verses.textEn: and said: "Praise be to the name of God for ever and ever; wisdom and power are his.

verses.textZh: 他改变时间、季节； 他废王、立王； 他赐智慧给智慧人， 赐知识给聪明人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他改变时间、季节； 他废王、立王； 他赐智慧给智慧人， 赐知识给聪明人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他改变时候、日期，废王，立王，将智慧赐与智慧人，将知识赐与聪明人。
verses.textEnNiv: He changes times and seasons; he deposes kings and raises up others. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.
verses.textEnEsv: He changes times and seasons; he removes kings and sets up kings; he gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who have understanding;
verses.textEnNkjv: And He changes the times and the seasons; He removes kings and raises up kings; He gives wisdom to the wise And knowledge to those who have understanding.
verses.textEnNlt: He controls the course of world events; he removes kings and sets up other kings. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the scholars.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is He who changes the times and the periods; He removes kings and appoints kings; He gives wisdom to wise men, And knowledge to people of understanding.
verses.textEn: He changes times and seasons; he deposes kings and raises up others. He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to the discerning.

verses.textZh: 他显明深奥和隐密的事， 他洞悉暗中的一切， 因为光明与他同住。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他显明深奥和隐密的事， 他洞悉暗中的一切， 因为光明与他同住。
verses.textZhCuv: 他显明深奥隐秘的事，知道暗中所有的，光明也与他同居。
verses.textEnNiv: He reveals deep and hidden things; he knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with him.
verses.textEnEsv: he reveals deep and hidden things; he knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.
verses.textEnNkjv: He reveals deep and secret things; He knows what is in the darkness, And light dwells with Him.
verses.textEnNlt: He reveals deep and mysterious things and knows what lies hidden in darkness, though he is surrounded by light.
verses.textEnNasb: "It is He who reveals the profound and hidden things; He knows what is in the darkness, And the light dwells with Him.
verses.textEn: He reveals deep and hidden things; he knows what lies in darkness, and light dwells with him.

verses.textZh: 我列祖的神啊！我感谢你，赞美你！ 你把智慧和能力赐了给我； 我们向你所求的，现在你已向我显明， 把王的事告诉了我们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我列祖的神啊！我感谢你，赞美你！ 你把智慧和能力赐了给我； 我们向你所求的，现在你已向我显明， 把王的事告诉了我们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我列祖的神啊，我感谢你，赞美你；因你将智慧才能赐给我，允准我们所求的，把王的事给我们指明。」
verses.textEnNiv: I thank and praise you, God of my ancestors: You have given me wisdom and power, you have made known to me what we asked of you, you have made known to us the dream of the king."
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O God of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, for you have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we asked of you, for you have made known to us the king’s matter."
verses.textEnNkjv: "I thank You and praise You, O God of my fathers; You have given me wisdom and might, And have now made known to me what we asked of You, For You have made known to us the king’s demand."
verses.textEnNlt: I thank and praise you, God of my ancestors, for you have given me wisdom and strength. You have told me what we asked of you and revealed to us what the king demanded."
verses.textEnNasb: "To You, God of my fathers, I give thanks and praise, For You have given me wisdom and power; Even now You have made known to me what we requested of You, For You have made known to us the king’s matter."
verses.textEn: I thank and praise you, God of my ancestors: You have given me wisdom and power, you have made known to me what we asked of you, you have made known to us the dream of the king."

verses.textZh: 于是但以理进去见亚略，就是王委派去杀绝巴比伦的智慧人的，对他这样说："不要杀绝巴比伦的智慧人；请把我带到王面前，我要把梦的意思向王解释。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是但以理进去见亚略，就是王委派去杀绝巴比伦的智慧人的，对他这样说："不要杀绝巴比伦的智慧人；请把我带到王面前，我要把梦的意思向王解释。"
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，但以理进去见亚略，就是王所派灭绝巴比伦哲士的，对他说：「不要灭绝巴比伦的哲士，求你领我到王面前，我要将梦的讲解告诉王。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to execute the wise men of Babylon, and said to him, "Do not execute the wise men of Babylon. Take me to the king, and I will interpret his dream for him."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said thus to him: "Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon; bring me in before the king, and I will show the king the interpretation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said thus to him: "Do not destroy the wise men of Babylon; take me before the king, and I will tell the king the interpretation."
verses.textEnNlt: Then Daniel went in to see Arioch, whom the king had ordered to execute the wise men of Babylon. Daniel said to him, "Don’t kill the wise men. Take me to the king, and I will tell him the meaning of his dream."
verses.textEnNasb: Thereupon, Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to kill the wise men of Babylon; he went and said this to him: "Do not kill the wise men of Babylon! Take me into the king’s presence, and I will declare the interpretation to the king."
verses.textEn: Then Daniel went to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to execute the wise men of Babylon, and said to him, "Do not execute the wise men of Babylon. Take me to the king, and I will interpret his dream for him."

verses.textZh: 亚略就急忙把但以理带到王面前，对王这样说："我在被掳的犹大人中找到一个能把梦的意思向王说明的人。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 亚略就急忙把但以理带到王面前，对王这样说："我在被掳的犹大人中找到一个能把梦的意思向王说明的人。"
verses.textZhCuv: 亚略就急忙将但以理领到王面前，对王说：「我在被掳的犹大人中遇见一人，他能将梦的讲解告诉王。」
verses.textEnNiv: Arioch took Daniel to the king at once and said, "I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who can tell the king what his dream means."
verses.textEnEsv: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste and said thus to him: "I have found among the exiles from Judah a man who will make known to the king the interpretation."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Arioch quickly brought Daniel before the king, and said thus to him, "I have found a man of the captives of Judah, who will make known to the king the interpretation."
verses.textEnNlt: Arioch quickly took Daniel to the king and said, "I have found one of the captives from Judah who will tell the king the meaning of his dream!"
verses.textEnNasb: Then Arioch hurriedly brought Daniel into the king’s presence and spoke to him as follows: "I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who can make the interpretation known to the king!"
verses.textEn: Arioch took Daniel to the king at once and said, "I have found a man among the exiles from Judah who can tell the king what his dream means."

verses.textZh: 王问称为伯提沙撒的但以理说："你能向我说明我所见的梦和梦的意思吗？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王问称为伯提沙撒的但以理说："你能向我说明我所见的梦和梦的意思吗？"
verses.textZhCuv: 王问称为伯提沙撒的但以理说：「你能将我所做的梦和梦的讲解告诉我吗？」
verses.textEnNiv: The king asked Daniel (also called Belteshazzar), "Are you able to tell me what I saw in my dream and interpret it?"
verses.textEnEsv: The king declared to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, "Are you able to make known to me the dream that I have seen and its interpretation?"
verses.textEnNkjv: The king answered and said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, "Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?"
verses.textEnNlt: The king said to Daniel (also known as Belteshazzar), "Is this true? Can you tell me what my dream was and what it means?"
verses.textEnNasb: The king said to Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, "Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen and its interpretation?"
verses.textEn: The king asked Daniel (also called Belteshazzar), "Are you able to tell me what I saw in my dream and interpret it?"

verses.textZh: 但以理在王面前回答说："王所问的那隐秘的事，没有智慧人、用法术的、术士和占星家能向王解释；
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理在王面前回答说："王所问的那隐秘的事，没有智慧人、用法术的、术士和占星家能向王解释；
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理在王面前回答说：「王所问的那奥秘事，哲士、用法术的、术士、观兆的都不能告诉王，
verses.textEnNiv: Daniel replied, "No wise man, enchanter, magician or diviner can explain to the king the mystery he has asked about,
verses.textEnEsv: Daniel answered the king and said, "No wise men, enchanters, magicians, or astrologers can show to the king the mystery that the king has asked,
verses.textEnNkjv: Daniel answered in the presence of the king, and said, "The secret which the king has demanded, the wise men, the astrologers, the magicians, and the soothsayers cannot declare to the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Daniel replied, "There are no wise men, enchanters, magicians, or fortune-tellers who can reveal the king’s secret.
verses.textEnNasb: Daniel answered before the king and said, "As for the secret about which the king has inquired, neither wise men, sorcerers, soothsayer priests, nor diviners are able to declare it to the king.
verses.textEn: Daniel replied, "No wise man, enchanter, magician or diviner can explain to the king the mystery he has asked about,

verses.textZh: 只有一位在天上的神能把一切隐秘的事显明；他已经把日后将要发生的事告诉你尼布甲尼撒王了。你的梦和你躺在床上时脑海中出现的异象就是这样：
verses.textZhCnvs: 只有一位在天上的神能把一切隐秘的事显明；他已经把日后将要发生的事告诉你尼布甲尼撒王了。你的梦和你躺在床上时脑海中出现的异象就是这样：
verses.textZhCuv: 只有一位在天上的神能显明奥秘的事。他已将日后必有的事指示尼布甲尼撒王。你的梦和你在床上脑中的异象是这样：
verses.textEnNiv: but there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries. He has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in days to come. Your dream and the visions that passed through your mind as you were lying in bed are these:
verses.textEnEsv: but there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head as you lay in bed are these:
verses.textEnNkjv: But there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream, and the visions of your head upon your bed, were these:
verses.textEnNlt: But there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in the future. Now I will tell you your dream and the visions you saw as you lay on your bed.
verses.textEnNasb: However, there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and He has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will take place in the latter days. This was your dream and the visions in your mind while on your bed.
verses.textEn: but there is a God in heaven who reveals mysteries. He has shown King Nebuchadnezzar what will happen in days to come. Your dream and the visions that passed through your mind as you were lying in bed are these:

verses.textZh: 王啊！你躺在床上时，想到日后将要发生的事，那显明隐秘事的神就把将要发生的事向你说明了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊！你躺在床上时，想到日后将要发生的事，那显明隐秘事的神就把将要发生的事向你说明了。
verses.textZhCuv: 王啊，你在床上想到后来的事，那显明奥秘事的主把将来必有的事指示你。
verses.textEnNiv: "As Your Majesty was lying there, your mind turned to things to come, and the revealer of mysteries showed you what is going to happen.
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O king, as you lay in bed came thoughts of what would be after this, and he who reveals mysteries made known to you what is to be.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for you, O king, thoughts came to your mindwhile on your bed, about what would come to pass after this; and He who reveals secrets has made known to you what will be.
verses.textEnNlt: "While Your Majesty was sleeping, you dreamed about coming events. He who reveals secrets has shown you what is going to happen.
verses.textEnNasb: As for you, O king, while on your bed your thoughts turned to what would take place in the future; and He who reveals secrets has made known to you what will take place.
verses.textEn: "As Your Majesty was lying there, your mind turned to things to come, and the revealer of mysteries showed you what is going to happen.

verses.textZh: 现在这隐秘的事向我显明，并不是因为我的智慧胜过所有的人，而是要使王知道梦的意思和你心想明白的事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在这隐秘的事向我显明，并不是因为我的智慧胜过所有的人，而是要使王知道梦的意思和你心想明白的事。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那奥秘的事显明给我，并非因我的智慧胜过一切活人，乃为使王知道梦的讲解和心里的思念。
verses.textEnNiv: As for me, this mystery has been revealed to me, not because I have greater wisdom than anyone else alive, but so that Your Majesty may know the interpretation and that you may understand what went through your mind.
verses.textEnEsv: But as for me, this mystery has been revealed to me, not because of any wisdom that I have more than all the living, but in order that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your mind.
verses.textEnNkjv: But as for me, this secret has not been revealed to me because I have more wisdom than anyone living, but for our sakes who make known the interpretation to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.
verses.textEnNlt: And it is not because I am wiser than anyone else that I know the secret of your dream, but because God wants you to understand what was in your heart.
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, this secret has not been revealed to me for any wisdom residing in me more than in any other living person, but for the purpose of making the interpretation known to the king, and that you may understand the thoughts of your mind.
verses.textEn: As for me, this mystery has been revealed to me, not because I have greater wisdom than anyone else alive, but so that Your Majesty may know the interpretation and that you may understand what went through your mind.

verses.textZh: "王啊！你正在观看，看见有一座大像，那像甚高，非常光耀，竖立在你面前，样貌十分可怕。
verses.textZhCnvs: "王啊！你正在观看，看见有一座大像，那像甚高，非常光耀，竖立在你面前，样貌十分可怕。
verses.textZhCuv: 「王啊，你梦见一个大像，这像甚高，极其光耀，站在你面前，形状甚是可怕。
verses.textEnNiv: "Your Majesty looked, and there before you stood a large statue—an enormous, dazzling statue, awesome in appearance.
verses.textEnEsv: "You saw, O king, and behold, a great image. This image, mighty and of exceeding brightness, stood before you, and its appearance was frightening.
verses.textEnNkjv: "You, O king, were watching; and behold, a great image! This great image, whose splendor was excellent, stood before you; and its form was awesome.
verses.textEnNlt: "In your vision, Your Majesty, you saw standing before you a huge, shining statue of a man. It was a frightening sight.
verses.textEnNasb: "You, O king, were watching and behold, there was a single great statue; that statue, which was large and of extraordinary radiance, was standing in front of you, and its appearance was awesome.
verses.textEn: "Your Majesty looked, and there before you stood a large statue—an enormous, dazzling statue, awesome in appearance.

verses.textZh: 这像的头是纯金的，胸膛和手臂是银的，腹和腰是铜的，
verses.textZhCnvs: 这像的头是纯金的，胸膛和手臂是银的，腹和腰是铜的，
verses.textZhCuv: 这像的头是精金的，胸膛和膀臂是银的，肚腹和腰是铜的，
verses.textEnNiv: The head of the statue was made of pure gold, its chest and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze,
verses.textEnEsv: The head of this image was of fine gold, its chest and arms of silver, its middle and thighs of bronze,
verses.textEnNkjv: This image’s head was of fine gold, its chest and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze,
verses.textEnNlt: The head of the statue was made of fine gold. Its chest and arms were silver, its belly and thighs were bronze,
verses.textEnNasb: The head of that statue was made of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,
verses.textEn: The head of the statue was made of pure gold, its chest and arms of silver, its belly and thighs of bronze,

verses.textZh: 腿是铁的，脚是铁和泥混杂的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 腿是铁的，脚是铁和泥混杂的。
verses.textZhCuv: 腿是铁的，脚是半铁半泥的。
verses.textEnNiv: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of baked clay.
verses.textEnEsv: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.
verses.textEnNkjv: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.
verses.textEnNlt: its legs were iron, and its feet were a combination of iron and baked clay.
verses.textEnNasb: its legs of iron, and its feet partly of iron and partly of clay.
verses.textEn: its legs of iron, its feet partly of iron and partly of baked clay.

verses.textZh: 你正观看的时候，有一块非人手凿成的石头，击在那座大像铁和泥混杂的脚上，把脚砸碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你正观看的时候，有一块非人手凿成的石头，击在那座大像铁和泥混杂的脚上，把脚砸碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 你观看，见有一块非人手凿出来的石头打在这像半铁半泥的脚上，把脚砸碎；
verses.textEnNiv: While you were watching, a rock was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay and smashed them.
verses.textEnEsv: As you looked, a stone was cut out by no human hand, and it struck the image on its feet of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: You watched while a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: As you watched, a rock was cut from a mountain, but not by human hands. It struck the feet of iron and clay, smashing them to bits.
verses.textEnNasb: You continued watching until a stone was broken off without hands, and it struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay, and crushed them.
verses.textEn: While you were watching, a rock was cut out, but not by human hands. It struck the statue on its feet of iron and clay and smashed them.

verses.textZh: 于是铁、泥、铜、银、金都一同砸得粉碎，好象夏天禾场上的糠秕，被风吹散，无处可寻；那打碎这像的石头却变成一座大山，充满全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是铁、泥、铜、银、金都一同砸得粉碎，好象夏天禾场上的糠秕，被风吹散，无处可寻；那打碎这像的石头却变成一座大山，充满全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是金、银、铜、铁、泥都一同砸得粉碎，成如夏天禾场上的糠秕，被风吹散，无处可寻。打碎这像的石头变成一座大山，充满天下。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver and the gold were all broken to pieces and became like chaff on a threshing floor in the summer. The wind swept them away without leaving a trace. But the rock that struck the statue became a huge mountain and filled the whole earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold, all together were broken in pieces, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors; and the wind carried them away, so that not a trace of them could be found. But the stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed together, and became like chaff from the summer threshing floors; the wind carried them away so that no trace of them was found. And the stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The whole statue was crushed into small pieces of iron, clay, bronze, silver, and gold. Then the wind blew them away without a trace, like chaff on a threshing floor. But the rock that knocked the statue down became a great mountain that covered the whole earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were crushed to pieces all at the same time, and they were like chaff from the summer threshing floors; and the wind carried them away so that not a trace of them was found. But the stone that struck the statue became a great mountain and filled the entire earth.
verses.textEn: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver and the gold were all broken to pieces and became like chaff on a threshing floor in the summer. The wind swept them away without leaving a trace. But the rock that struck the statue became a huge mountain and filled the whole earth.

verses.textZh: "这就是那梦，现在我们要在王面前讲解那梦的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: "这就是那梦，现在我们要在王面前讲解那梦的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 「这就是那梦；我们在王面前要讲解那梦。
verses.textEnNiv: "This was the dream, and now we will interpret it to the king.
verses.textEnEsv: "This was the dream. Now we will tell the king its interpretation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the dream. Now we will tell the interpretation of it before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: "That was the dream. Now we will tell the king what it means.
verses.textEnNasb: "This was the dream; and now we will tell its interpretation before the king.
verses.textEn: "This was the dream, and now we will interpret it to the king.

verses.textZh: 王啊！你是万王之王，天上的神已经把国度、权柄、能力和尊荣都赐给你；
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊！你是万王之王，天上的神已经把国度、权柄、能力和尊荣都赐给你；
verses.textZhCuv: 王啊，你是诸王之王。天上的神已将国度、权柄、能力、尊荣都赐给你。
verses.textEnNiv: Your Majesty, you are the king of kings. The God of heaven has given you dominion and power and might and glory;
verses.textEnEsv: You, O king, the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, and the might, and the glory,
verses.textEnNkjv: You, O king, are a king of kings. For the God of heaven has given you a kingdom, power, strength, and glory;
verses.textEnNlt: Your Majesty, you are the greatest of kings. The God of heaven has given you sovereignty, power, strength, and honor.
verses.textEnNasb: You, O king, are the king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the honor;
verses.textEn: Your Majesty, you are the king of kings. The God of heaven has given you dominion and power and might and glory;

verses.textZh: 也把散居在各处的世人、田野的走兽和空中的飞鸟，都交在你手里，使你管理这一切。你就是那金头。
verses.textZhCnvs: 也把散居在各处的世人、田野的走兽和空中的飞鸟，都交在你手里，使你管理这一切。你就是那金头。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡世人所住之地的走兽，并天空的飞鸟，他都交付你手，使你掌管这一切。你就是那金头。
verses.textEnNiv: in your hands he has placed all mankind and the beasts of the field and the birds in the sky. Wherever they live, he has made you ruler over them all. You are that head of gold.
verses.textEnEsv: and into whose hand he has given, wherever they dwell, the children of man, the beasts of the field, and the birds of the heavens, making you rule over them all—you are the head of gold.
verses.textEnNkjv: and wherever the children of men dwell, or the beasts of the field and the birds of the heaven, He has given them into your hand, and has made you ruler over them all— you are this head of gold.
verses.textEnNlt: He has made you the ruler over all the inhabited world and has put even the wild animals and birds under your control. You are the head of gold.
verses.textEnNasb: and wherever the sons of mankind live, or the animals of the field, or the birds of the sky, He has handed them over to you and has made you ruler over them all. You are the head of gold.
verses.textEn: in your hands he has placed all mankind and the beasts of the field and the birds in the sky. Wherever they live, he has made you ruler over them all. You are that head of gold.

verses.textZh: 在你以后，另一国将兴起，不及于你。后有第三国，就是那铜的，要统治全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 在你以后，另一国将兴起，不及于你。后有第三国，就是那铜的，要统治全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 在你以后必另兴一国，不及于你；又有第三国，就是铜的，必掌管天下。
verses.textEnNiv: "After you, another kingdom will arise, inferior to yours. Next, a third kingdom, one of bronze, will rule over the whole earth.
verses.textEnEsv: Another kingdom inferior to you shall arise after you, and yet a third kingdom of bronze, which shall rule over all the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: But after you shall arise another kingdom inferior to yours; then another, a third kingdom of bronze, which shall rule over all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "But after your kingdom comes to an end, another kingdom, inferior to yours, will rise to take your place. After that kingdom has fallen, yet a third kingdom, represented by bronze, will rise to rule the world.
verses.textEnNasb: And after you another kingdom will arise inferior to you, then another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.
verses.textEn: "After you, another kingdom will arise, inferior to yours. Next, a third kingdom, one of bronze, will rule over the whole earth.

verses.textZh: 还有第四国，坚强如铁，因为铁能砸碎击破万物；铁怎样压碎一切，那国也要照样砸碎一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 还有第四国，坚强如铁，因为铁能砸碎击破万物；铁怎样压碎一切，那国也要照样砸碎一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 第四国，必坚壮如铁，铁能打碎克制百物，又能压碎一切，那国也必打碎压制列国。
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, there will be a fourth kingdom, strong as iron—for iron breaks and smashes everything—and as iron breaks things to pieces, so it will crush and break all the others.
verses.textEnEsv: And there shall be a fourth kingdom, strong as iron, because iron breaks to pieces and shatters all things. And like iron that crushes, it shall break and crush all these.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the fourth kingdom shall be as strong as iron, inasmuch as iron breaks in pieces and shatters everything; and like iron that crushes, thatkingdom will break in pieces and crush all the others.
verses.textEnNlt: Following that kingdom, there will be a fourth one, as strong as iron. That kingdom will smash and crush all previous empires, just as iron smashes and crushes everything it strikes.
verses.textEnNasb: Then there will be a fourth kingdom as strong as iron; just as iron smashes and crushes everything, so, like iron that crushes, it will smash and crush all these things.
verses.textEn: Finally, there will be a fourth kingdom, strong as iron—for iron breaks and smashes everything—and as iron breaks things to pieces, so it will crush and break all the others.

verses.textZh: 正如你看见那像的脚和脚趾是窑匠的泥和铁混杂的，那国也必分裂；正如你看见铁和陶泥混合在一起，那国也必有铁的坚硬。
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如你看见那像的脚和脚趾是窑匠的泥和铁混杂的，那国也必分裂；正如你看见铁和陶泥混合在一起，那国也必有铁的坚硬。
verses.textZhCuv: 你既见像的脚和脚指头，一半是窑匠的泥，一半是铁，那国将来也必分开。你既见铁与泥搀杂，那国也必有铁的力量。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as you saw that the feet and toes were partly of baked clay and partly of iron, so this will be a divided kingdom; yet it will have some of the strength of iron in it, even as you saw iron mixed with clay.
verses.textEnEsv: And as you saw the feet and toes, partly of potter’s clay and partly of iron, it shall be a divided kingdom, but some of the firmness of iron shall be in it, just as you saw iron mixed with the soft clay.
verses.textEnNkjv: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, partly of potter’s clay and partly of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; yet the strength of the iron shall be in it, just as you saw the iron mixed with ceramic clay.
verses.textEnNlt: The feet and toes you saw were a combination of iron and baked clay, showing that this kingdom will be divided. Like iron mixed with clay, it will have some of the strength of iron.
verses.textEnNasb: And in that you saw the feet and toes, partly of potter’s clay and partly of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but it will have within it some of the toughness of iron, since you saw the iron mixed with common clay.
verses.textEn: Just as you saw that the feet and toes were partly of baked clay and partly of iron, so this will be a divided kingdom; yet it will have some of the strength of iron in it, even as you saw iron mixed with clay.

verses.textZh: 那些脚趾是铁和泥混杂的，那国也必是部分坚强，部分脆弱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些脚趾是铁和泥混杂的，那国也必是部分坚强，部分脆弱。
verses.textZhCuv: 那脚指头，既是半铁半泥，那国也必半强半弱。
verses.textEnNiv: As the toes were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.
verses.textEnEsv: And as the toes of the feet were partly iron and partly clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong and partly brittle.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as the toes of the feet were partly of iron and partly of clay, so the kingdom shall be partly strong and partly fragile.
verses.textEnNlt: But while some parts of it will be as strong as iron, other parts will be as weak as clay.
verses.textEnNasb: And just as the toes of the feet were partly of iron and partly of pottery, so some of the kingdom will be strong, and part of it will be fragile.
verses.textEn: As the toes were partly iron and partly clay, so this kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

verses.textZh: 你怎样看见铁和陶泥混合在一起，那国的人也必和列国的人通婚混杂，却不能彼此联合，正如铁和泥不能混杂一样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你怎样看见铁和陶泥混合在一起，那国的人也必和列国的人通婚混杂，却不能彼此联合，正如铁和泥不能混杂一样。
verses.textZhCuv: 你既见铁与泥搀杂，那国民也必与各种人搀杂，却不能彼此相合，正如铁与泥不能相合一样。
verses.textEnNiv: And just as you saw the iron mixed with baked clay, so the people will be a mixture and will not remain united, any more than iron mixes with clay.
verses.textEnEsv: As you saw the iron mixed with soft clay, so they will mix with one another in marriage, but they will not hold together, just as iron does not mix with clay.
verses.textEnNkjv: As you saw iron mixed with ceramic clay, they will mingle with the seed of men; but they will not adhere to one another, just as iron does not mix with clay.
verses.textEnNlt: This mixture of iron and clay also shows that these kingdoms will try to strengthen themselves by forming alliances with each other through intermarriage. But they will not hold together, just as iron and clay do not mix.
verses.textEnNasb: In that you saw the iron mixed with common clay, they will combine with one another in their descendants; but they will not adhere to one another, just as iron does not combine with pottery.
verses.textEn: And just as you saw the iron mixed with baked clay, so the people will be a mixture and will not remain united, any more than iron mixes with clay.

verses.textZh: 那些王在位的时候，天上的神必兴起另一个永不灭亡的国，国权必不归给别族的人。这国必砸碎毁灭其他各国；并且这国必存到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些王在位的时候，天上的神必兴起另一个永不灭亡的国，国权必不归给别族的人。这国必砸碎毁灭其他各国；并且这国必存到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那列王在位的时候，天上的神必另立一国，永不败坏，也不归别国的人，却要打碎灭绝那一切国，这国必存到永远。
verses.textEnNiv: "In the time of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, nor will it be left to another people. It will crush all those kingdoms and bring them to an end, but it will itself endure forever.
verses.textEnEsv: And in the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that shall never be destroyed, nor shall the kingdom be left to another people. It shall break in pieces all these kingdoms and bring them to an end, and it shall stand forever,
verses.textEnNkjv: And in the days of these kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which shall never be destroyed; and the kingdom shall not be left to other people; it shall break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it shall stand forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "During the reigns of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed or conquered. It will crush all these kingdoms into nothingness, and it will stand forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And in the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, and that kingdom will not be left for another people; it will crush and put an end to all these kingdoms, but it will itself endure forever.
verses.textEn: "In the time of those kings, the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, nor will it be left to another people. It will crush all those kingdoms and bring them to an end, but it will itself endure forever.

verses.textZh: 正如你看见那块从山而出，非人手凿成的石头，把铁、铜、泥、银和金都砸碎了，伟大的神已把日后必有的结局都告诉王了。这梦是确实的，梦的意思也是准确的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 正如你看见那块从山而出，非人手凿成的石头，把铁、铜、泥、银和金都砸碎了，伟大的神已把日后必有的结局都告诉王了。这梦是确实的，梦的意思也是准确的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 你既看见非人手凿出来的一块石头从山而出，打碎金、银、铜、铁、泥，那就是至大的神把后来必有的事给王指明。这梦准是这样，这讲解也是确实的。」
verses.textEnNiv: This is the meaning of the vision of the rock cut out of a mountain, but not by human hands—a rock that broke the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver and the gold to pieces. "The great God has shown the king what will take place in the future. The dream is true and its interpretation is trustworthy."
verses.textEnEsv: just as you saw that a stone was cut from a mountain by no human hand, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold. A great God has made known to the king what shall be after this. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure."
verses.textEnNkjv: Inasmuch as you saw that the stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold—the great God has made known to the king what will come to pass after this. The dream is certain, and its interpretation is sure."
verses.textEnNlt: That is the meaning of the rock cut from the mountain, though not by human hands, that crushed to pieces the statue of iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold. The great God was showing the king what will happen in the future. The dream is true, and its meaning is certain."
verses.textEnNasb: Just as you saw that a stone was broken off from the mountain without hands, and that it crushed the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will take place in the future; so the dream is certain and its interpretation is trustworthy."
verses.textEn: This is the meaning of the vision of the rock cut out of a mountain, but not by human hands—a rock that broke the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver and the gold to pieces. "The great God has shown the king what will take place in the future. The dream is true and its interpretation is trustworthy."

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒王俯伏在地，向但以理下拜，又下令向但以理献上供物和香品。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒王俯伏在地，向但以理下拜，又下令向但以理献上供物和香品。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，尼布甲尼撒王俯伏在地，向但以理下拜，并且吩咐人给他奉上供物和香品。
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell prostrate before Daniel and paid him honor and ordered that an offering and incense be presented to him.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell upon his face and paid homage to Daniel, and commanded that an offering and incense be offered up to him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, prostrate before Daniel, and commanded that they should present an offering and incense to him.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Nebuchadnezzar threw himself down before Daniel and worshiped him, and he commanded his people to offer sacrifices and burn sweet incense before him.
verses.textEnNasb: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face and paid humble respect to Daniel, and gave orders to present to him an offering and incense.
verses.textEn: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell prostrate before Daniel and paid him honor and ordered that an offering and incense be presented to him.

verses.textZh: 王对但以理说："你们的神真是万神之神，万王之王，又是显明隐秘事的，因为你能把这隐秘的事显明出来。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王对但以理说："你们的神真是万神之神，万王之王，又是显明隐秘事的，因为你能把这隐秘的事显明出来。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王对但以理说：「你既能显明这奥秘的事，你们的神诚然是万神之神、万王之主，又是显明奥秘事的。」
