verses.textEnNiv: The king said to Daniel, "Surely your God is the God of gods and the Lord of kings and a revealer of mysteries, for you were able to reveal this mystery."
verses.textEnEsv: The king answered and said to Daniel, "Truly, your God is God of gods and Lord of kings, and a revealer of mysteries, for you have been able to reveal this mystery."
verses.textEnNkjv: The king answered Daniel, and said, "Truly your God is the God of gods, the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you could reveal this secret."
verses.textEnNlt: The king said to Daniel, "Truly, your God is the greatest of gods, the Lord over kings, a revealer of mysteries, for you have been able to reveal this secret."
verses.textEnNasb: The king responded to Daniel and said, "Your God truly is a God of gods and a Lord of kings and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret."
verses.textEn: The king said to Daniel, "Surely your God is the God of gods and the Lord of kings and a revealer of mysteries, for you were able to reveal this mystery."

verses.textZh: 于是王提升但以理，赐他许多贵重的礼物，使他管理巴比伦全省，又立他为总长，管理巴比伦所有的智慧人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王提升但以理，赐他许多贵重的礼物，使他管理巴比伦全省，又立他为总长，管理巴比伦所有的智慧人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是王高抬但以理，赏赐他许多上等礼物，派他管理巴比伦全省，又立他为总理，掌管巴比伦的一切哲士。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king placed Daniel in a high position and lavished many gifts on him. He made him ruler over the entire province of Babylon and placed him in charge of all its wise men.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king gave Daniel high honors and many great gifts, and made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon and chief prefect over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king promoted Daniel and gave him many great gifts; and he made him ruler over the whole province of Babylon, and chief administrator over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king appointed Daniel to a high position and gave him many valuable gifts. He made Daniel ruler over the whole province of Babylon, as well as chief over all his wise men.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king promoted Daniel and gave him many great gifts, and he made him ruler over the entire province of Babylon, and chief prefect over all the wise men of Babylon.
verses.textEn: Then the king placed Daniel in a high position and lavished many gifts on him. He made him ruler over the entire province of Babylon and placed him in charge of all its wise men.

verses.textZh: 但以理求王，王就委派沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌管理巴比伦省的政务；但以理却在朝中侍立。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理求王，王就委派沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌管理巴比伦省的政务；但以理却在朝中侍立。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理求王，王就派沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌管理巴比伦省的事务，只是但以理常在朝中侍立。
verses.textEnNiv: Moreover, at Daniel’s request the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego administrators over the province of Babylon, while Daniel himself remained at the royal court.
verses.textEnEsv: Daniel made a request of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon. But Daniel remained at the king’s court.
verses.textEnNkjv: Also Daniel petitioned the king, and he set Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego over the affairs of the province of Babylon; but Daniel sat in the gate of the king.
verses.textEnNlt: At Daniel’s request, the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to be in charge of all the affairs of the province of Babylon, while Daniel remained in the king’s court.
verses.textEnNasb: And Daniel made a request of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego over the administration of the province of Babylon, while Daniel was at the king’s court.
verses.textEn: Moreover, at Daniel’s request the king appointed Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego administrators over the province of Babylon, while Daniel himself remained at the royal court.

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒王造了一座金像，高二十七公尺，宽三公尺，竖立在巴比伦省的杜拉平原上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒王造了一座金像，高二十七公尺，宽三公尺，竖立在巴比伦省的杜拉平原上。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒王造了一个金像，高六十肘，宽六肘，立在巴比伦省杜拉平原。
verses.textEnNiv: King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide, and set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits and its breadth six cubits. He set it up on the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king made an image of gold, whose height was sixty cubits and its width six cubits. He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: King Nebuchadnezzar made a gold statue ninety feet tall and nine feet wide and set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar the king made a statue of gold, the height of which was sixty cubits, and its width six cubits; he set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEn: King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold, sixty cubits high and six cubits wide, and set it up on the plain of Dura in the province of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒王派人召集总督、总监、省长、参谋、财政大臣、法官、裁判官和各省所有的官员，要他们参加尼布甲尼撒王为所立的像举行的揭幕典礼。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒王派人召集总督、总监、省长、参谋、财政大臣、法官、裁判官和各省所有的官员，要他们参加尼布甲尼撒王为所立的像举行的揭幕典礼。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒王差人将总督、钦差、巡抚、臬司、藩司、谋士、法官，和各省的官员都召了来，为尼布甲尼撒王所立的像行开光之礼。
verses.textEnNiv: He then summoned the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials to come to the dedication of the image he had set up.
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar sent to gather the satraps, the prefects, and the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the justices, the magistrates, and all the officials of the provinces to come to the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNkjv: And King Nebuchadnezzar sent word to gather together the satraps, the administrators, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the officials of the provinces, to come to the dedication of the image which King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he sent messages to the high officers, officials, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates, and all the provincial officials to come to the dedication of the statue he had set up.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar the king also sent word to assemble the satraps, the prefects and the governors, the counselors, the chief treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the administrators of the provinces to come to the dedication of the statue that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.textEn: He then summoned the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials to come to the dedication of the image he had set up.

verses.textZh: 于是总督、总监、省长、参谋、财政大臣、法官、裁判官和省内所有其他的官员，都聚集起来，参加尼布甲尼撒王为所立的像举行的揭幕典礼；他们都站在尼布甲尼撒所立的像前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是总督、总监、省长、参谋、财政大臣、法官、裁判官和省内所有其他的官员，都聚集起来，参加尼布甲尼撒王为所立的像举行的揭幕典礼；他们都站在尼布甲尼撒所立的像前。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是总督、钦差、巡抚、臬司、藩司、谋士、法官，和各省的官员都聚集了来，要为尼布甲尼撒王所立的像行开光之礼，就站在尼布甲尼撒所立的像前。
verses.textEnNiv: So the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials assembled for the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up, and they stood before it.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the satraps, the prefects, and the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the justices, the magistrates, and all the officials of the provinces gathered for the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up. And they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the satraps, the administrators, the governors, the counselors, the treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the officials of the provinces gathered together for the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up; and they stood before the image that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNlt: So all these officials came and stood before the statue King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the satraps, the prefects and the governors, the counselors, the chief treasurers, the judges, the magistrates, and all the administrators of the provinces were assembled for the dedication of the statue that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up; and they stood before the statue that Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEn: So the satraps, prefects, governors, advisers, treasurers, judges, magistrates and all the other provincial officials assembled for the dedication of the image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up, and they stood before it.

verses.textZh: 那时，传令官大声呼叫说："各国、各族、说各种语言的人哪！这是传给你们的命令：
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，传令官大声呼叫说："各国、各族、说各种语言的人哪！这是传给你们的命令：
verses.textZhCuv: 那时传令的大声呼叫说：「各方、各国、各族 的人哪，有令传与你们：
verses.textEnNiv: Then the herald loudly proclaimed, "Nations and peoples of every language, this is what you are commanded to do:
verses.textEnEsv: And the herald proclaimed aloud, "You are commanded, O peoples, nations, and languages,
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a herald cried aloud: "To you it is commanded, O peoples, nations, and languages,
verses.textEnNlt: Then a herald shouted out, "People of all races and nations and languages, listen to the king’s command!
verses.textEnNasb: Then the herald loudly proclaimed: "To you the command is given, you peoples, nations, and populations of all languages,
verses.textEn: Then the herald loudly proclaimed, "Nations and peoples of every language, this is what you are commanded to do:

verses.textZh: 你们一听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴、风笛和各种乐器的声音，就要俯伏，向尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你们一听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴、风笛和各种乐器的声音，就要俯伏，向尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 你们一听见角、笛、琵琶、琴、瑟、笙，和各样乐器的声音，就当俯伏敬拜尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
verses.textEnEsv: that when you hear the sound of the horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music, you are to fall down and worship the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.
verses.textEnNkjv: that at the time you hear the sound of the horn, flute, harp, lyre, and psaltery, in symphony with all kinds of music, you shall fall down and worship the gold image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up;
verses.textEnNlt: When you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and other musical instruments, bow to the ground to worship King Nebuchadnezzar’s gold statue.
verses.textEnNasb: that at the moment you hear the sound of the horn, flute, lyre, trigon, psaltery, bagpipe, and all kinds of musical instruments, you are to fall down and worship the golden statue that Nebuchadnezzar the king has set up.
verses.textEn: As soon as you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music, you must fall down and worship the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up.

verses.textZh: 凡不俯伏下拜的，就必立刻扔在烈火的窑中。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡不俯伏下拜的，就必立刻扔在烈火的窑中。"
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不俯伏敬拜的，必立时扔在烈火的窑中。」
verses.textEnNiv: Whoever does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace."
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever does not fall down and worship shall immediately be cast into a burning fiery furnace."
verses.textEnNkjv: and whoever does not fall down and worship shall be cast immediately into the midst of a burning fiery furnace."
verses.textEnNlt: Anyone who refuses to obey will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace."
verses.textEnNasb: But whoever does not fall down and worship shall immediately be thrown into the middle of a furnace of blazing fire."
verses.textEn: Whoever does not fall down and worship will immediately be thrown into a blazing furnace."

verses.textZh: 因此，各国、各族和说各种语言的人，一听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴和各种乐器的声音，就都俯伏，向尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，各国、各族和说各种语言的人，一听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴和各种乐器的声音，就都俯伏，向尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 因此各方、各国、各族的人民一听见角、笛、琵琶、琴、瑟，和各样乐器的声音，就都俯伏敬拜尼布甲尼撒王所立的金像。
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, as soon as they heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp and all kinds of music, all the nations and peoples of every language fell down and worshiped the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, as soon as all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music, all the peoples, nations, and languages fell down and worshiped the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNkjv: So at that time, when all the people heard the sound of the horn, flute, harp, and lyre, in symphony with all kinds of music, all the people, nations, and languages fell down and worshiped the gold image which King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNlt: So at the sound of the musical instruments, all the people, whatever their race or nation or language, bowed to the ground and worshiped the gold statue that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore as soon as all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, lyre, trigon, psaltery, bagpipe, and all kinds of musical instruments, all the peoples, nations, and populations of all languages fell down and worshiped the golden statue that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
verses.textEn: Therefore, as soon as they heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp and all kinds of music, all the nations and peoples of every language fell down and worshiped the image of gold that King Nebuchadnezzar had set up.

verses.textZh: 那时，有几个迦勒底人前来，诬蔑控告犹大人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，有几个迦勒底人前来，诬蔑控告犹大人。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，有几个迦勒底人进前来控告犹大人。
verses.textEnNiv: At this time some astrologers came forward and denounced the Jews.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came forward and maliciously accused the Jews.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came forward and accused the Jews.
verses.textEnNlt: But some of the astrologers went to the king and informed on the Jews.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason at that time certain Chaldeans came forward and brought charges against the Jews.
verses.textEn: At this time some astrologers came forward and denounced the Jews.

verses.textZh: 他们对尼布甲尼撒王说："愿王万岁！
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们对尼布甲尼撒王说："愿王万岁！
verses.textZhCuv: 他们对尼布甲尼撒王说：「愿王万岁！
verses.textEnNiv: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, "May the king live forever!
verses.textEnEsv: They declared to King Nebuchadnezzar, "O king, live forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: They spoke and said to King Nebuchadnezzar, "O king, live forever!
verses.textEnNlt: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, "Long live the king!
verses.textEnNasb: They began to speak and said to Nebuchadnezzar the king: "O king, live forever!
verses.textEn: They said to King Nebuchadnezzar, "May the king live forever!

verses.textZh: 王啊，你曾下令，凡听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴、风笛和各种乐器声音的人，都要俯伏，向金像下拜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊，你曾下令，凡听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴、风笛和各种乐器声音的人，都要俯伏，向金像下拜。
verses.textZhCuv: 王啊，你曾降旨说，凡听见角、笛、琵琶、琴、瑟、笙，和各样乐器声音的都当俯伏敬拜金像。
verses.textEnNiv: Your Majesty has issued a decree that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music must fall down and worship the image of gold,
verses.textEnEsv: You, O king, have made a decree, that every man who hears the sound of the horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music, shall fall down and worship the golden image.
verses.textEnNkjv: You, O king, have made a decree that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, flute, harp, lyre, and psaltery, in symphony with all kinds of music, shall fall down and worship the gold image;
verses.textEnNlt: You issued a decree requiring all the people to bow down and worship the gold statue when they hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipes, and other musical instruments.
verses.textEnNasb: You, O king, have made a decree that every person who hears the sound of the horn, flute, lyre, trigon, psaltery, and bagpipe, and all kinds of musical instruments, is to fall down and worship the golden statue.
verses.textEn: Your Majesty has issued a decree that everyone who hears the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music must fall down and worship the image of gold,

verses.textZh: 凡不俯伏下拜的，就必被扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 凡不俯伏下拜的，就必被扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCuv: 凡不俯伏敬拜的，必扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textEnNiv: and that whoever does not fall down and worship will be thrown into a blazing furnace.
verses.textEnEsv: And whoever does not fall down and worship shall be cast into a burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNkjv: and whoever does not fall down and worship shall be cast into the midst of a burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNlt: That decree also states that those who refuse to obey must be thrown into a blazing furnace.
verses.textEnNasb: But whoever does not fall down and worship shall be thrown into the middle of a furnace of blazing fire.
verses.textEn: and that whoever does not fall down and worship will be thrown into a blazing furnace.

verses.textZh: 但有几个犹大人，就是王所派管理巴比伦省政务的沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌，王啊！这些人不理会你的命令，不事奉你的神，也不向你所立的金像下拜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但有几个犹大人，就是王所派管理巴比伦省政务的沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌，王啊！这些人不理会你的命令，不事奉你的神，也不向你所立的金像下拜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在有几个犹大人，就是王所派管理巴比伦省事务的沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌；王啊，这些人不理你，不事奉你的神，也不敬拜你所立的金像。」
verses.textEnNiv: But there are some Jews whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon—Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego—who pay no attention to you, Your Majesty. They neither serve your gods nor worship the image of gold you have set up."
verses.textEnEsv: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. These men, O king, pay no attention to you; they do not serve your gods or worship the golden image that you have set up."
verses.textEnNkjv: There are certain Jews whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego; these men, O king, have not paid due regard to you. They do not serve your gods or worship the gold image which you have set up."
verses.textEnNlt: But there are some Jews—Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—whom you have put in charge of the province of Babylon. They pay no attention to you, Your Majesty. They refuse to serve your gods and do not worship the gold statue you have set up."
verses.textEnNasb: There are certain Jews whom you have appointed over the administration of the province of Babylon, namely Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. These men, O king, have disregarded you; they do not serve your gods, nor do they worship the golden statue which you have set up."
verses.textEn: But there are some Jews whom you have set over the affairs of the province of Babylon—Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego—who pay no attention to you, Your Majesty. They neither serve your gods nor worship the image of gold you have set up."

verses.textZh: 当时尼布甲尼撒勃然大怒，吩咐人把沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌带来；他们就被带到王面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时尼布甲尼撒勃然大怒，吩咐人把沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌带来；他们就被带到王面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，尼布甲尼撒冲冲大怒，吩咐人把沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌带过来，他们就把那些人带到王面前。
verses.textEnNiv: Furious with rage, Nebuchadnezzar summoned Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. So these men were brought before the king,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Nebuchadnezzar in furious rage commanded that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought. So they brought these men before the king.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar, in rage and fury, gave the command to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego. So they brought these men before the king.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nebuchadnezzar flew into a rage and ordered that Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego be brought before him. When they were brought in,
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nebuchadnezzar in rage and anger gave orders to bring Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego; then these men were brought before the king.
verses.textEn: Furious with rage, Nebuchadnezzar summoned Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego. So these men were brought before the king,

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒问他们说："沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌啊！你们真的不事奉我的神，也不向我所立的金像下拜吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒问他们说："沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌啊！你们真的不事奉我的神，也不向我所立的金像下拜吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒问他们说：「沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌，你们不事奉我的神，也不敬拜我所立的金像，是故意的吗？
verses.textEnNiv: and Nebuchadnezzar said to them, "Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the image of gold I have set up?
verses.textEnEsv: Nebuchadnezzar answered and said to them, "Is it true, O Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the golden image that I have set up?
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebuchadnezzar spoke, saying to them, "Isit true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the gold image which I have set up?
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuchadnezzar said to them, "Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, that you refuse to serve my gods or to worship the gold statue I have set up?
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar began speaking and said to them, "Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, that you do not serve my gods, nor worship the golden statue that I have set up?
verses.textEn: and Nebuchadnezzar said to them, "Is it true, Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, that you do not serve my gods or worship the image of gold I have set up?

verses.textZh: 现在，如果你们想清楚，一听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴、风笛和各种乐器的声音，就俯伏向我所做的像下拜，那还可以。如果你们不下拜，就必立刻扔在烈火的窑中。哪里有神能救你们脱离我的手呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，如果你们想清楚，一听见角、笛、琵琶、弦琴、竖琴、风笛和各种乐器的声音，就俯伏向我所做的像下拜，那还可以。如果你们不下拜，就必立刻扔在烈火的窑中。哪里有神能救你们脱离我的手呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 你们再听见角、笛、琵琶、琴、瑟、笙，和各样乐器的声音，若俯伏敬拜我所造的像，却还可以；若不敬拜，必立时扔在烈火的窑中，有何神能救你们脱离我手呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Now when you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music, if you are ready to fall down and worship the image I made, very good. But if you do not worship it, you will be thrown immediately into a blazing furnace. Then what god will be able to rescue you from my hand?"
verses.textEnEsv: Now if you are ready when you hear the sound of the horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music, to fall down and worship the image that I have made, well and good. But if you do not worship, you shall immediately be cast into a burning fiery furnace. And who is the god who will deliver you out of my hands?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Now if you are ready at the time you hear the sound of the horn, flute, harp, lyre, and psaltery, in symphony with all kinds of music, and you fall down and worship the image which I have made, good! But if you do not worship, you shall be cast immediately into the midst of a burning fiery furnace. And who is the god who will deliver you from my hands?"
verses.textEnNlt: I will give you one more chance to bow down and worship the statue I have made when you hear the sound of the musical instruments. But if you refuse, you will be thrown immediately into the blazing furnace. And then what god will be able to rescue you from my power?"
verses.textEnNasb: Now if you are ready, at the moment you hear the sound of the horn, flute, lyre, trigon, psaltery and bagpipe, and all kinds of musical instruments, to fall down and worship the statue that I have made, very well. But if you do not worship, you will immediately be thrown into the midst of a furnace of blazing fire; and what god is there who can rescue you from my hands?"
verses.textEn: Now when you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe and all kinds of music, if you are ready to fall down and worship the image I made, very good. But if you do not worship it, you will be thrown immediately into a blazing furnace. Then what god will be able to rescue you from my hand?"

verses.textZh: 沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌回答王说："尼布甲尼撒啊！这件事我们无需回答你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌回答王说："尼布甲尼撒啊！这件事我们无需回答你。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌对王说：「尼布甲尼撒啊，这件事我们不必回答你，
verses.textEnNiv: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego replied to him, "King Nebuchadnezzar, we do not need to defend ourselves before you in this matter.
verses.textEnEsv: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego answered and said to the king, "O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego answered and said to the king, "O Nebuchadnezzar, we have no need to answer you in this matter.
verses.textEnNlt: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego replied, "O Nebuchadnezzar, we do not need to defend ourselves before you.
verses.textEnNasb: Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego replied to the king, "Nebuchadnezzar, we are not in need of an answer to give you concerning this matter.
verses.textEn: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego replied to him, "King Nebuchadnezzar, we do not need to defend ourselves before you in this matter.

verses.textZh: 如果我们被扔在火窑里，我们所事奉的神必能拯救我们；王啊！他必拯救我们脱离烈火的窑和你的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 如果我们被扔在火窑里，我们所事奉的神必能拯救我们；王啊！他必拯救我们脱离烈火的窑和你的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 即便如此，我们所事奉的神能将我们从烈火的窑中救出来。王啊，他也必救我们脱离你的手；
verses.textEnNiv: If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God we serve is able to deliver us from it, and he will deliver us from Your Majesty’s hand.
verses.textEnEsv: If this be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king.
verses.textEnNkjv: If that isthecase, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and He will deliver us from your hand, O king.
verses.textEnNlt: If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God whom we serve is able to save us. He will rescue us from your power, Your Majesty.
verses.textEnNasb: If it be so, our God whom we serve is able to rescue us from the furnace of blazing fire; and He will rescue us from your hand, O king.
verses.textEn: If we are thrown into the blazing furnace, the God we serve is able to deliver us from it, and he will deliver us from Your Majesty’s hand.

verses.textZh: 即或不然，王啊！你要知道，我们决不事奉你的神，也不向你所立的金像下拜。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 即或不然，王啊！你要知道，我们决不事奉你的神，也不向你所立的金像下拜。"
verses.textZhCuv: 即或不然，王啊，你当知道我们决不事奉你的神，也不敬拜你所立的金像。」
verses.textEnNiv: But even if he does not, we want you to know, Your Majesty, that we will not serve your gods or worship the image of gold you have set up."
verses.textEnEsv: But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image that you have set up."
verses.textEnNkjv: But if not, let it be known to you, O king, that we do not serve your gods, nor will we worship the gold image which you have set up."
verses.textEnNlt: But even if he doesn’t, we want to make it clear to you, Your Majesty, that we will never serve your gods or worship the gold statue you have set up."
verses.textEnNasb: But even if He does not, let it be known to you, O king, that we are not going to serve your gods nor worship the golden statue that you have set up."
verses.textEn: But even if he does not, we want you to know, Your Majesty, that we will not serve your gods or worship the image of gold you have set up."

verses.textZh: 当时尼布甲尼撒向沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌大发烈怒，连脸色也变了，吩咐人把窑烧热，比平常猛烈七倍。
verses.textZhCnvs: 当时尼布甲尼撒向沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌大发烈怒，连脸色也变了，吩咐人把窑烧热，比平常猛烈七倍。
verses.textZhCuv: 当时，尼布甲尼撒怒气填胸，向沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌变了脸色，吩咐人把窑烧热，比寻常更加七倍；
verses.textEnNiv: Then Nebuchadnezzar was furious with Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, and his attitude toward them changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times hotter than usual
verses.textEnEsv: Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with fury, and the expression of his face was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego. He ordered the furnace heated seven times more than it was usually heated.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar was full of fury, and the expression on his face changed toward Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego. He spoke and commanded that they heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.
verses.textEnNlt: Nebuchadnezzar was so furious with Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego that his face became distorted with rage. He commanded that the furnace be heated seven times hotter than usual.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nebuchadnezzar was filled with wrath, and his facial expression was changed toward Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego. He answered by giving orders to heat the furnace seven times more than it was usually heated.
verses.textEn: Then Nebuchadnezzar was furious with Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, and his attitude toward them changed. He ordered the furnace heated seven times hotter than usual

verses.textZh: 又吩咐他军队中几个最精壮的士兵，把沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌绑起来，扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 又吩咐他军队中几个最精壮的士兵，把沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌绑起来，扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCuv: 又吩咐他军中的几个壮士，将沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌捆起来，扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textEnNiv: and commanded some of the strongest soldiers in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego and throw them into the blazing furnace.
verses.textEnEsv: And he ordered some of the mighty men of his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, and to cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he commanded certain mighty men of valor who were in his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego, and cast them into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he ordered some of the strongest men of his army to bind Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego and throw them into the blazing furnace.
verses.textEnNasb: And he ordered certain valiant warriors who were in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego in order to throw them into the furnace of blazing fire.
verses.textEn: and commanded some of the strongest soldiers in his army to tie up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego and throw them into the blazing furnace.

verses.textZh: 于是这三个人穿著外袍、长裤、头巾和身上其他的衣服，被绑起来，扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是这三个人穿著外袍、长裤、头巾和身上其他的衣服，被绑起来，扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCuv: 这三人穿着裤子、内袍、外衣，和别的衣服，被捆起来扔在烈火的窑中。
verses.textEnNiv: So these men, wearing their robes, trousers, turbans and other clothes, were bound and thrown into the blazing furnace.
verses.textEnEsv: Then these men were bound in their cloaks, their tunics, their hats, and their other garments, and they were thrown into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then these men were bound in their coats, their trousers, their turbans, and their other garments, and were cast into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNlt: So they tied them up and threw them into the furnace, fully dressed in their pants, turbans, robes, and other garments.
verses.textEnNasb: Then these men were tied up in their trousers, their coats, their caps, and their other clothes, and were thrown into the middle of the furnace of blazing fire.
verses.textEn: So these men, wearing their robes, trousers, turbans and other clothes, were bound and thrown into the blazing furnace.

verses.textZh: 由于王的命令紧急，窑又烧得非常猛烈，那些把沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌抬起来的人，都被火焰烧死了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 由于王的命令紧急，窑又烧得非常猛烈，那些把沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌抬起来的人，都被火焰烧死了。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为王命紧急，窑又甚热，那抬沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的人都被火焰烧死。
verses.textEnNiv: The king’s command was so urgent and the furnace so hot that the flames of the fire killed the soldiers who took up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego,
verses.textEnEsv: Because the king’s order was urgent and the furnace overheated, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, because the king’s command was urgent, and the furnace exceedingly hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego.
verses.textEnNlt: And because the king, in his anger, had demanded such a hot fire in the furnace, the flames killed the soldiers as they threw the three men in.
verses.textEnNasb: For this reason, because the king’s command was harsh and the furnace had been made extremely hot, the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego.
verses.textEn: The king’s command was so urgent and the furnace so hot that the flames of the fire killed the soldiers who took up Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego,

verses.textZh: 而沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌这三个人仍被绑着，落入烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCnvs: 而沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌这三个人仍被绑着，落入烈火的窑中。
verses.textZhCuv: 沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌这三个人都被捆着落在烈火的窑中。
verses.textEnNiv: and these three men, firmly tied, fell into the blazing furnace.
verses.textEnEsv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell bound into the burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNkjv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
verses.textEnNlt: So Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, securely tied, fell into the roaring flames.
verses.textEnNasb: But these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell into the middle of the furnace of blazing fire still tied up.
verses.textEn: and these three men, firmly tied, fell into the blazing furnace.

verses.textZh: 那时尼布甲尼撒王非常惊奇，急忙起来，问他的谋臣说："我们绑起来扔在火里的，不是三个人吗？"他们回答王说："王啊！是的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时尼布甲尼撒王非常惊奇，急忙起来，问他的谋臣说："我们绑起来扔在火里的，不是三个人吗？"他们回答王说："王啊！是的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，尼布甲尼撒王惊奇，急忙起来，对谋士说：「我们捆起来扔在火里的不是三个人吗？」他们回答王说：「王啊，是。」
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar leaped to his feet in amazement and asked his advisers, "Weren’t there three men that we tied up and threw into the fire?" They replied, "Certainly, Your Majesty."
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar was astonished and rose up in haste. He declared to his counselors, "Did we not cast three men bound into the fire?" They answered and said to the king, "True, O king."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Nebuchadnezzar was astonished; and he rose in haste and spoke, saying to his counselors, "Did we not cast three men bound into the midst of the fire?" They answered and said to the king, "True, O king."
verses.textEnNlt: But suddenly, Nebuchadnezzar jumped up in amazement and exclaimed to his advisers, "Didn’t we tie up three men and throw them into the furnace?" "Yes, Your Majesty, we certainly did," they replied.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nebuchadnezzar the king was astounded and stood up quickly; he said to his counselors, "Was it not three men that we threw bound into the middle of the fire?" They replied to the king, "Absolutely, O king."
verses.textEn: Then King Nebuchadnezzar leaped to his feet in amazement and asked his advisers, "Weren’t there three men that we tied up and threw into the fire?" They replied, "Certainly, Your Majesty."

verses.textZh: 王说："但我见有四个人，并没有绑着，在火中走来走去，也没有受伤，并且那第四个的样貌好象神子。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 王说："但我见有四个人，并没有绑着，在火中走来走去，也没有受伤，并且那第四个的样貌好象神子。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王说：「看哪，我见有四个人，并没有捆绑，在火中游行，也没有受伤；那第四个的相貌好像神子。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods."
verses.textEnEsv: He answered and said, "But I see four men unbound, walking in the midst of the fire, and they are not hurt; and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods."
verses.textEnNkjv: "Look!" he answered, "I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire; and they are not hurt, and the form of the fourth is like the Son of God."
verses.textEnNlt: "Look!" Nebuchadnezzar shouted. "I see four men, unbound, walking around in the fire unharmed! And the fourth looks like a god !"
verses.textEnNasb: He responded, "Look! I see four men untied and walking about in the middle of the fire unharmed, and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods!"
verses.textEn: He said, "Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods."

verses.textZh: 于是尼布甲尼撒走近烈火的窑口，说："至高神的仆人沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌啊！你们出来，到这里来吧。"沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌就从火中出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是尼布甲尼撒走近烈火的窑口，说："至高神的仆人沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌啊！你们出来，到这里来吧。"沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌就从火中出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是，尼布甲尼撒就近烈火窑门，说：「至高神的仆人沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌出来，上这里来吧！」沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌就从火中出来了。
verses.textEnNiv: Nebuchadnezzar then approached the opening of the blazing furnace and shouted, "Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out! Come here!" So Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego came out of the fire,
verses.textEnEsv: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the door of the burning fiery furnace; he declared, "Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here!" Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego came out from the fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Nebuchadnezzar went near the mouth of the burning fiery furnace and spoke, saying, "Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego, servants of the Most High God, come out, and come here." Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego came from the midst of the fire.
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nebuchadnezzar came as close as he could to the door of the flaming furnace and shouted: "Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out! Come here!" So Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego stepped out of the fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Then Nebuchadnezzar came near to the door of the furnace of blazing fire; he said, "Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, come out, you servants of the Most High God, and come here!" Then Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego came out of the middle of the fire.
verses.textEn: Nebuchadnezzar then approached the opening of the blazing furnace and shouted, "Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, servants of the Most High God, come out! Come here!" So Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego came out of the fire,

verses.textZh: 那些总督、总监、省长和王的谋臣，都聚拢来看这三个人，见火无力伤他们的身体；他们的头发没有烧焦，衣服没有烧坏，身上也没有火烧的气味。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些总督、总监、省长和王的谋臣，都聚拢来看这三个人，见火无力伤他们的身体；他们的头发没有烧焦，衣服没有烧坏，身上也没有火烧的气味。
verses.textZhCuv: 那些总督、钦差、巡抚，和王的谋士一同聚集看这三个人，见火无力伤他们的身体，头发也没有烧焦，衣裳也没有变色，并没有火燎的气味。
verses.textEnNiv: and the satraps, prefects, governors and royal advisers crowded around them. They saw that the fire had not harmed their bodies, nor was a hair of their heads singed; their robes were not scorched, and there was no smell of fire on them.
verses.textEnEsv: And the satraps, the prefects, the governors, and the king’s counselors gathered together and saw that the fire had not had any power over the bodies of those men. The hair of their heads was not singed, their cloaks were not harmed, and no smell of fire had come upon them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the satraps, administrators, governors, and the king’s counselors gathered together, and they saw these men on whose bodies the fire had no power; the hair of their head was not singed nor were their garments affected, and the smell of fire was not on them.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the high officers, officials, governors, and advisers crowded around them and saw that the fire had not touched them. Not a hair on their heads was singed, and their clothing was not scorched. They didn’t even smell of smoke!
verses.textEnNasb: The satraps, the prefects, the governors, and the king’s counselors gathered together and saw that the fire had no effect on the bodies of these men, nor was the hair of their heads singed, nor were their trousers damaged, nor had even the smell of fire touched them.
verses.textEn: and the satraps, prefects, governors and royal advisers crowded around them. They saw that the fire had not harmed their bodies, nor was a hair of their heads singed; their robes were not scorched, and there was no smell of fire on them.

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒说："沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神是应当称颂的，他差遣使者拯救那些倚靠他的仆人；他们违抗王的命令，宁愿舍命，除了自己的神以外，不肯事奉敬拜任何其他的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒说："沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神是应当称颂的，他差遣使者拯救那些倚靠他的仆人；他们违抗王的命令，宁愿舍命，除了自己的神以外，不肯事奉敬拜任何其他的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒说：「沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神是应当称颂的！他差遣使者救护倚靠他的仆人，他们不遵王命，舍去己身，在他们神以外不肯事奉敬拜别神。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Nebuchadnezzar said, "Praise be to the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who has sent his angel and rescued his servants! They trusted in him and defied the king’s command and were willing to give up their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.
verses.textEnEsv: Nebuchadnezzar answered and said, "Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, who has sent his angel and delivered his servants, who trusted in him, and set aside the king’s command, and yielded up their bodies rather than serve and worship any god except their own God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebuchadnezzar spoke, saying, "Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego, who sent His Angel and delivered His servants who trusted in Him, and they have frustrated the king’s word, and yielded their bodies, that they should not serve nor worship any god except their own God!
verses.textEnNlt: Then Nebuchadnezzar said, "Praise to the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego! He sent his angel to rescue his servants who trusted in him. They defied the king’s command and were willing to die rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar responded and said, "Blessed be the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, who has sent His angel and rescued His servants who put their trust in Him, violating the king’s command, and surrendered their bodies rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.
verses.textEn: Then Nebuchadnezzar said, "Praise be to the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego, who has sent his angel and rescued his servants! They trusted in him and defied the king’s command and were willing to give up their lives rather than serve or worship any god except their own God.

verses.textZh: 我现在下令：无论各国、各族、说各种语言的人，凡说话得罪沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神的，必被碎尸万段，他的家也必成为废墟，因为没有别的神能这样施行拯救。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我现在下令：无论各国、各族、说各种语言的人，凡说话得罪沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌的神的，必被碎尸万段，他的家也必成为废墟，因为没有别的神能这样施行拯救。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我降旨，无论何方、何国、何族的人，谤沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌之神的，必被凌迟，他的房屋必成粪堆，因为没有别神能这样施行拯救。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego be cut into pieces and their houses be turned into piles of rubble, for no other god can save in this way."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore I make a decree: Any people, nation, or language that speaks anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be torn limb from limb, and their houses laid in ruins, for there is no other god who is able to rescue in this way."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I make a decree that any people, nation, or language which speaks anything amiss against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego shall be cut in pieces, and their houses shall be made an ash heap; because there is no other God who can deliver like this."
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, I make this decree: If any people, whatever their race or nation or language, speak a word against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, they will be torn limb from limb, and their houses will be turned into heaps of rubble. There is no other god who can rescue like this!"
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore I make a decree that any people, nation, or population of any language that speaks anything offensive against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego shall be torn limb from limb and their houses made a rubbish heap, because there is no other god who is able to save in this way."
verses.textEn: Therefore I decree that the people of any nation or language who say anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego be cut into pieces and their houses be turned into piles of rubble, for no other god can save in this way."

verses.textZh: 于是王在巴比伦省提升了沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是王在巴比伦省提升了沙得拉、米煞和亚伯尼歌。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时王在巴比伦省，高升了沙得拉、米煞、亚伯尼歌。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-Nego in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego to even higher positions in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king made Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego prosperous in the province of Babylon.
verses.textEn: Then the king promoted Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego in the province of Babylon.

verses.textZh: 尼布甲尼撒王向住在全地的各国、各族和说各种语言的人宣告说："愿你们大享平安！
verses.textZhCnvs: 尼布甲尼撒王向住在全地的各国、各族和说各种语言的人宣告说："愿你们大享平安！
verses.textZhCuv: 尼布甲尼撒王晓谕住在全地各方、各国、各族的人说：「愿你们大享平安！
verses.textEnNiv: King Nebuchadnezzar, To the nations and peoples of every language, who live in all the earth: May you prosper greatly!
verses.textEnEsv: King Nebuchadnezzar to all peoples, nations, and languages, that dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you!
verses.textEnNkjv: Nebuchadnezzar the king, To all peoples, nations, and languages that dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.
verses.textEnNlt: King Nebuchadnezzar sent this message to the people of every race and nation and language throughout the world: "Peace and prosperity to you!
verses.textEnNasb: Nebuchadnezzar the king to all the peoples, nations, and populations of all languages who live in all the earth: "May your peace be great!
verses.textEn: King Nebuchadnezzar, To the nations and peoples of every language, who live in all the earth: May you prosper greatly!

verses.textZh: 我乐意把至高的神向我所行的神迹奇事宣扬出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我乐意把至高的神向我所行的神迹奇事宣扬出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我乐意将至高的神向我所行的神迹奇事宣扬出来。
verses.textEnNiv: It is my pleasure to tell you about the miraculous signs and wonders that the Most High God has performed for me.
verses.textEnEsv: It has seemed good to me to show the signs and wonders that the Most High God has done for me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I thought it good to declare the signs and wonders that the Most High God has worked for me.
verses.textEnNlt: "I want you all to know about the miraculous signs and wonders the Most High God has performed for me.
verses.textEnNasb: I am pleased to declare the signs and miracles that the Most High God has done for me.
verses.textEn: It is my pleasure to tell you about the miraculous signs and wonders that the Most High God has performed for me.

verses.textZh: 他的神迹多么伟大， 他的奇事多么有力； 他的国是永远的国，
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的神迹多么伟大， 他的奇事多么有力； 他的国是永远的国，
verses.textZhCuv: 他的神迹何其大！ 他的奇事何其盛！ 他的国是永远的； 他的权柄存到万代！
verses.textEnNiv: How great are his signs, how mighty his wonders! His kingdom is an eternal kingdom; his dominion endures from generation to generation.
verses.textEnEsv: How great are his signs, how mighty his wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and his dominion endures from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNkjv: How great are His signs, And how mighty His wonders! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And His dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.textEnNlt: How great are his signs, how powerful his wonders! His kingdom will last forever, his rule through all generations.
verses.textEnNasb: "How great are His signs And how mighty are His miracles! His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And His dominion is from generation to generation.
verses.textEn: How great are his signs, how mighty his wonders! His kingdom is an eternal kingdom; his dominion endures from generation to generation.

verses.textZh: "我尼布甲尼撒安逸地住在家中，在宫里享受荣华富贵。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我尼布甲尼撒安逸地住在家中，在宫里享受荣华富贵。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我－尼布甲尼撒安居在宫中，平顺在殿内。
verses.textEnNiv: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at home in my palace, contented and prosperous.
verses.textEnEsv: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at ease in my house and prospering in my palace.
verses.textEnNkjv: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at rest in my house, and flourishing in my palace.
verses.textEnNlt: "I, Nebuchadnezzar, was living in my palace in comfort and prosperity.
verses.textEnNasb: " I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at ease in my house and happy in my palace.
verses.textEn: I, Nebuchadnezzar, was at home in my palace, contented and prosperous.

verses.textZh: 我作了一个梦，这梦使我惧怕；我在床上所见的梦幻和我脑海中出现的异象，都使我惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我作了一个梦，这梦使我惧怕；我在床上所见的梦幻和我脑海中出现的异象，都使我惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 我做了一梦，使我惧怕。我在床上的思念，并脑中的异象，使我惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: I had a dream that made me afraid. As I was lying in bed, the images and visions that passed through my mind terrified me.
verses.textEnEsv: I saw a dream that made me afraid. As I lay in bed the fancies and the visions of my head alarmed me.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw a dream which made me afraid, and the thoughts on my bed and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.textEnNlt: But one night I had a dream that frightened me; I saw visions that terrified me as I lay in my bed.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw a dream and it startled me; and these appearances as I lay on my bed and the visions in my mind kept alarming me.
verses.textEn: I had a dream that made me afraid. As I was lying in bed, the images and visions that passed through my mind terrified me.

verses.textZh: 我就下令把巴比伦所有的智慧人，都带到我面前来，要他们把梦的意思向我说明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我就下令把巴比伦所有的智慧人，都带到我面前来，要他们把梦的意思向我说明。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以我降旨召巴比伦的一切哲士到我面前，叫他们把梦的讲解告诉我。
verses.textEnNiv: So I commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be brought before me to interpret the dream for me.
verses.textEnEsv: So I made a decree that all the wise men of Babylon should be brought before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I issued a decree to bring in all the wise men of Babylon before me, that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.textEnNlt: So I issued an order calling in all the wise men of Babylon, so they could tell me what my dream meant.
verses.textEnNasb: So I gave orders to bring into my presence all the wise men of Babylon, so that they might make known to me the interpretation of the dream.
verses.textEn: So I commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be brought before me to interpret the dream for me.

verses.textZh: 于是术士、用法术的、迦勒底人和占星家都进来；我当面把那梦告诉了他们，可是他们却不能把梦的意思向我说明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是术士、用法术的、迦勒底人和占星家都进来；我当面把那梦告诉了他们，可是他们却不能把梦的意思向我说明。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是那些术士、用法术的、迦勒底人、观兆的都进来，我将那梦告诉了他们，他们却不能把梦的讲解告诉我。
verses.textEnNiv: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners came, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the magicians, the enchanters, the Chaldeans, and the astrologers came in, and I told them the dream, but they could not make known to me its interpretation.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the magicians, the astrologers, the Chaldeans, and the soothsayers came in, and I told them the dream; but they did not make known to me its interpretation.
verses.textEnNlt: When all the magicians, enchanters, astrologers, and fortune-tellers came in, I told them the dream, but they could not tell me what it meant.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the soothsayer priests, the sorcerers, the Chaldeans, and the diviners came in and I related the dream to them, but they could not make its interpretation known to me.
verses.textEn: When the magicians, enchanters, astrologers and diviners came, I told them the dream, but they could not interpret it for me.

verses.textZh: "最后，那照着我神的名，称为伯提沙撒的但以理，来到我面前，他里面有圣神的灵，我就把梦告诉他：
verses.textZhCnvs: "最后，那照着我神的名，称为伯提沙撒的但以理，来到我面前，他里面有圣神的灵，我就把梦告诉他：
verses.textZhCuv: 末后那照我神的名，称为伯提沙撒的但以理来到我面前，他里头有圣神的灵，我将梦告诉他说：
verses.textEnNiv: Finally, Daniel came into my presence and I told him the dream. (He is called Belteshazzar, after the name of my god, and the spirit of the holy gods is in him.)
verses.textEnEsv: At last Daniel came in before me—he who was named Belteshazzar after the name of my god, and in whom is the spirit of the holy gods —and I told him the dream, saying,
verses.textEnNkjv: But at last Daniel came before me (his name is Belteshazzar, according to the name of my god; in him is the Spirit of the Holy God), and I told the dream before him, saying:
verses.textEnNlt: At last Daniel came in before me, and I told him the dream. (He was named Belteshazzar after my god, and the spirit of the holy gods is in him.)
verses.textEnNasb: But finally Daniel came in before me, whose name is Belteshazzar according to the name of my god, and in whom is a spirit of the holy gods; and I related the dream to him, saying,
verses.textEn: Finally, Daniel came into my presence and I told him the dream. (He is called Belteshazzar, after the name of my god, and the spirit of the holy gods is in him.)

verses.textZh: ‘术士的领袖伯提沙撒啊！因为我知道你里面有圣神的灵，没有甚么隐秘的事能难倒你；因此，你要把我梦中所见的异象和梦的意思告诉我。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘术士的领袖伯提沙撒啊！因为我知道你里面有圣神的灵，没有甚么隐秘的事能难倒你；因此，你要把我梦中所见的异象和梦的意思告诉我。
verses.textZhCuv: 『术士的领袖伯提沙撒啊，因我知道你里头有圣神的灵，什么奥秘的事都不能使你为难。现在要把我梦中所见的异象和梦的讲解告诉我。』
verses.textEnNiv: I said, "Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no mystery is too difficult for you. Here is my dream; interpret it for me.
verses.textEnEsv: "O Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, because I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that no mystery is too difficult for you, tell me the visions of my dream that I saw and their interpretation.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, because I know that the Spirit of the Holy God is in you, and no secret troubles you, explain to me the visions of my dream that I have seen, and its interpretation.
verses.textEnNlt: "I said to him, ‘Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you and that no mystery is too great for you to solve. Now tell me what my dream means.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Belteshazzar, chief of the soothsayer priests, since I know that a spirit of the holy gods is in you and no secret baffles you, tell me the visions of my dream which I have seen, along with its interpretation.
verses.textEn: I said, "Belteshazzar, chief of the magicians, I know that the spirit of the holy gods is in you, and no mystery is too difficult for you. Here is my dream; interpret it for me.

verses.textZh: 我躺在床上时脑海中所见的异象是这样： 我看见大地中间， 有一棵树，十分高大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我躺在床上时脑海中所见的异象是这样： 我看见大地中间， 有一棵树，十分高大。
verses.textZhCuv: 「我在床上脑中的异象是这样：我看见地当中有一棵树，极其高大。
verses.textEnNiv: These are the visions I saw while lying in bed: I looked, and there before me stood a tree in the middle of the land. Its height was enormous.
verses.textEnEsv: The visions of my head as I lay in bed were these: I saw, and behold, a tree in the midst of the earth, and its height was great.
verses.textEnNkjv: "These were the visions of my head while on my bed: I was looking, and behold, A tree in the midst of the earth, And its height was great.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘While I was lying in my bed, this is what I dreamed. I saw a large tree in the middle of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Now these were the visions in my mind as I lay on my bed: I was looking, and behold, there was a tree in the middle of the earth and its height was great.
verses.textEn: These are the visions I saw while lying in bed: I looked, and there before me stood a tree in the middle of the land. Its height was enormous.

verses.textZh: 那树渐长，而且坚强， 高达于天， 地极所有的人都看得到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那树渐长，而且坚强， 高达于天， 地极所有的人都看得到。
verses.textZhCuv: 那树渐长，而且坚固，高得顶天，从地极都能看见，
verses.textEnNiv: The tree grew large and strong and its top touched the sky; it was visible to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: The tree grew and became strong, and its top reached to heaven, and it was visible to the end of the whole earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: The tree grew and became strong; Its height reached to the heavens, And it could be seen to the ends of all the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: The tree grew very tall and strong, reaching high into the heavens for all the world to see.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘The tree grew large and became strong And its height reached to the sky, And it was visible to the end of the whole earth.
verses.textEn: The tree grew large and strong and its top touched the sky; it was visible to the ends of the earth.

verses.textZh: 它的叶子美丽，果实繁多， 所有的生物都从它得到食物； 野地的走兽在它下面歇息， 空中的飞鸟栖宿在它的枝头上； 各种生物都从它得着供养。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的叶子美丽，果实繁多， 所有的生物都从它得到食物； 野地的走兽在它下面歇息， 空中的飞鸟栖宿在它的枝头上； 各种生物都从它得着供养。
verses.textZhCuv: 叶子华美，果子甚多，可作众生的食物；田野的走兽卧在荫下，天空的飞鸟宿在枝上；凡有血气的都从这树得食。
verses.textEnNiv: Its leaves were beautiful, its fruit abundant, and on it was food for all. Under it the wild animals found shelter, and the birds lived in its branches; from it every creature was fed.
verses.textEnEsv: Its leaves were beautiful and its fruit abundant, and in it was food for all. The beasts of the field found shade under it, and the birds of the heavens lived in its branches, and all flesh was fed from it.
verses.textEnNkjv: Its leaves were lovely, Its fruit abundant, And in it was food for all. The beasts of the field found shade under it, The birds of the heavens dwelt in its branches, And all flesh was fed from it.
verses.textEnNlt: It had fresh green leaves, and it was loaded with fruit for all to eat. Wild animals lived in its shade, and birds nested in its branches. All the world was fed from this tree.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘Its foliage was beautiful and its fruit abundant, And in it was food for all. The animals of the field found shade under it, And the birds of the sky lived in its branches, And all living creatures fed from it.
verses.textEn: Its leaves were beautiful, its fruit abundant, and on it was food for all. Under it the wild animals found shelter, and the birds lived in its branches; from it every creature was fed.

verses.textZh: "‘我躺在床上，在我脑海出现的异象中，我看见有一位守望者，就是圣者，从天上下来，
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘我躺在床上，在我脑海出现的异象中，我看见有一位守望者，就是圣者，从天上下来，
verses.textZhCuv: 「我在床上脑中的异象，见有一位守望的圣者从天而降。
verses.textEnNiv: "In the visions I saw while lying in bed, I looked, and there before me was a holy one, a messenger, coming down from heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: "I saw in the visions of my head as I lay in bed, and behold, a watcher, a holy one, came down from heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I saw in the visions of my head while on my bed, and there was a watcher, a holy one, coming down from heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Then as I lay there dreaming, I saw a messenger, a holy one, coming down from heaven.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘I was looking in the visions in my mind as I lay on my bed, and behold, an angelic watcher, a holy one, descended from heaven.
verses.textEn: "In the visions I saw while lying in bed, I looked, and there before me was a holy one, a messenger, coming down from heaven.

verses.textZh: 大声呼叫，这样说： 你们要砍下这树，削断枝子， 摇落叶子，打散果子， 把树下的走兽赶散， 把树枝上的飞鸟赶走。
verses.textZhCnvs: 大声呼叫，这样说： 你们要砍下这树，削断枝子， 摇落叶子，打散果子， 把树下的走兽赶散， 把树枝上的飞鸟赶走。
verses.textZhCuv: 大声呼叫说：『伐倒这树！砍下枝子！摇掉叶子！抛散果子！使走兽离开树下，飞鸟躲开树枝。
verses.textEnNiv: He called in a loud voice: ‘Cut down the tree and trim off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the animals flee from under it and the birds from its branches.
verses.textEnEsv: He proclaimed aloud and said thus: ‘Chop down the tree and lop off its branches, strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the beasts flee from under it and the birds from its branches.
verses.textEnNkjv: He cried aloud and said thus: ‘Chop down the tree and cut off its branches, Strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the beasts get out from under it, And the birds from its branches.
verses.textEnNlt: The messenger shouted, "Cut down the tree and lop off its branches! Shake off its leaves and scatter its fruit! Chase the wild animals from its shade and the birds from its branches.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘He shouted out and spoke as follows: "Chop down the tree and cut off its branches, Shake off its foliage and scatter its fruit; Let the animals flee from under it And the birds from its branches.
verses.textEn: He called in a loud voice: ‘Cut down the tree and trim off its branches; strip off its leaves and scatter its fruit. Let the animals flee from under it and the birds from its branches.

verses.textZh: 然而，树根的余干却要留在地上， 用铁和铜的链子围住， 留在野地的青草中， 使他被天露滴湿； 使他像走兽一样在地上的草丛中得他的分。
verses.textZhCnvs: 然而，树根的余干却要留在地上， 用铁和铜的链子围住， 留在野地的青草中， 使他被天露滴湿； 使他像走兽一样在地上的草丛中得他的分。
verses.textZhCuv: 树𣎴却要留在地内，用铁圈和铜圈箍住，在田野的青草中让天露滴湿，使他与地上的兽一同吃草，
verses.textEnNiv: But let the stump and its roots, bound with iron and bronze, remain in the ground, in the grass of the field. " ‘Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and let him live with the animals among the plants of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: But leave the stump of its roots in the earth, bound with a band of iron and bronze, amid the tender grass of the field. Let him be wet with the dew of heaven. Let his portion be with the beasts in the grass of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: Nevertheless leave the stump and roots in the earth, Bound with a band of iron and bronze, In the tender grass of the field. Let it be wet with the dew of heaven, And let him graze with the beasts On the grass of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: But leave the stump and the roots in the ground, bound with a band of iron and bronze and surrounded by tender grass. Now let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and let him live with the wild animals among the plants of the field.
verses.textEnNasb: "Yet leave the stump with its roots in the ground, But with a band of iron and bronze around it In the new grass of the field; And let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, And let him share with the animals in the grass of the earth.
verses.textEn: But let the stump and its roots, bound with iron and bronze, remain in the ground, in the grass of the field. " ‘Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and let him live with the animals among the plants of the earth.

verses.textZh: 使他的心改变，不再是人的心， 给他一个兽心， 使他经过七年的时期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 使他的心改变，不再是人的心， 给他一个兽心， 使他经过七年的时期。
verses.textZhCuv: 使他的心改变，不如人心，给他一个兽心，使他经过七期 。
verses.textEnNiv: Let his mind be changed from that of a man and let him be given the mind of an animal, till seven times pass by for him.
verses.textEnEsv: Let his mind be changed from a man’s, and let a beast’s mind be given to him; and let seven periods of time pass over him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Let his heart be changed from thatof a man, Let him be given the heart of a beast, And let seven times pass over him.
verses.textEnNlt: For seven periods of time, let him have the mind of a wild animal instead of the mind of a human.
verses.textEnNasb: "Let his mind change from that of a human And let an animal’s mind be given to him, And let seven periods of time pass over him.
verses.textEn: Let his mind be changed from that of a man and let him be given the mind of an animal, till seven times pass by for him.

verses.textZh: 这是守望者宣告的裁决， 是圣者颁布的决定， 好使世人都知道： 至高者在世人的国中掌权， 他喜欢把国赐给谁，就赐给谁， 甚至立最卑微的人执掌国权。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这是守望者宣告的裁决， 是圣者颁布的决定， 好使世人都知道： 至高者在世人的国中掌权， 他喜欢把国赐给谁，就赐给谁， 甚至立最卑微的人执掌国权。
verses.textZhCuv: 这是守望者所发的命，圣者所出的令，好叫世人知道至高者在人的国中掌权，要将国赐与谁就赐与谁，或立极卑微的人执掌国权。』
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘The decision is announced by messengers, the holy ones declare the verdict, so that the living may know that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes and sets over them the lowliest of people.’
verses.textEnEsv: The sentence is by the decree of the watchers, the decision by the word of the holy ones, to the end that the living may know that the Most High rules the kingdom of men and gives it to whom he will and sets over it the lowliest of men.’
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘This decision is by the decree of the watchers, And the sentence by the word of the holy ones, In order that the living may know That the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, Gives it to whomever He will, And sets over it the lowest of men.’
verses.textEnNlt: For this has been decreed by the messengers ; it is commanded by the holy ones, so that everyone may know that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of the world. He gives them to anyone he chooses— even to the lowliest of people."
verses.textEnNasb: "This sentence is by the decree of the angelic watchers, And the decision is a command of the holy ones, In order that the living may know That the Most High is ruler over the realm of mankind, And He grants it to whomever He wishes And sets over it the lowliest of people."
verses.textEn: " ‘The decision is announced by messengers, the holy ones declare the verdict, so that the living may know that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes and sets over them the lowliest of people.’

verses.textZh: "‘这就是我尼布甲尼撒王所作的梦。伯提沙撒啊！你要把这梦的意思告诉我，因为我国中所有的智慧人都不能把梦的意思向我说明；只有你能，因为你里面有圣神的灵。’"
verses.textZhCnvs: "‘这就是我尼布甲尼撒王所作的梦。伯提沙撒啊！你要把这梦的意思告诉我，因为我国中所有的智慧人都不能把梦的意思向我说明；只有你能，因为你里面有圣神的灵。’"
verses.textZhCuv: 「这是我－尼布甲尼撒王所做的梦。伯提沙撒啊，你要说明这梦的讲解；因为我国中的一切哲士都不能将梦的讲解告诉我，惟独你能，因你里头有圣神的灵。」
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means, for none of the wise men in my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you can, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you."
verses.textEnEsv: This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, saw. And you, O Belteshazzar, tell me the interpretation, because all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation, but you are able, for the spirit of the holy gods is in you."
verses.textEnNkjv: "This dream I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen. Now you, Belteshazzar, declare its interpretation, since all the wise men of my kingdom are not able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, for the Spirit of the Holy God is in you."
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Belteshazzar, that was the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. Now tell me what it means, for none of the wise men of my kingdom can do so. But you can tell me because the spirit of the holy gods is in you.’
verses.textEnNasb: This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, have seen. Now you, Belteshazzar, tell me its interpretation, since none of the wise men of my kingdom is able to make known to me the interpretation; but you are able, because a spirit of the holy gods is in you.’
verses.textEn: "This is the dream that I, King Nebuchadnezzar, had. Now, Belteshazzar, tell me what it means, for none of the wise men in my kingdom can interpret it for me. But you can, because the spirit of the holy gods is in you."

verses.textZh: 于是那称为伯提沙撒的但以理惊愕片时，他想到的事使他惊惶。王对他说："伯提沙撒啊！别让这梦和梦的意思使你惊惶。"伯提沙撒回答说："我主啊！愿这梦归给憎恨你的人，梦的意思归给你的敌人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是那称为伯提沙撒的但以理惊愕片时，他想到的事使他惊惶。王对他说："伯提沙撒啊！别让这梦和梦的意思使你惊惶。"伯提沙撒回答说："我主啊！愿这梦归给憎恨你的人，梦的意思归给你的敌人。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是称为伯提沙撒的但以理惊讶片时，心意惊惶。王说：「伯提沙撒啊，不要因梦和梦的讲解惊惶。」伯提沙撒回答说：「我主啊，愿这梦归与恨恶你的人，讲解归与你的敌人。
verses.textEnNiv: Then Daniel (also called Belteshazzar) was greatly perplexed for a time, and his thoughts terrified him. So the king said, "Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its meaning alarm you." Belteshazzar answered, "My lord, if only the dream applied to your enemies and its meaning to your adversaries!
verses.textEnEsv: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was dismayed for a while, and his thoughts alarmed him. The king answered and said, "Belteshazzar, let not the dream or the interpretation alarm you." Belteshazzar answered and said, "My lord, may the dream be for those who hate you and its interpretation for your enemies!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, was astonished for a time, and his thoughts troubled him. So the king spoke, and said, "Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its interpretation trouble you." Belteshazzar answered and said, "My lord, may the dream concern those who hate you, and its interpretation concern your enemies!
verses.textEnNlt: "Upon hearing this, Daniel (also known as Belteshazzar) was overcome for a time, frightened by the meaning of the dream. Then the king said to him, ‘Belteshazzar, don’t be alarmed by the dream and what it means.’ "Belteshazzar replied, ‘I wish the events foreshadowed in this dream would happen to your enemies, my lord, and not to you!
verses.textEnNasb: "Then Daniel, whose name is Belteshazzar, was appalled for a while as his thoughts alarmed him. The king responded and said, ‘Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its interpretation alarm you.’ Belteshazzar replied, ‘My lord, if only the dream applied to those who hate you, and its interpretation to your adversaries!
verses.textEn: Then Daniel (also called Belteshazzar) was greatly perplexed for a time, and his thoughts terrified him. So the king said, "Belteshazzar, do not let the dream or its meaning alarm you." Belteshazzar answered, "My lord, if only the dream applied to your enemies and its meaning to your adversaries!

verses.textZh: 你所见的树渐长，而且坚强，高达于天，全地的人都看得到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所见的树渐长，而且坚强，高达于天，全地的人都看得到。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所见的树渐长，而且坚固，高得顶天，从地极都能看见；
verses.textEnNiv: The tree you saw, which grew large and strong, with its top touching the sky, visible to the whole earth,
verses.textEnEsv: The tree you saw, which grew and became strong, so that its top reached to heaven, and it was visible to the end of the whole earth,
verses.textEnNkjv: "The tree that you saw, which grew and became strong, whose height reached to the heavens and which couldbe seen by all the earth,
verses.textEnNlt: The tree you saw was growing very tall and strong, reaching high into the heavens for all the world to see.
verses.textEnNasb: The tree that you saw, which became large and grew strong, whose height reached to the sky and was visible to all the earth,
verses.textEn: The tree you saw, which grew large and strong, with its top touching the sky, visible to the whole earth,

verses.textZh: 它的叶子美丽，果实繁多，所有的生物都从它得到食物；野地的走兽住在它下面，空中的飞鸟栖在它的枝头上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 它的叶子美丽，果实繁多，所有的生物都从它得到食物；野地的走兽住在它下面，空中的飞鸟栖在它的枝头上。
verses.textZhCuv: 叶子华美，果子甚多，可作众生的食物；田野的走兽住在其下；天空的飞鸟宿在枝上。
verses.textEnNiv: with beautiful leaves and abundant fruit, providing food for all, giving shelter to the wild animals, and having nesting places in its branches for the birds—
verses.textEnEsv: whose leaves were beautiful and its fruit abundant, and in which was food for all, under which beasts of the field found shade, and in whose branches the birds of the heavens lived—
verses.textEnNkjv: whose leaves were lovely and its fruit abundant, in which was food for all, under which the beasts of the field dwelt, and in whose branches the birds of the heaven had their home—
verses.textEnNlt: It had fresh green leaves and was loaded with fruit for all to eat. Wild animals lived in its shade, and birds nested in its branches.
verses.textEnNasb: and whose foliage was beautiful and its fruit abundant, and in which was food for all, under which the animals of the field lived and in whose branches the birds of the sky settled—
verses.textEn: with beautiful leaves and abundant fruit, providing food for all, giving shelter to the wild animals, and having nesting places in its branches for the birds—

verses.textZh: 王啊！你就是那树，越来越伟大坚强；你的威势渐长，高达于天；你的权柄直到地极。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊！你就是那树，越来越伟大坚强；你的威势渐长，高达于天；你的权柄直到地极。
verses.textZhCuv: 「王啊，这渐长又坚固的树就是你。你的威势渐长及天，你的权柄管到地极。
verses.textEnNiv: Your Majesty, you are that tree! You have become great and strong; your greatness has grown until it reaches the sky, and your dominion extends to distant parts of the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: it is you, O king, who have grown and become strong. Your greatness has grown and reaches to heaven, and your dominion to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: it is you, O king, who have grown and become strong; for your greatness has grown and reaches to the heavens, and your dominion to the end of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: That tree, Your Majesty, is you. For you have grown strong and great; your greatness reaches up to heaven, and your rule to the ends of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: it is you, O king; for you have become great and grown strong, and your majesty has become great and reached to the sky, and your dominion to the end of the earth.
verses.textEn: Your Majesty, you are that tree! You have become great and strong; your greatness has grown until it reaches the sky, and your dominion extends to distant parts of the earth.

verses.textZh: 王既然看见一位守望者，就是圣者，从天上下来，说：‘你们要砍下毁坏这树，树根的余干却要留在地上，用铁和铜的链子围住，留在野地的青草中，使他被天露滴湿；使他的分和野地的走兽一样，直到他经过那七年的时期。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 王既然看见一位守望者，就是圣者，从天上下来，说：‘你们要砍下毁坏这树，树根的余干却要留在地上，用铁和铜的链子围住，留在野地的青草中，使他被天露滴湿；使他的分和野地的走兽一样，直到他经过那七年的时期。’
verses.textZhCuv: 王既看见一位守望的圣者从天而降，说：『将这树砍伐毁坏，树𣎴却要留在地内，用铁圈和铜圈箍住；在田野的青草中，让天露滴湿，使他与地上的兽一同吃草，直到经过七期。』
verses.textEnNiv: "Your Majesty saw a holy one, a messenger, coming down from heaven and saying, ‘Cut down the tree and destroy it, but leave the stump, bound with iron and bronze, in the grass of the field, while its roots remain in the ground. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven; let him live with the wild animals, until seven times pass by for him.’
verses.textEnEsv: And because the king saw a watcher, a holy one, coming down from heaven and saying, ‘Chop down the tree and destroy it, but leave the stump of its roots in the earth, bound with a band of iron and bronze, in the tender grass of the field, and let him be wet with the dew of heaven, and let his portion be with the beasts of the field, till seven periods of time pass over him,’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And inasmuch as the king saw a watcher, a holy one, coming down from heaven and saying, ‘Chop down the tree and destroy it, but leave its stump and roots in the earth, bound with a band of iron and bronze in the tender grass of the field; let it be wet with the dew of heaven, and let him graze with the beasts of the field, till seven times pass over him’;
verses.textEnNlt: "‘Then you saw a messenger, a holy one, coming down from heaven and saying, "Cut down the tree and destroy it. But leave the stump and the roots in the ground, bound with a band of iron and bronze and surrounded by tender grass. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven. Let him live with the animals of the field for seven periods of time."
verses.textEnNasb: And in that the king saw an angelic watcher, a holy one, descending from heaven and saying, "Chop down the tree and destroy it; yet leave the stump with its roots in the ground, but with a band of iron and bronze around it in the new grass of the field, let him be drenched with the dew of heaven, and let him share with the animals of the field until seven periods of time pass over him,"
verses.textEn: "Your Majesty saw a holy one, a messenger, coming down from heaven and saying, ‘Cut down the tree and destroy it, but leave the stump, bound with iron and bronze, in the grass of the field, while its roots remain in the ground. Let him be drenched with the dew of heaven; let him live with the wild animals, until seven times pass by for him.’

verses.textZh: 王啊！梦的意思就是这样：这临到我主我王的事，是至高者的裁决。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王啊！梦的意思就是这样：这临到我主我王的事，是至高者的裁决。
verses.textZhCuv: 「王啊，讲解就是这样：临到我主我王的事是出于至高者的命。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the interpretation, Your Majesty, and this is the decree the Most High has issued against my lord the king:
verses.textEnEsv: this is the interpretation, O king: It is a decree of the Most High, which has come upon my lord the king,
verses.textEnNkjv: this is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the Most High, which has come upon my lord the king:
verses.textEnNlt: "‘This is what the dream means, Your Majesty, and what the Most High has declared will happen to my lord the king.
verses.textEnNasb: this is the interpretation, O king, and this is the decree of the Most High, which has come upon my lord the king:
verses.textEn: "This is the interpretation, Your Majesty, and this is the decree the Most High has issued against my lord the king:

verses.textZh: 你必被赶逐，离开人群，和野地的走兽同住；你必像牛一样吃草，被天露滴湿，要经过七年的时期；等到你承认至高者在世人的国中掌权，他喜欢把国赐给谁，就赐给谁。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你必被赶逐，离开人群，和野地的走兽同住；你必像牛一样吃草，被天露滴湿，要经过七年的时期；等到你承认至高者在世人的国中掌权，他喜欢把国赐给谁，就赐给谁。
verses.textZhCuv: 你必被赶出离开世人，与野地的兽同居，吃草如牛，被天露滴湿，且要经过七期。等你知道至高者在人的国中掌权，要将国赐与谁就赐与谁。
verses.textEnNiv: You will be driven away from people and will live with the wild animals; you will eat grass like the ox and be drenched with the dew of heaven. Seven times will pass by for you until you acknowledge that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes.
verses.textEnEsv: that you shall be driven from among men, and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field. You shall be made to eat grass like an ox, and you shall be wet with the dew of heaven, and seven periods of time shall pass over you, till you know that the Most High rules the kingdom of men and gives it to whom he will.
verses.textEnNkjv: They shall drive you from men, your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field, and they shall make you eat grass like oxen. They shall wet you with the dew of heaven, and seven times shall pass over you, till you know that the Most High rules in the kingdom of men, and gives it to whomever He chooses.
verses.textEnNlt: You will be driven from human society, and you will live in the fields with the wild animals. You will eat grass like a cow, and you will be drenched with the dew of heaven. Seven periods of time will pass while you live this way, until you learn that the Most High rules over the kingdoms of the world and gives them to anyone he chooses.
verses.textEnNasb: that you be driven away from mankind and your dwelling place be with the animals of the field, and you be given grass to eat like cattle and be drenched with the dew of heaven; and seven periods of time will pass over you, until you recognize that the Most High is ruler over the realm of mankind and bestows it on whomever He wishes.
verses.textEn: You will be driven away from people and will live with the wild animals; you will eat grass like the ox and be drenched with the dew of heaven. Seven times will pass by for you until you acknowledge that the Most High is sovereign over all kingdoms on earth and gives them to anyone he wishes.

verses.textZh: 守望者既然吩咐要留下树根的余干，所以，等到你承认上天的至高者是掌权的，你的国就必再归给你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 守望者既然吩咐要留下树根的余干，所以，等到你承认上天的至高者是掌权的，你的国就必再归给你。
verses.textZhCuv: 守望者既吩咐存留树𣎴，等你知道诸天掌权，以后你的国必定归你。
verses.textEnNiv: The command to leave the stump of the tree with its roots means that your kingdom will be restored to you when you acknowledge that Heaven rules.
verses.textEnEsv: And as it was commanded to leave the stump of the roots of the tree, your kingdom shall be confirmed for you from the time that you know that Heaven rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And inasmuch as they gave the command to leave the stump and roots of the tree, your kingdom shall be assured to you, after you come to know that Heaven rules.
verses.textEnNlt: But the stump and roots of the tree were left in the ground. This means that you will receive your kingdom back again when you have learned that heaven rules.
verses.textEnNasb: And in that it was commanded to leave the stump with the roots of the tree, your kingdom will remain as yours after you recognize that it is Heaven that rules.
verses.textEn: The command to leave the stump of the tree with its roots means that your kingdom will be restored to you when you acknowledge that Heaven rules.

verses.textZh: 因此，王啊！请你接纳我的劝告，施行公义，断绝罪过，怜悯受欺压者，断绝罪孽，你的平安或者可以延长。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，王啊！请你接纳我的劝告，施行公义，断绝罪过，怜悯受欺压者，断绝罪孽，你的平安或者可以延长。"
verses.textZhCuv: 王啊，求你悦纳我的谏言，以施行公义断绝罪过，以怜悯穷人除掉罪孽，或者你的平安可以延长。」
verses.textEnNiv: Therefore, Your Majesty, be pleased to accept my advice: Renounce your sins by doing what is right, and your wickedness by being kind to the oppressed. It may be that then your prosperity will continue."
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore, O king, let my counsel be acceptable to you: break off your sins by practicing righteousness, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the oppressed, that there may perhaps be a lengthening of your prosperity."
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore, O king, let my advice be acceptable to you; break off your sins by being righteous, and your iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. Perhaps there may be a lengthening of your prosperity."
verses.textEnNlt: "‘King Nebuchadnezzar, please accept my advice. Stop sinning and do what is right. Break from your wicked past and be merciful to the poor. Perhaps then you will continue to prosper.’
verses.textEnNasb: Therefore, O king, may my advice be pleasing to you: wipe away your sin by doing righteousness, and your wrongdoings by showing mercy to the poor, in case there may be a prolonging of your prosperity.’
verses.textEn: Therefore, Your Majesty, be pleased to accept my advice: Renounce your sins by doing what is right, and your wickedness by being kind to the oppressed. It may be that then your prosperity will continue."

verses.textZh: 这一切事都在尼布甲尼撒王身上实现了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切事都在尼布甲尼撒王身上实现了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这事都临到尼布甲尼撒王。
verses.textEnNiv: All this happened to King Nebuchadnezzar.
