verses.textEnNkjv: And when he came to the den, he cried out with a lamenting voice to Daniel. The king spoke, saying to Daniel, "Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to deliver you from the lions?"
verses.textEnNlt: When he got there, he called out in anguish, "Daniel, servant of the living God! Was your God, whom you serve so faithfully, able to rescue you from the lions?"
verses.textEnNasb: And when he had come near the den to Daniel, he cried out with a troubled voice. The king began speaking and said to Daniel, "Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you continually serve, been able to rescue you from the lions?"
verses.textEn: When he came near the den, he called to Daniel in an anguished voice, "Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to rescue you from the lions?"

verses.textZh: 但以理对王说："愿王万岁！
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理对王说："愿王万岁！
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理对王说：「愿王万岁！
verses.textEnNiv: Daniel answered, "May the king live forever!
verses.textEnEsv: Then Daniel said to the king, "O king, live forever!
verses.textEnNkjv: Then Daniel said to the king, "O king, live forever!
verses.textEnNlt: Daniel answered, "Long live the king!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Daniel spoke to the king, "O king, live forever!
verses.textEn: Daniel answered, "May the king live forever!

verses.textZh: 我的神差遣了他的使者，封住狮子的口，使牠们没有伤害我，因为我在神面前是清白的；王啊！在你面前我也没有作过任何错事。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神差遣了他的使者，封住狮子的口，使牠们没有伤害我，因为我在神面前是清白的；王啊！在你面前我也没有作过任何错事。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神差遣使者，封住狮子的口，叫狮子不伤我；因我在神面前无辜，我在王面前也没有行过亏损的事。」
verses.textEnNiv: My God sent his angel, and he shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, because I was found innocent in his sight. Nor have I ever done any wrong before you, Your Majesty."
verses.textEnEsv: My God sent his angel and shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not harmed me, because I was found blameless before him; and also before you, O king, I have done no harm."
verses.textEnNkjv: My God sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths, so that they have not hurt me, because I was found innocent before Him; and also, O king, I have done no wrong before you."
verses.textEnNlt: My God sent his angel to shut the lions’ mouths so that they would not hurt me, for I have been found innocent in his sight. And I have not wronged you, Your Majesty."
verses.textEnNasb: My God sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not harmed me, since I was found innocent before Him; and also toward you, O king, I have committed no crime."
verses.textEn: My God sent his angel, and he shut the mouths of the lions. They have not hurt me, because I was found innocent in his sight. Nor have I ever done any wrong before you, Your Majesty."

verses.textZh: 王就非常高兴，吩咐人把但以理从坑里拉上来。于是但以理从坑里被拉上来，他身上一点损伤也没有，因为他信靠他的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王就非常高兴，吩咐人把但以理从坑里拉上来。于是但以理从坑里被拉上来，他身上一点损伤也没有，因为他信靠他的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 王就甚喜乐，吩咐人将但以理从坑里系上来。于是但以理从坑里被系上来，身上毫无伤损，因为信靠他的神。
verses.textEnNiv: The king was overjoyed and gave orders to lift Daniel out of the den. And when Daniel was lifted from the den, no wound was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king was exceedingly glad, and commanded that Daniel be taken up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now the king was exceedingly glad for him, and commanded that they should take Daniel up out of the den. So Daniel was taken up out of the den, and no injury whatever was found on him, because he believed in his God.
verses.textEnNlt: The king was overjoyed and ordered that Daniel be lifted from the den. Not a scratch was found on him, for he had trusted in his God.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king was very glad and gave orders for Daniel to be lifted up out of the den. So Daniel was lifted up out of the den, and no injury whatever was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.
verses.textEn: The king was overjoyed and gave orders to lift Daniel out of the den. And when Daniel was lifted from the den, no wound was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

verses.textZh: 王下令，人就把那些诬蔑控告但以理的人，连同他们的妻子和儿女都一起带来，扔在狮子坑中；他们还没有下到坑底，狮子就抓住他们，把他们所有的骨头都咬碎了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 王下令，人就把那些诬蔑控告但以理的人，连同他们的妻子和儿女都一起带来，扔在狮子坑中；他们还没有下到坑底，狮子就抓住他们，把他们所有的骨头都咬碎了。
verses.textZhCuv: 王下令，人就把那些控告但以理的人，连他们的妻子儿女都带来，扔在狮子坑中。他们还没有到坑底，狮子就抓住 他们，咬碎他们的骨头。
verses.textEnNiv: At the king’s command, the men who had falsely accused Daniel were brought in and thrown into the lions’ den, along with their wives and children. And before they reached the floor of the den, the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones.
verses.textEnEsv: And the king commanded, and those men who had maliciously accused Daniel were brought and cast into the den of lions—they, their children, and their wives. And before they reached the bottom of the den, the lions overpowered them and broke all their bones in pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the king gave the command, and they brought those men who had accused Daniel, and they cast them into the den of lions—them, their children, and their wives; and the lions overpowered them, and broke all their bones in pieces before they ever came to the bottom of the den.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king gave orders to arrest the men who had maliciously accused Daniel. He had them thrown into the lions’ den, along with their wives and children. The lions leaped on them and tore them apart before they even hit the floor of the den.
verses.textEnNasb: The king then gave orders, and they brought those men who had maliciously accused Daniel, and they threw them, their children, and their wives into the lions’ den; and they had not reached the bottom of the den before the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones.
verses.textEn: At the king’s command, the men who had falsely accused Daniel were brought in and thrown into the lions’ den, along with their wives and children. And before they reached the floor of the den, the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones.

verses.textZh: 后来大利乌王写信给住在全地的各国、各族和说各种语言的人，说："愿你们大享平安！
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来大利乌王写信给住在全地的各国、各族和说各种语言的人，说："愿你们大享平安！
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，大流士王传旨，晓谕住在全地各方、各国、各族的人说：「愿你们大享平安！
verses.textEnNiv: Then King Darius wrote to all the nations and peoples of every language in all the earth: "May you prosper greatly!
verses.textEnEsv: Then King Darius wrote to all the peoples, nations, and languages that dwell in all the earth: "Peace be multiplied to you.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then King Darius wrote: To all peoples, nations, and languages that dwell in all the earth: Peace be multiplied to you.
verses.textEnNlt: Then King Darius sent this message to the people of every race and nation and language throughout the world: "Peace and prosperity to you!
verses.textEnNasb: Then Darius the king wrote to all the peoples, nations, and populations of all languages who were living in all the land: "May your peace be great!
verses.textEn: Then King Darius wrote to all the nations and peoples of every language in all the earth: "May you prosper greatly!

verses.textZh: 现在我下令，我所统治的全国人民都要在但以理的神面前战兢恐惧。 "他是永活的神， 他永远长存； 他的国度永不灭亡， 他的统治直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我下令，我所统治的全国人民都要在但以理的神面前战兢恐惧。 "他是永活的神， 他永远长存； 他的国度永不灭亡， 他的统治直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我降旨晓谕我所统辖的全国人民，要在但以理的神面前，战兢恐惧。 因为他是永远长存的活神， 他的国永不败坏； 他的权柄永存无极！
verses.textEnNiv: "I issue a decree that in every part of my kingdom people must fear and reverence the God of Daniel. "For he is the living God and he endures forever; his kingdom will not be destroyed, his dominion will never end.
verses.textEnEsv: I make a decree, that in all my royal dominion people are to tremble and fear before the God of Daniel, for he is the living God, enduring forever; his kingdom shall never be destroyed, and his dominion shall be to the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: I make a decree that in every dominion of my kingdom menmust tremble and fear before the God of Daniel. For He is the living God, And steadfast forever; His kingdom istheone which shall not be destroyed, And His dominion shallendure to the end.
verses.textEnNlt: "I decree that everyone throughout my kingdom should tremble with fear before the God of Daniel. For he is the living God, and he will endure forever. His kingdom will never be destroyed, and his rule will never end.
verses.textEnNasb: I issue a decree that in all the realm of my kingdom people are to tremble and fear before the God of Daniel; For He is the living God and enduring forever, And His kingdom is one which will not be destroyed, And His dominion will be forever.
verses.textEn: "I issue a decree that in every part of my kingdom people must fear and reverence the God of Daniel. "For he is the living God and he endures forever; his kingdom will not be destroyed, his dominion will never end.

verses.textZh: 他搭救人，拯救人； 他在天上地下施行神迹奇事； 他搭救了但以理脱离狮子的爪。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他搭救人，拯救人； 他在天上地下施行神迹奇事； 他搭救了但以理脱离狮子的爪。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他护庇人，搭救人， 在天上地下施行神迹奇事， 救了但以理脱离狮子的口。」
verses.textEnNiv: He rescues and he saves; he performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth. He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions."
verses.textEnEsv: He delivers and rescues; he works signs and wonders in heaven and on earth, he who has saved Daniel from the power of the lions."
verses.textEnNkjv: He delivers and rescues, And He works signs and wonders In heaven and on earth, Who has delivered Daniel from the power of the lions.
verses.textEnNlt: He rescues and saves his people; he performs miraculous signs and wonders in the heavens and on earth. He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions."
verses.textEnNasb: "He rescues, saves, and performs signs and miracles In heaven and on earth, He who has also rescued Daniel from the power of the lions."
verses.textEn: He rescues and he saves; he performs signs and wonders in the heavens and on the earth. He has rescued Daniel from the power of the lions."

verses.textZh: 于是这但以理在大利乌作王的时候，和在波斯人古列作王的时候 ，事事亨通。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是这但以理在大利乌作王的时候，和在波斯人古列作王的时候 ，事事亨通。
verses.textZhCuv: 如此，这但以理，当大流士王在位的时候和波斯王塞鲁士在位的时候，大享亨通。
verses.textEnNiv: So Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.textEnEsv: So this Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.textEnNkjv: So this Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.textEnNlt: So Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.textEnNasb: So this Daniel enjoyed success in the reign of Darius, and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.textEn: So Daniel prospered during the reign of Darius and the reign of Cyrus the Persian.

verses.textZh: 巴比伦王伯沙撒第一年，但以理躺在床上时，他作了一个梦，脑海中出现了异象；他就把那梦记录下来，把事情的重点述说出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 巴比伦王伯沙撒第一年，但以理躺在床上时，他作了一个梦，脑海中出现了异象；他就把那梦记录下来，把事情的重点述说出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 巴比伦王伯沙撒元年，但以理在床上做梦，见了脑中的异象，就记录这梦，述说其中的大意。
verses.textEnNiv: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and visions passed through his mind as he was lying in bed. He wrote down the substance of his dream.
verses.textEnEsv: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions of his head as he lay in his bed. Then he wrote down the dream and told the sum of the matter.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head while on his bed. Then he wrote down the dream, telling the main facts.
verses.textEnNlt: Earlier, during the first year of King Belshazzar’s reign in Babylon, Daniel had a dream and saw visions as he lay in his bed. He wrote down the dream, and this is what he saw.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions in his mind as he lay on his bed; then he wrote the dream down and told the following summary of it.
verses.textEn: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream, and visions passed through his mind as he was lying in bed. He wrote down the substance of his dream.

verses.textZh: 但以理说："在夜间的异象中，我看见天的四风，搅动大海。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理说："在夜间的异象中，我看见天的四风，搅动大海。
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理说： 我夜里见异象，看见天的四风陡起，刮在大海之上。
verses.textEnNiv: Daniel said: "In my vision at night I looked, and there before me were the four winds of heaven churning up the great sea.
verses.textEnEsv: Daniel declared, "I saw in my vision by night, and behold, the four winds of heaven were stirring up the great sea.
verses.textEnNkjv: Daniel spoke, saying, "I saw in my vision by night, and behold, the four winds of heaven were stirring up the Great Sea.
verses.textEnNlt: In my vision that night, I, Daniel, saw a great storm churning the surface of a great sea, with strong winds blowing from every direction.
verses.textEnNasb: Daniel said, "I was looking in my vision by night, and behold, the four winds of heaven were stirring up the great sea.
verses.textEn: Daniel said: "In my vision at night I looked, and there before me were the four winds of heaven churning up the great sea.

verses.textZh: "有四只巨兽从海中上来，形状各不相同。
verses.textZhCnvs: "有四只巨兽从海中上来，形状各不相同。
verses.textZhCuv: 有四个大兽从海中上来，形状各有不同：
verses.textEnNiv: Four great beasts, each different from the others, came up out of the sea.
verses.textEnEsv: And four great beasts came up out of the sea, different from one another.
verses.textEnNkjv: And four great beasts came up from the sea, each different from the other.
verses.textEnNlt: Then four huge beasts came up out of the water, each different from the others.
verses.textEnNasb: And four great beasts were coming up from the sea, different from one another.
verses.textEn: Four great beasts, each different from the others, came up out of the sea.

verses.textZh: 第一只兽像狮子，却有鹰的翅膀。我一直在观看，看见牠的翅膀被拔去，牠从地上被举起来，两脚像人一样直立在地上；又有人的心给了牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 第一只兽像狮子，却有鹰的翅膀。我一直在观看，看见牠的翅膀被拔去，牠从地上被举起来，两脚像人一样直立在地上；又有人的心给了牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 头一个像狮子，有鹰的翅膀；我正观看的时候，兽的翅膀被拔去，兽从地上得立起来，用两脚站立，像人一样，又得了人心。
verses.textEnNiv: "The first was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted from the ground so that it stood on two feet like a human being, and the mind of a human was given to it.
verses.textEnEsv: The first was like a lion and had eagles’ wings. Then as I looked its wings were plucked off, and it was lifted up from the ground and made to stand on two feet like a man, and the mind of a man was given to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: The first was like a lion, and had eagle’s wings. I watched till its wings were plucked off; and it was lifted up from the earth and made to stand on two feet like a man, and a man’s heart was given to it.
verses.textEnNlt: The first beast was like a lion with eagles’ wings. As I watched, its wings were pulled off, and it was left standing with its two hind feet on the ground, like a human being. And it was given a human mind.
verses.textEnNasb: The first was like a lion but had the wings of an eagle. I kept looking until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the ground and set up on two feet like a man; a human mind also was given to it.
verses.textEn: "The first was like a lion, and it had the wings of an eagle. I watched until its wings were torn off and it was lifted from the ground so that it stood on two feet like a human being, and the mind of a human was given to it.

verses.textZh: 我又看见另一只兽，就是第二只兽；牠和熊相似，挺起一边的身躯，口中的牙齿衔着三根肋骨。有人这样对牠说：‘起来，吃多量的肉吧！’
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又看见另一只兽，就是第二只兽；牠和熊相似，挺起一边的身躯，口中的牙齿衔着三根肋骨。有人这样对牠说：‘起来，吃多量的肉吧！’
verses.textZhCuv: 又有一兽如熊，就是第二兽，旁跨而坐，口齿内衔着三根肋骨。有吩咐这兽的说：「起来吞吃多肉。」
verses.textEnNiv: "And there before me was a second beast, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, ‘Get up and eat your fill of flesh!’
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, another beast, a second one, like a bear. It was raised up on one side. It had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth; and it was told, ‘Arise, devour much flesh.’
verses.textEnNkjv: "And suddenly another beast, a second, like a bear. It was raised up on one side, and had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. And they said thus to it: ‘Arise, devour much flesh!’
verses.textEnNlt: Then I saw a second beast, and it looked like a bear. It was rearing up on one side, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. And I heard a voice saying to it, "Get up! Devour the flesh of many people!"
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, another beast, a second one, resembling a bear. And it was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth; and they said this to it: ‘Arise, devour much meat!’
verses.textEn: "And there before me was a second beast, which looked like a bear. It was raised up on one of its sides, and it had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. It was told, ‘Get up and eat your fill of flesh!’

verses.textZh: 此后，我继续观看，看见另一只兽像豹，背上有鸟的四个翅膀；这兽有四个头，又有权柄给了牠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 此后，我继续观看，看见另一只兽像豹，背上有鸟的四个翅膀；这兽有四个头，又有权柄给了牠。
verses.textZhCuv: 此后我观看，又有一兽如豹，背上有鸟的四个翅膀；这兽有四个头，又得了权柄。
verses.textEnNiv: "After that, I looked, and there before me was another beast, one that looked like a leopard. And on its back it had four wings like those of a bird. This beast had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.
verses.textEnEsv: After this I looked, and behold, another, like a leopard, with four wings of a bird on its back. And the beast had four heads, and dominion was given to it.
verses.textEnNkjv: "After this I looked, and there was another, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird. The beast also had four heads, and dominion was given to it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the third of these strange beasts appeared, and it looked like a leopard. It had four bird’s wings on its back, and it had four heads. Great authority was given to this beast.
verses.textEnNasb: After this I kept looking, and behold, another one, like a leopard, which had on its back four wings of a bird; the beast also had four heads, and dominion was given to it.
verses.textEn: "After that, I looked, and there before me was another beast, one that looked like a leopard. And on its back it had four wings like those of a bird. This beast had four heads, and it was given authority to rule.

verses.textZh: 后来，我在夜间的异象中继续观看，看见有第四只兽，非常恐怖，十分可怕，极其强壮。牠有大铁牙；牠吞吃咬碎，又把剩余的用脚践踏；这兽和前面的各兽都不相同；牠有十个角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来，我在夜间的异象中继续观看，看见有第四只兽，非常恐怖，十分可怕，极其强壮。牠有大铁牙；牠吞吃咬碎，又把剩余的用脚践踏；这兽和前面的各兽都不相同；牠有十个角。
verses.textZhCuv: 其后我在夜间的异象中观看，见第四兽甚是可怕，极其强壮，大有力量，有大铁牙，吞吃嚼碎，所剩下的用脚践踏。这兽与前三兽大不相同，头有十角。
verses.textEnNiv: "After that, in my vision at night I looked, and there before me was a fourth beast—terrifying and frightening and very powerful. It had large iron teeth; it crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left. It was different from all the former beasts, and it had ten horns.
verses.textEnEsv: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold, a fourth beast, terrifying and dreadful and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth; it devoured and broke in pieces and stamped what was left with its feet. It was different from all the beasts that were before it, and it had ten horns.
verses.textEnNkjv: "After this I saw in the night visions, and behold, a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, exceedingly strong. It had huge iron teeth; it was devouring, breaking in pieces, and trampling the residue with its feet. It was different from all the beasts that were before it, and it had ten horns.
verses.textEnNlt: Then in my vision that night, I saw a fourth beast—terrifying, dreadful, and very strong. It devoured and crushed its victims with huge iron teeth and trampled their remains beneath its feet. It was different from any of the other beasts, and it had ten horns.
verses.textEnNasb: After this I kept looking in the night visions, and behold, a fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and extremely strong; and it had large iron teeth. It devoured and crushed, and trampled down the remainder with its feet; and it was different from all the beasts that were before it, and it had ten horns.
verses.textEn: "After that, in my vision at night I looked, and there before me was a fourth beast—terrifying and frightening and very powerful. It had large iron teeth; it crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left. It was different from all the former beasts, and it had ten horns.

verses.textZh: 我正在究察这些角的时候，看见角的中间长出另一个小角来。在这小角前面，有三个先前的角连根被拔起来。这小角有眼，像人的眼，又有一张说夸大话的嘴。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我正在究察这些角的时候，看见角的中间长出另一个小角来。在这小角前面，有三个先前的角连根被拔起来。这小角有眼，像人的眼，又有一张说夸大话的嘴。
verses.textZhCuv: 我正观看这些角，见其中又长起一个小角；先前的角中有三角在这角前，连根被它拔出来。这角有眼，像人的眼，有口说夸大的话。
verses.textEnNiv: "While I was thinking about the horns, there before me was another horn, a little one, which came up among them; and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like the eyes of a human being and a mouth that spoke boastfully.
verses.textEnEsv: I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots. And behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.
verses.textEnNkjv: I was considering the horns, and there was another horn, a little one, coming up among them, before whom three of the first horns were plucked out by the roots. And there, in this horn, were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking pompous words.
verses.textEnNlt: As I was looking at the horns, suddenly another small horn appeared among them. Three of the first horns were torn out by the roots to make room for it. This little horn had eyes like human eyes and a mouth that was boasting arrogantly.
verses.textEnNasb: While I was thinking about the horns, behold, another horn, a little one, came up among them, and three of the previous horns were plucked out before it; and behold, this horn possessed eyes like human eyes, and a mouth uttering great boasts.
verses.textEn: "While I was thinking about the horns, there before me was another horn, a little one, which came up among them; and three of the first horns were uprooted before it. This horn had eyes like the eyes of a human being and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

verses.textZh: "我一直在观看， 看见有些宝座安放好了， 万古常存者就坐上去； 他的衣服洁白如雪， 他的头发纯净像羊毛。 他的宝座是火焰， 宝座的轮子是烈火。
verses.textZhCnvs: "我一直在观看， 看见有些宝座安放好了， 万古常存者就坐上去； 他的衣服洁白如雪， 他的头发纯净像羊毛。 他的宝座是火焰， 宝座的轮子是烈火。
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看， 见有宝座设立， 上头坐着亘古常在者。 他的衣服洁白如雪， 头发如纯净的羊毛。 宝座乃火焰， 其轮乃烈火。
verses.textEnNiv: "As I looked, "thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was as white as snow; the hair of his head was white like wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.
verses.textEnEsv: "As I looked, thrones were placed, and the Ancient of Days took his seat; his clothing was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool; his throne was fiery flames; its wheels were burning fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I watched till thrones were put in place, And the Ancient of Days was seated; His garment was white as snow, And the hair of His head was like pure wool. His throne was a fiery flame, Its wheels a burning fire;
verses.textEnNlt: I watched as thrones were put in place and the Ancient One sat down to judge. His clothing was as white as snow, his hair like purest wool. He sat on a fiery throne with wheels of blazing fire,
verses.textEnNasb: "I kept looking Until thrones were set up, And the Ancient of Days took His seat; His garment was white as snow, And the hair of His head like pure wool. His throne was ablaze with flames, Its wheels were a burning fire.
verses.textEn: "As I looked, "thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took his seat. His clothing was as white as snow; the hair of his head was white like wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.

verses.textZh: 有火像河涌出， 烈火从他面前冒出； 事奉他的有千千， 侍立在他面前的有万万。 审判已经开始， 案卷都展开了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 有火像河涌出， 烈火从他面前冒出； 事奉他的有千千， 侍立在他面前的有万万。 审判已经开始， 案卷都展开了。
verses.textZhCuv: 从他面前有火，像河发出； 事奉他的有千千， 在他面前侍立的有万万； 他坐着要行审判， 案卷都展开了。
verses.textEnNiv: A river of fire was flowing, coming out from before him. Thousands upon thousands attended him; ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The court was seated, and the books were opened.
verses.textEnEsv: A stream of fire issued and came out from before him; a thousand thousands served him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him; the court sat in judgment, and the books were opened.
verses.textEnNkjv: A fiery stream issued And came forth from before Him. A thousand thousands ministered to Him; Ten thousand times ten thousand stood before Him. The court was seated, And the books were opened.
verses.textEnNlt: and a river of fire was pouring out, flowing from his presence. Millions of angels ministered to him; many millions stood to attend him. Then the court began its session, and the books were opened.
verses.textEnNasb: "A river of fire was flowing And coming out from before Him; Thousands upon thousands were serving Him, And myriads upon myriads were standing before Him; The court convened, And the books were opened.
verses.textEn: A river of fire was flowing, coming out from before him. Thousands upon thousands attended him; ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him. The court was seated, and the books were opened.

verses.textZh: "那时，因那小角说夸大话的声音，我继续观看，看见那兽被杀，尸体被毁，扔在烈火中。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，因那小角说夸大话的声音，我继续观看，看见那兽被杀，尸体被毁，扔在烈火中。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我观看，见那兽因小角说夸大话的声音被杀，身体损坏，扔在火中焚烧。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then I continued to watch because of the boastful words the horn was speaking. I kept looking until the beast was slain and its body destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.
verses.textEnEsv: "I looked then because of the sound of the great words that the horn was speaking. And as I looked, the beast was killed, and its body destroyed and given over to be burned with fire.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I watched then because of the sound of the pompous words which the horn was speaking; I watched till the beast was slain, and its body destroyed and given to the burning flame.
verses.textEnNlt: I continued to watch because I could hear the little horn’s boastful speech. I kept watching until the fourth beast was killed and its body was destroyed by fire.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I kept looking because of the sound of the boastful words which the horn was speaking; I kept looking until the beast was killed, and its body was destroyed and given to the burning fire.
verses.textEn: "Then I continued to watch because of the boastful words the horn was speaking. I kept looking until the beast was slain and its body destroyed and thrown into the blazing fire.

verses.textZh: 至于其余的三兽，牠们的权柄都被夺去，牠们的生命却得着延长，直到所定的时候和日期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于其余的三兽，牠们的权柄都被夺去，牠们的生命却得着延长，直到所定的时候和日期。
verses.textZhCuv: 其余的兽，权柄都被夺去，生命却仍存留，直到所定的时候和日期。
verses.textEnNiv: (The other beasts had been stripped of their authority, but were allowed to live for a period of time.)
verses.textEnEsv: As for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away, but their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the rest of the beasts, they had their dominion taken away, yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.
verses.textEnNlt: The other three beasts had their authority taken from them, but they were allowed to live a while longer.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away, but an extension of life was granted to them for an appointed period of time.
verses.textEn: (The other beasts had been stripped of their authority, but were allowed to live for a period of time.)

verses.textZh: "我在夜间的异象中继续观看， 看见有一位像人子的， 驾着天云而来， 到万古常存者那里， 被引领到他面前，
verses.textZhCnvs: "我在夜间的异象中继续观看， 看见有一位像人子的， 驾着天云而来， 到万古常存者那里， 被引领到他面前，
verses.textZhCuv: 我在夜间的异象中观看， 见有一位像人子的， 驾着天云而来， 被领到亘古常在者面前，
verses.textEnNiv: "In my vision at night I looked, and there before me was one like a son of man, coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into his presence.
verses.textEnEsv: "I saw in the night visions, and behold, with the clouds of heaven there came one like a son of man, and he came to the Ancient of Days and was presented before him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I was watching in the night visions, And behold, One like the Son of Man, Coming with the clouds of heaven! He came to the Ancient of Days, And they brought Him near before Him.
verses.textEnNlt: As my vision continued that night, I saw someone like a son of man coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient One and was led into his presence.
verses.textEnNasb: "I kept looking in the night visions, And behold, with the clouds of heaven One like a son of man was coming, And He came up to the Ancient of Days And was presented before Him.
verses.textEn: "In my vision at night I looked, and there before me was one like a son of man, coming with the clouds of heaven. He approached the Ancient of Days and was led into his presence.

verses.textZh: 得了权柄、尊荣和国度； 各国、各族和说各种语言的人都事奉他。 他的权柄是永远的权柄，是不能废去的； 他的国度是永不毁灭的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 得了权柄、尊荣和国度； 各国、各族和说各种语言的人都事奉他。 他的权柄是永远的权柄，是不能废去的； 他的国度是永不毁灭的。
verses.textZhCuv: 得了权柄、荣耀、国度， 使各方、各国、各族的人都事奉他。 他的权柄是永远的，不能废去； 他的国必不败坏。
verses.textEnNiv: He was given authority, glory and sovereign power; all nations and peoples of every language worshiped him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and his kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: And to him was given dominion and glory and a kingdom, that all peoples, nations, and languages should serve him; his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom one that shall not be destroyed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then to Him was given dominion and glory and a kingdom, That all peoples, nations, and languages should serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion, Which shall not pass away, And His kingdom theone Which shall not be destroyed.
verses.textEnNlt: He was given authority, honor, and sovereignty over all the nations of the world, so that people of every race and nation and language would obey him. His rule is eternal—it will never end. His kingdom will never be destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: "And to Him was given dominion, Honor, and a kingdom, So that all the peoples, nations, and populations of all languages Might serve Him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion Which will not pass away; And His kingdom is one Which will not be destroyed.
verses.textEn: He was given authority, glory and sovereign power; all nations and peoples of every language worshiped him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and his kingdom is one that will never be destroyed.

verses.textZh: "至于我但以理，我的灵在我里面忧伤，我脑海中出现的异象使我惊惶。
verses.textZhCnvs: "至于我但以理，我的灵在我里面忧伤，我脑海中出现的异象使我惊惶。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于我－但以理，我的灵在我里面愁烦，我脑中的异象使我惊惶。
verses.textEnNiv: "I, Daniel, was troubled in spirit, and the visions that passed through my mind disturbed me.
verses.textEnEsv: "As for me, Daniel, my spirit within me was anxious, and the visions of my head alarmed me.
verses.textEnNkjv: "I, Daniel, was grieved in my spirit within my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.
verses.textEnNlt: I, Daniel, was troubled by all I had seen, and my visions terrified me.
verses.textEnNasb: "As for me, Daniel, my spirit was distressed within me, and the visions in my mind kept alarming me.
verses.textEn: "I, Daniel, was troubled in spirit, and the visions that passed through my mind disturbed me.

verses.textZh: 于是我走近其中一位侍立者，问他有关这一切事的实情；他就告诉我，使我知道这些事的意思，他说：
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我走近其中一位侍立者，问他有关这一切事的实情；他就告诉我，使我知道这些事的意思，他说：
verses.textZhCuv: 我就近一位侍立者，问他这一切的真情。他就告诉我，将那事的讲解给我说明：
verses.textEnNiv: I approached one of those standing there and asked him the meaning of all this. "So he told me and gave me the interpretation of these things:
verses.textEnEsv: I approached one of those who stood there and asked him the truth concerning all this. So he told me and made known to me the interpretation of the things.
verses.textEnNkjv: I came near to one of those who stood by, and asked him the truth of all this. So he told me and made known to me the interpretation of these things:
verses.textEnNlt: So I approached one of those standing beside the throne and asked him what it all meant. He explained it to me like this:
verses.textEnNasb: I approached one of those who were standing by and began requesting of him the exact meaning of all this. So he told me and made known to me the interpretation of these things:
verses.textEn: I approached one of those standing there and asked him the meaning of all this. "So he told me and gave me the interpretation of these things:

verses.textZh: ‘这四只巨兽就是将要在世上兴起的四个王。
verses.textZhCnvs: ‘这四只巨兽就是将要在世上兴起的四个王。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四个大兽就是四王将要在世上兴起。
verses.textEnNiv: ‘The four great beasts are four kings that will rise from the earth.
verses.textEnEsv: ‘These four great beasts are four kings who shall arise out of the earth.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘Those great beasts, which are four, are four kings which arise out of the earth.
verses.textEnNlt: "These four huge beasts represent four kingdoms that will arise from the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: ‘These great beasts, which are four in number, are four kings who will arise from the earth.
verses.textEn: ‘The four great beasts are four kings that will rise from the earth.

verses.textZh: 但至高者的圣民必要得国，拥有这国，直到永永远远。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 但至高者的圣民必要得国，拥有这国，直到永永远远。’
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，至高者的圣民，必要得国享受，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: But the holy people of the Most High will receive the kingdom and will possess it forever—yes, for ever and ever.’
verses.textEnEsv: But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom and possess the kingdom forever, forever and ever.’
verses.textEnNkjv: But the saints of the Most High shall receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom forever, even forever and ever.’
verses.textEnNlt: But in the end, the holy people of the Most High will be given the kingdom, and they will rule forever and ever."
verses.textEnNasb: But the saints of the Highest One will receive the kingdom and take possession of the kingdom forever, for all ages to come.’
verses.textEn: But the holy people of the Most High will receive the kingdom and will possess it forever—yes, for ever and ever.’

verses.textZh: 那时我想知道有关第四只兽的实情，牠和其他三兽不相同，十分恐怖，有铁牙铜爪；牠吞吃咬碎，又把剩余的用脚践踏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时我想知道有关第四只兽的实情，牠和其他三兽不相同，十分恐怖，有铁牙铜爪；牠吞吃咬碎，又把剩余的用脚践踏。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时我愿知道第四兽的真情，它为何与那三兽的真情大不相同，甚是可怕，有铁牙铜爪，吞吃嚼碎，所剩下的用脚践踏；
verses.textEnNiv: "Then I wanted to know the meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others and most terrifying, with its iron teeth and bronze claws—the beast that crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then I desired to know the truth about the fourth beast, which was different from all the rest, exceedingly terrifying, with its teeth of iron and claws of bronze, and which devoured and broke in pieces and stamped what was left with its feet,
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then I wished to know the truth about the fourth beast, which was different from all the others, exceedingly dreadful, with its teeth of iron and its nails of bronze, which devoured, broke in pieces, and trampled the residue with its feet;
verses.textEnNlt: Then I wanted to know the true meaning of the fourth beast, the one so different from the others and so terrifying. It had devoured and crushed its victims with iron teeth and bronze claws, trampling their remains beneath its feet.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then I desired to know the exact meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others, exceedingly dreadful, with its teeth of iron and its claws of bronze, and which devoured, crushed, and trampled down the remainder with its feet,
verses.textEn: "Then I wanted to know the meaning of the fourth beast, which was different from all the others and most terrifying, with its iron teeth and bronze claws—the beast that crushed and devoured its victims and trampled underfoot whatever was left.

verses.textZh: 我又想知道有关牠头上的十角，和那另长出来的小角，以及那三个在这小角前面倒下的角的实情。这小角有眼，有说夸大话的嘴；牠的形状比牠的同类更威猛。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又想知道有关牠头上的十角，和那另长出来的小角，以及那三个在这小角前面倒下的角的实情。这小角有眼，有说夸大话的嘴；牠的形状比牠的同类更威猛。
verses.textZhCuv: 头有十角和那另长的一角，在这角前有三角被它打落。这角有眼，有说夸大话的口，形状强横，过于它的同类。
verses.textEnNiv: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and about the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell—the horn that looked more imposing than the others and that had eyes and a mouth that spoke boastfully.
verses.textEnEsv: and about the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn that came up and before which three of them fell, the horn that had eyes and a mouth that spoke great things, and that seemed greater than its companions.
verses.textEnNkjv: and the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, before which three fell, namely, that horn which had eyes and a mouth which spoke pompous words, whose appearance was greater than his fellows.
verses.textEnNlt: I also asked about the ten horns on the fourth beast’s head and the little horn that came up afterward and destroyed three of the other horns. This horn had seemed greater than the others, and it had human eyes and a mouth that was boasting arrogantly.
verses.textEnNasb: and the meaning of the ten horns that were on its head, and the other horn which came up, and before which three of the horns fell, namely, that horn which had eyes and a mouth uttering great boasts, and which was larger in appearance than its associates.
verses.textEn: I also wanted to know about the ten horns on its head and about the other horn that came up, before which three of them fell—the horn that looked more imposing than the others and that had eyes and a mouth that spoke boastfully.

verses.textZh: 我继续观看，看见这小角和圣民争战，战胜了他们，
verses.textZhCnvs: 我继续观看，看见这小角和圣民争战，战胜了他们，
verses.textZhCuv: 我观看，见这角与圣民争战，胜了他们。
verses.textEnNiv: As I watched, this horn was waging war against the holy people and defeating them,
verses.textEnEsv: As I looked, this horn made war with the saints and prevailed over them,
verses.textEnNkjv: "I was watching; and the same horn was making war against the saints, and prevailing against them,
verses.textEnNlt: As I watched, this horn was waging war against God’s holy people and was defeating them,
verses.textEnNasb: I kept looking, and that horn was waging war with the saints and prevailing against them,
verses.textEn: As I watched, this horn was waging war against the holy people and defeating them,

verses.textZh: 直到万古常存者来到，为至高者的圣民伸张正义；圣民拥有国度的时候就到了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 直到万古常存者来到，为至高者的圣民伸张正义；圣民拥有国度的时候就到了。
verses.textZhCuv: 直到亘古常在者来给至高者的圣民伸冤，圣民得国的时候就到了。
verses.textEnNiv: until the Ancient of Days came and pronounced judgment in favor of the holy people of the Most High, and the time came when they possessed the kingdom.
verses.textEnEsv: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given for the saints of the Most High, and the time came when the saints possessed the kingdom.
verses.textEnNkjv: until the Ancient of Days came, and a judgment was made infavor of the saints of the Most High, and the time came for the saints to possess the kingdom.
verses.textEnNlt: until the Ancient One—the Most High—came and judged in favor of his holy people. Then the time arrived for the holy people to take over the kingdom.
verses.textEnNasb: until the Ancient of Days came and judgment was passed in favor of the saints of the Highest One, and the time arrived when the saints took possession of the kingdom.
verses.textEn: until the Ancient of Days came and pronounced judgment in favor of the holy people of the Most High, and the time came when they possessed the kingdom.

verses.textZh: "那位侍立者这样说：‘那第四只兽就是世上必有的第四国，和其他各国都不相同；牠必吞吃全地，践踏咬碎全地。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那位侍立者这样说：‘那第四只兽就是世上必有的第四国，和其他各国都不相同；牠必吞吃全地，践踏咬碎全地。
verses.textZhCuv: 那侍立者这样说： 第四兽就是世上必有的第四国， 与一切国大不相同， 必吞吃全地， 并且践踏嚼碎。
verses.textEnNiv: "He gave me this explanation: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on earth. It will be different from all the other kingdoms and will devour the whole earth, trampling it down and crushing it.
verses.textEnEsv: "Thus he said: ‘As for the fourth beast, there shall be a fourth kingdom on earth, which shall be different from all the kingdoms, and it shall devour the whole earth, and trample it down, and break it to pieces.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Thus he said: ‘The fourth beast shall be A fourth kingdom on earth, Which shall be different from all other kingdoms, And shall devour the whole earth, Trample it and break it in pieces.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said to me, "This fourth beast is the fourth world power that will rule the earth. It will be different from all the others. It will devour the whole world, trampling and crushing everything in its path.
verses.textEnNasb: "This is what he said: ‘The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom on the earth which will be different from all the other kingdoms, and will devour the whole earth and trample it down and crush it.
verses.textEn: "He gave me this explanation: ‘The fourth beast is a fourth kingdom that will appear on earth. It will be different from all the other kingdoms and will devour the whole earth, trampling it down and crushing it.

verses.textZh: 至于那十角，就是从这国中将要兴起的十个王，在他们以后，必有另一个王兴起，和先前的王都不相同；他必制伏三个王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那十角，就是从这国中将要兴起的十个王，在他们以后，必有另一个王兴起，和先前的王都不相同；他必制伏三个王。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那十角，就是从这国中必兴起的十王， 后来又兴起一王， 与先前的不同； 他必制伏三王。
verses.textEnNiv: The ten horns are ten kings who will come from this kingdom. After them another king will arise, different from the earlier ones; he will subdue three kings.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the ten horns, out of this kingdom ten kings shall arise, and another shall arise after them; he shall be different from the former ones, and shall put down three kings.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ten horns are ten kings Who shall arise from this kingdom. And another shall rise after them; He shall be different from the first ones, And shall subdue three kings.
verses.textEnNlt: Its ten horns are ten kings who will rule that empire. Then another king will arise, different from the other ten, who will subdue three of them.
verses.textEnNasb: As for the ten horns, out of this kingdom ten kings will arise; and another will arise after them, and he will be different from the previous ones and will humble three kings.
verses.textEn: The ten horns are ten kings who will come from this kingdom. After them another king will arise, different from the earlier ones; he will subdue three kings.

verses.textZh: 他必说话，敌挡至高者；他必折磨至高者的圣民，又想改变节期和律法；圣民必交在他的手中，一载、二载、半载 。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必说话，敌挡至高者；他必折磨至高者的圣民，又想改变节期和律法；圣民必交在他的手中，一载、二载、半载 。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必向至高者说夸大的话， 必折磨至高者的圣民， 必想改变节期和律法。 圣民必交付他手一载、二载、半载。
verses.textEnNiv: He will speak against the Most High and oppress his holy people and try to change the set times and the laws. The holy people will be delivered into his hands for a time, times and half a time.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the saints of the Most High, and shall think to change the times and the law; and they shall be given into his hand for a time, times, and half a time.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall speak pompous words against the Most High, Shall persecute the saints of the Most High, And shall intend to change times and law. Then thesaints shall be given into his hand For a time and times and half a time.
verses.textEnNlt: He will defy the Most High and oppress the holy people of the Most High. He will try to change their sacred festivals and laws, and they will be placed under his control for a time, times, and half a time.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will speak against the Most High and wear down the saints of the Highest One, and he will intend to make alterations in times and in law; and they will be handed over to him for a time, times, and half a time.
verses.textEn: He will speak against the Most High and oppress his holy people and try to change the set times and the laws. The holy people will be delivered into his hands for a time, times and half a time.

verses.textZh: 但审判要开始，他的权柄必被夺去，他必被毁坏灭绝，直到永远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但审判要开始，他的权柄必被夺去，他必被毁坏灭绝，直到永远。
verses.textZhCuv: 然而，审判者必坐着行审判； 他的权柄必被夺去， 毁坏，灭绝，一直到底。
verses.textEnNiv: " ‘But the court will sit, and his power will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.
verses.textEnEsv: But the court shall sit in judgment, and his dominion shall be taken away, to be consumed and destroyed to the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: ‘But the court shall be seated, And they shall take away his dominion, To consume and destroy it forever.
verses.textEnNlt: "But then the court will pass judgment, and all his power will be taken away and completely destroyed.
verses.textEnNasb: But the court will convene for judgment, and his dominion will be taken away, annihilated and destroyed forever.
verses.textEn: " ‘But the court will sit, and his power will be taken away and completely destroyed forever.

verses.textZh: 那时，国度、权柄，和普天之下万国的大权，都必赐给至高者的圣民。他的国是永远的国；所有掌权的都必事奉他，顺从他。’
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，国度、权柄，和普天之下万国的大权，都必赐给至高者的圣民。他的国是永远的国；所有掌权的都必事奉他，顺从他。’
verses.textZhCuv: 国度、权柄，和天下诸国的大权 必赐给至高者的圣民。 他的国是永远的； 一切掌权的都必事奉他，顺从他。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the sovereignty, power and greatness of all the kingdoms under heaven will be handed over to the holy people of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will worship and obey him.’
verses.textEnEsv: And the kingdom and the dominion and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven shall be given to the people of the saints of the Most High; his kingdom shall be an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him.’
verses.textEnNkjv: Then the kingdom and dominion, And the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven, Shall be given to the people, the saints of the Most High. His kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, And all dominions shall serve and obey Him.’
verses.textEnNlt: Then the sovereignty, power, and greatness of all the kingdoms under heaven will be given to the holy people of the Most High. His kingdom will last forever, and all rulers will serve and obey him."
verses.textEnNasb: Then the sovereignty, the dominion, and the greatness of all the kingdoms under the whole heaven will be given to the people of the saints of the Highest One; His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all the empires will serve and obey Him.’
verses.textEn: Then the sovereignty, power and greatness of all the kingdoms under heaven will be handed over to the holy people of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all rulers will worship and obey him.’

verses.textZh: 这事到此完毕。我但以理心中十分惊惶，脸色也变了，但我把这事存放在心里。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 这事到此完毕。我但以理心中十分惊惶，脸色也变了，但我把这事存放在心里。"
verses.textZhCuv: 那事至此完毕。至于我－但以理，心中甚是惊惶，脸色也改变了，却将那事存记在心。
verses.textEnNiv: "This is the end of the matter. I, Daniel, was deeply troubled by my thoughts, and my face turned pale, but I kept the matter to myself."
verses.textEnEsv: "Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts greatly alarmed me, and my color changed, but I kept the matter in my heart."
verses.textEnNkjv: "This is the end of the account. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts greatly troubled me, and my countenance changed; but I kept the matter in my heart."
verses.textEnNlt: That was the end of the vision. I, Daniel, was terrified by my thoughts and my face was pale with fear, but I kept these things to myself.
verses.textEnNasb: " At this point the revelation ended. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts were greatly alarming me and my face became pale, but I kept the matter to myself."
verses.textEn: "This is the end of the matter. I, Daniel, was deeply troubled by my thoughts, and my face turned pale, but I kept the matter to myself."

verses.textZh: 伯沙撒王在位第三年，在先前显给我的异象之后，再有一个异象向我但以理显现。
verses.textZhCnvs: 伯沙撒王在位第三年，在先前显给我的异象之后，再有一个异象向我但以理显现。
verses.textZhCuv: 伯沙撒王在位第三年，有异象现与我－但以理，是在先前所见的异象之后。
verses.textEnNiv: In the third year of King Belshazzar’s reign, I, Daniel, had a vision, after the one that had already appeared to me.
verses.textEnEsv: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar a vision appeared to me, Daniel, after that which appeared to me at the first.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the third year of the reign of King Belshazzar a vision appeared to me—to me, Daniel—after the one that appeared to me the first time.
verses.textEnNlt: During the third year of King Belshazzar’s reign, I, Daniel, saw another vision, following the one that had already appeared to me.
verses.textEnNasb: In the third year of the reign of Belshazzar the king, a vision appeared to me, Daniel, subsequent to the one which appeared to me previously.
verses.textEn: In the third year of King Belshazzar’s reign, I, Daniel, had a vision, after the one that had already appeared to me.

verses.textZh: 我在异象中观看，看见自己在以拦省书珊城堡里；我在异象中继续观看，看见自己在乌莱河的岸边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我在异象中观看，看见自己在以拦省书珊城堡里；我在异象中继续观看，看见自己在乌莱河的岸边。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见了异象的时候，我以为在以拦省书珊城 中；我见异象又如在乌莱河边。
verses.textEnNiv: In my vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa in the province of Elam; in the vision I was beside the Ulai Canal.
verses.textEnEsv: And I saw in the vision; and when I saw, I was in Susa the citadel, which is in the province of Elam. And I saw in the vision, and I was at the Ulai canal.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw in the vision, and it so happened while I was looking, that I was in Shushan, the citadel, which is in the province of Elam; and I saw in the vision that I was by the River Ulai.
verses.textEnNlt: In this vision I was at the fortress of Susa, in the province of Elam, standing beside the Ulai River.
verses.textEnNasb: I looked in the vision, and while I was looking, I was in the citadel of Susa, which is in the province of Elam; and I looked in the vision, and I myself was beside the Ulai Canal.
verses.textEn: In my vision I saw myself in the citadel of Susa in the province of Elam; in the vision I was beside the Ulai Canal.

verses.textZh: 我举目观看，看见一只公绵羊，站在河边；牠有两个角，两角都很高，但高低不一；那较高的角是较迟长出来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我举目观看，看见一只公绵羊，站在河边；牠有两个角，两角都很高，但高低不一；那较高的角是较迟长出来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我举目观看，见有双角的公绵羊站在河边，两角都高。这角高过那角，更高的是后长的。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked up, and there before me was a ram with two horns, standing beside the canal, and the horns were long. One of the horns was longer than the other but grew up later.
verses.textEnEsv: I raised my eyes and saw, and behold, a ram standing on the bank of the canal. It had two horns, and both horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher one came up last.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I lifted my eyes and saw, and there, standing beside the river, was a ram which had two horns, and the two horns were high; but one was higher than the other, and the higher one came up last.
verses.textEnNlt: As I looked up, I saw a ram with two long horns standing beside the river. One of the horns was longer than the other, even though it had grown later than the other one.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I raised my eyes and looked, and behold, a ram which had two horns was standing in front of the canal. Now the two horns were long, but one was longer than the other, with the longer one coming up last.
verses.textEn: I looked up, and there before me was a ram with two horns, standing beside the canal, and the horns were long. One of the horns was longer than the other but grew up later.

verses.textZh: 我看见那公绵羊向西、向北、向南撞去，没有走兽能在牠面前站立得住，也没有能拯救脱离牠手的；牠任意而行，狂妄自大。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见那公绵羊向西、向北、向南撞去，没有走兽能在牠面前站立得住，也没有能拯救脱离牠手的；牠任意而行，狂妄自大。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见那公绵羊往西、往北、往南抵触。兽在它面前都站立不住，也没有能救护脱离它手的；但它任意而行，自高自大。
verses.textEnNiv: I watched the ram as it charged toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against it, and none could rescue from its power. It did as it pleased and became great.
verses.textEnEsv: I saw the ram charging westward and northward and southward. No beast could stand before him, and there was no one who could rescue from his power. He did as he pleased and became great.
verses.textEnNkjv: I saw the ram pushing westward, northward, and southward, so that no animal could withstand him; nor wasthereany that could deliver from his hand, but he did according to his will and became great.
verses.textEnNlt: The ram butted everything out of his way to the west, to the north, and to the south, and no one could stand against him or help his victims. He did as he pleased and became very great.
verses.textEnNasb: I saw the ram butting westward, northward, and southward, and no other beasts could stand against him nor was there anyone to rescue from his power, but he did as he pleased and made himself great.
verses.textEn: I watched the ram as it charged toward the west and the north and the south. No animal could stand against it, and none could rescue from its power. It did as it pleased and became great.

verses.textZh: 我正在思考的时候，忽然有一只公山羊从西而来，走遍全地，快得脚不沾尘；这山羊两眼之间有一个显眼的角。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我正在思考的时候，忽然有一只公山羊从西而来，走遍全地，快得脚不沾尘；这山羊两眼之间有一个显眼的角。
verses.textZhCuv: 我正思想的时候，见有一只公山羊从西而来，遍行全地，脚不沾尘。这山羊两眼当中有一非常的角。
verses.textEnNiv: As I was thinking about this, suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between its eyes came from the west, crossing the whole earth without touching the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: As I was considering, behold, a male goat came from the west across the face of the whole earth, without touching the ground. And the goat had a conspicuous horn between his eyes.
verses.textEnNkjv: And as I was considering, suddenly a male goat came from the west, across the surface of the whole earth, without touching the ground; and the goat had a notable horn between his eyes.
verses.textEnNlt: While I was watching, suddenly a male goat appeared from the west, crossing the land so swiftly that he didn’t even touch the ground. This goat, which had one very large horn between its eyes,
verses.textEnNasb: While I was observing, behold, a male goat was coming from the west over the surface of the entire earth without touching the ground; and the goat had a prominent horn between his eyes.
verses.textEn: As I was thinking about this, suddenly a goat with a prominent horn between its eyes came from the west, crossing the whole earth without touching the ground.

verses.textZh: 牠走到我先前所看见站在河边、那有两个角的公绵羊那里去，忿怒地向公绵羊猛力冲去。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠走到我先前所看见站在河边、那有两个角的公绵羊那里去，忿怒地向公绵羊猛力冲去。
verses.textZhCuv: 它往我所看见、站在河边有双角的公绵羊那里去，大发忿怒，向它直闯。
verses.textEnNiv: It came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and charged at it in great rage.
verses.textEnEsv: He came to the ram with the two horns, which I had seen standing on the bank of the canal, and he ran at him in his powerful wrath.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he came to the ram that had two horns, which I had seen standing beside the river, and ran at him with furious power.
verses.textEnNlt: headed toward the two-horned ram that I had seen standing beside the river, rushing at him in a rage.
verses.textEnNasb: He came up to the ram that had the two horns, which I had seen standing in front of the canal, and rushed at him in his mighty wrath.
verses.textEn: It came toward the two-horned ram I had seen standing beside the canal and charged at it in great rage.

verses.textZh: 我看见公山羊走近公绵羊，向牠发怒，撞击牠，折断牠的两个角；公绵羊在牠面前站立不住，牠把公绵羊撞倒在地上，又用脚践踏牠，没有能拯救公绵羊脱离牠手的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我看见公山羊走近公绵羊，向牠发怒，撞击牠，折断牠的两个角；公绵羊在牠面前站立不住，牠把公绵羊撞倒在地上，又用脚践踏牠，没有能拯救公绵羊脱离牠手的。
verses.textZhCuv: 我见公山羊就近公绵羊，向它发烈怒，抵触它，折断它的两角。绵羊在它面前站立不住；它将绵羊触倒在地，用脚践踏，没有能救绵羊脱离它手的。
verses.textEnNiv: I saw it attack the ram furiously, striking the ram and shattering its two horns. The ram was powerless to stand against it; the goat knocked it to the ground and trampled on it, and none could rescue the ram from its power.
verses.textEnEsv: I saw him come close to the ram, and he was enraged against him and struck the ram and broke his two horns. And the ram had no power to stand before him, but he cast him down to the ground and trampled on him. And there was no one who could rescue the ram from his power.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I saw him confronting the ram; he was moved with rage against him, attacked the ram, and broke his two horns. There was no power in the ram to withstand him, but he cast him down to the ground and trampled him; and there was no one that could deliver the ram from his hand.
verses.textEnNlt: The goat charged furiously at the ram and struck him, breaking off both his horns. Now the ram was helpless, and the goat knocked him down and trampled him. No one could rescue the ram from the goat’s power.
verses.textEnNasb: And I saw him come up beside the ram, and he was enraged at him; and he struck the ram and smashed his two horns, and the ram had no strength to withstand him. So he hurled him to the ground and trampled on him, and there was no one to rescue the ram from his power.
verses.textEn: I saw it attack the ram furiously, striking the ram and shattering its two horns. The ram was powerless to stand against it; the goat knocked it to the ground and trampled on it, and none could rescue the ram from its power.

verses.textZh: 这公山羊非常狂妄自大；但在牠强盛的时候，那大角被折断了；在大角原来的地方，有四个显眼的角向天的四方长出来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这公山羊非常狂妄自大；但在牠强盛的时候，那大角被折断了；在大角原来的地方，有四个显眼的角向天的四方长出来。
verses.textZhCuv: 这山羊极其自高自大，正强盛的时候，那大角折断了，又在角根上向天的四方 长出四个非常的角来。
verses.textEnNiv: The goat became very great, but at the height of its power the large horn was broken off, and in its place four prominent horns grew up toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the goat became exceedingly great, but when he was strong, the great horn was broken, and instead of it there came up four conspicuous horns toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the male goat grew very great; but when he became strong, the large horn was broken, and in place of it four notable ones came up toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.textEnNlt: The goat became very powerful. But at the height of his power, his large horn was broken off. In the large horn’s place grew four prominent horns pointing in the four directions of the earth.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the male goat made himself exceedingly great. But once he became powerful, the large horn was broken; and in its place four prominent horns came up toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.textEn: The goat became very great, but at the height of its power the large horn was broken off, and in its place four prominent horns grew up toward the four winds of heaven.

verses.textZh: 从这四个角中的一个角，又长出一个小角来，这小角向南、向东和向荣美之地，不断强大起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从这四个角中的一个角，又长出一个小角来，这小角向南、向东和向荣美之地，不断强大起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 四角之中有一角长出一个小角，向南、向东、向荣美之地，渐渐成为强大。
verses.textEnNiv: Out of one of them came another horn, which started small but grew in power to the south and to the east and toward the Beautiful Land.
verses.textEnEsv: Out of one of them came a little horn, which grew exceedingly great toward the south, toward the east, and toward the glorious land.
verses.textEnNkjv: And out of one of them came a little horn which grew exceedingly great toward the south, toward the east, and toward the Glorious Land.
verses.textEnNlt: Then from one of the prominent horns came a small horn whose power grew very great. It extended toward the south and the east and toward the glorious land of Israel.
verses.textEnNasb: And out of one of them came a rather small horn which grew exceedingly great toward the south, toward the east, and toward the Beautiful Land.
verses.textEn: Out of one of them came another horn, which started small but grew in power to the south and to the east and toward the Beautiful Land.

verses.textZh: 牠渐渐长大，高及天象，把一些天象和星星摔落在地上，用脚践踏。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠渐渐长大，高及天象，把一些天象和星星摔落在地上，用脚践踏。
verses.textZhCuv: 它渐渐强大，高及天象，将些天象和星宿抛落在地，用脚践踏。
verses.textEnNiv: It grew until it reached the host of the heavens, and it threw some of the starry host down to the earth and trampled on them.
verses.textEnEsv: It grew great, even to the host of heaven. And some of the host and some of the stars it threw down to the ground and trampled on them.
verses.textEnNkjv: And it grew up to the host of heaven; and it cast down some of the host and some of the stars to the ground, and trampled them.
verses.textEnNlt: Its power reached to the heavens, where it attacked the heavenly army, throwing some of the heavenly beings and some of the stars to the ground and trampling them.
verses.textEnNasb: It grew up to the heavenly lights, and some of the lights, that is, some of the stars it threw down to the earth, and it trampled them.
verses.textEn: It grew until it reached the host of the heavens, and it threw some of the starry host down to the earth and trampled on them.

verses.textZh: 牠狂妄自大，要高及天象之君；牠除掉献给天象之君的常献祭，又拆毁他的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 牠狂妄自大，要高及天象之君；牠除掉献给天象之君的常献祭，又拆毁他的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 并且它自高自大，以为高及天象之君；除掉常献给君的燔祭，毁坏君的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: It set itself up to be as great as the commander of the army of the Lord ; it took away the daily sacrifice from the Lord , and his sanctuary was thrown down.
verses.textEnEsv: It became great, even as great as the Prince of the host. And the regular burnt offering was taken away from him, and the place of his sanctuary was overthrown.
verses.textEnNkjv: He even exalted himself as high as the Prince of the host; and by him the daily sacrifices were taken away, and the place of His sanctuary was cast down.
verses.textEnNlt: It even challenged the Commander of heaven’s army by canceling the daily sacrifices offered to him and by destroying his Temple.
verses.textEnNasb: It even exalted itself to be equal with the Commander of the army; and it removed the regular sacrifice from Him, and the place of His sanctuary was overthrown.
verses.textEn: It set itself up to be as great as the commander of the army of the Lord ; it took away the daily sacrifice from the Lord , and his sanctuary was thrown down.

verses.textZh: 因罪过的缘故，圣民 连同常献的祭都交给牠；牠把真理丢在地上，任意而行，凡事顺利。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因罪过的缘故，圣民 连同常献的祭都交给牠；牠把真理丢在地上，任意而行，凡事顺利。
verses.textZhCuv: 因罪过的缘故，有军旅和常献的燔祭交付它。它将真理抛在地上，任意而行，无不顺利。
verses.textEnNiv: Because of rebellion, the Lord ’s people and the daily sacrifice were given over to it. It prospered in everything it did, and truth was thrown to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: And a host will be given over to it together with the regular burnt offering because of transgression, and it will throw truth to the ground, and it will act and prosper.
verses.textEnNkjv: Because of transgression, an army was given over tothehorn to oppose the daily sacrifices; and he cast truth down to the ground. He did allthis and prospered.
verses.textEnNlt: The army of heaven was restrained from responding to this rebellion. So the daily sacrifice was halted, and truth was overthrown. The horn succeeded in everything it did.
verses.textEnNasb: And because of an offense the army will be given to the horn along with the regular sacrifice; and it will hurl truth to the ground and do as it pleases and be successful.
verses.textEn: Because of rebellion, the Lord ’s people and the daily sacrifice were given over to it. It prospered in everything it did, and truth was thrown to the ground.

verses.textZh: 我听见一位圣者在说话，又有一位圣者问他："这个关于除掉常献的祭，和引致毁坏的罪过，以及践踏圣所和圣民 的异象，要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见一位圣者在说话，又有一位圣者问他："这个关于除掉常献的祭，和引致毁坏的罪过，以及践踏圣所和圣民 的异象，要到几时呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见有一位圣者说话，又有一位圣者问那说话的圣者说：「这除掉常献的燔祭和施行毁坏的罪过，将圣所与军旅 践踏的异象，要到几时才应验呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, "How long will it take for the vision to be fulfilled—the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, the surrender of the sanctuary and the trampling underfoot of the Lord ’s people?"
verses.textEnEsv: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to the one who spoke, "For how long is the vision concerning the regular burnt offering, the transgression that makes desolate, and the giving over of the sanctuary and host to be trampled underfoot?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I heard a holy one speaking; and another holy one said to that certain one who was speaking, "How long will the vision be, concerning the daily sacrifices and the transgression of desolation, the giving of both the sanctuary and the host to be trampled underfoot?"
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard two holy ones talking to each other. One of them asked, "How long will the events of this vision last? How long will the rebellion that causes desecration stop the daily sacrifices? How long will the Temple and heaven’s army be trampled on?"
verses.textEnNasb: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to that particular one who was speaking, "How long will the vision about the regular sacrifice apply, while the offense causes horror, so as to allow both the sanctuary and the army to be trampled?"
verses.textEn: Then I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to him, "How long will it take for the vision to be fulfilled—the vision concerning the daily sacrifice, the rebellion that causes desolation, the surrender of the sanctuary and the trampling underfoot of the Lord ’s people?"

verses.textZh: 他对我说："要到二千三百个晚上和早晨，圣所才得洁净。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："要到二千三百个晚上和早晨，圣所才得洁净。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「到二千三百日，圣所就必洁净。」
verses.textEnNiv: He said to me, "It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be reconsecrated."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "For 2,300 evenings and mornings. Then the sanctuary shall be restored to its rightful state."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "For two thousand three hundred days; then the sanctuary shall be cleansed."
verses.textEnNlt: The other replied, "It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the Temple will be made right again."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "For 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be properly restored."
verses.textEn: He said to me, "It will take 2,300 evenings and mornings; then the sanctuary will be reconsecrated."

verses.textZh: 我但以理看见了这异象以后，就想明白它的意义；忽然有一位外貌像人的，站在我面前。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我但以理看见了这异象以后，就想明白它的意义；忽然有一位外貌像人的，站在我面前。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－但以理见了这异象，愿意明白其中的意思。忽有一位形状像人的站在我面前。
verses.textEnNiv: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there before me stood one who looked like a man.
verses.textEnEsv: When I, Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it. And behold, there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then it happened, when I, Daniel, had seen the vision and was seeking the meaning, that suddenly there stood before me one having the appearance of a man.
verses.textEnNlt: As I, Daniel, was trying to understand the meaning of this vision, someone who looked like a man stood in front of me.
verses.textEnNasb: When I, Daniel, had seen the vision, I sought to understand it; and behold, standing before me was one who looked like a man.
verses.textEn: While I, Daniel, was watching the vision and trying to understand it, there before me stood one who looked like a man.

verses.textZh: 我又听见从乌莱河两岸之间，有人的声音呼叫着说："加百列啊！你要使这人明白这异象。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我又听见从乌莱河两岸之间，有人的声音呼叫着说："加百列啊！你要使这人明白这异象。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我又听见乌莱河两岸中有人声呼叫说：「加百列啊，要使此人明白这异象。」
verses.textEnNiv: And I heard a man’s voice from the Ulai calling, "Gabriel, tell this man the meaning of the vision."
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard a man’s voice between the banks of the Ulai, and it called, "Gabriel, make this man understand the vision."
verses.textEnNkjv: And I heard a man’s voice between thebanksof the Ulai, who called, and said, "Gabriel, make this man understand the vision."
verses.textEnNlt: And I heard a human voice calling out from the Ulai River, "Gabriel, tell this man the meaning of his vision."
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard the voice of a man between the banks of Ulai, and he called out and said, "Gabriel, explain the vision to this man."
verses.textEn: And I heard a man’s voice from the Ulai calling, "Gabriel, tell this man the meaning of the vision."

verses.textZh: 他就来到我所站的地方；他来到的时候，我就害怕，脸伏在地；他对我说："人子啊，你要明白！这异象是关于末后的时期的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他就来到我所站的地方；他来到的时候，我就害怕，脸伏在地；他对我说："人子啊，你要明白！这异象是关于末后的时期的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他便来到我所站的地方。他一来，我就惊慌俯伏在地；他对我说：「人子啊，你要明白，因为这是关乎末后的异象。」
verses.textEnNiv: As he came near the place where I was standing, I was terrified and fell prostrate. "Son of man," he said to me, "understand that the vision concerns the time of the end."
verses.textEnEsv: So he came near where I stood. And when he came, I was frightened and fell on my face. But he said to me, "Understand, O son of man, that the vision is for the time of the end."
verses.textEnNkjv: So he came near where I stood, and when he came I was afraid and fell on my face; but he said to me, "Understand, son of man, that the vision refers to the time of the end."
verses.textEnNlt: As Gabriel approached the place where I was standing, I became so terrified that I fell with my face to the ground. "Son of man," he said, "you must understand that the events you have seen in your vision relate to the time of the end."
verses.textEnNasb: So he came near to where I was standing, and when he came I was frightened and fell on my face; and he said to me, "Son of man, understand that the vision pertains to the time of the end."
verses.textEn: As he came near the place where I was standing, I was terrified and fell prostrate. "Son of man," he said to me, "understand that the vision concerns the time of the end."

verses.textZh: 他和我说话的时候，我沉睡了，脸伏在地；他触摸我，使我站起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他和我说话的时候，我沉睡了，脸伏在地；他触摸我，使我站起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他与我说话的时候，我面伏在地沉睡；他就摸我，扶我站起来，
verses.textEnNiv: While he was speaking to me, I was in a deep sleep, with my face to the ground. Then he touched me and raised me to my feet.
verses.textEnEsv: And when he had spoken to me, I fell into a deep sleep with my face to the ground. But he touched me and made me stand up.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now, as he was speaking with me, I was in a deep sleep with my face to the ground; but he touched me, and stood me upright.
verses.textEnNlt: While he was speaking, I fainted and lay there with my face to the ground. But Gabriel roused me with a touch and helped me to my feet.
verses.textEnNasb: Now while he was talking with me, I was dazed with my face to the ground; but he touched me and made me stand at my place.
verses.textEn: While he was speaking to me, I was in a deep sleep, with my face to the ground. Then he touched me and raised me to my feet.

verses.textZh: 他说："看哪！我要告诉你在神忿怒审判的后期必要发生的事，因为这是有关那末后的定期的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："看哪！我要告诉你在神忿怒审判的后期必要发生的事，因为这是有关那末后的定期的。
verses.textZhCuv: 说：「我要指示你恼怒临完必有的事，因为这是关乎末后的定期。
verses.textEnNiv: He said: "I am going to tell you what will happen later in the time of wrath, because the vision concerns the appointed time of the end.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Behold, I will make known to you what shall be at the latter end of the indignation, for it refers to the appointed time of the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Look, I am making known to you what shall happen in the latter time of the indignation; for at the appointed time the end shallbe.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "I am here to tell you what will happen later in the time of wrath. What you have seen pertains to the very end of time.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Behold, I am going to inform you of what will occur at the final period of the indignation, because it pertains to the appointed time of the end.
verses.textEn: He said: "I am going to tell you what will happen later in the time of wrath, because the vision concerns the appointed time of the end.

verses.textZh: 你所看见那有两个角的公绵羊，就是玛代和波斯王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你所看见那有两个角的公绵羊，就是玛代和波斯王。
verses.textZhCuv: 你所看见双角的公绵羊，就是米底亚和波斯王。
verses.textEnNiv: The two-horned ram that you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the ram that you saw with the two horns, these are the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.textEnNkjv: The ram which you saw, having the two horns—theyare the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.textEnNlt: The two-horned ram represents the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.textEnNasb: The ram which you saw with the two horns represents the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.textEn: The two-horned ram that you saw represents the kings of Media and Persia.

verses.textZh: 那多毛的公山羊就是希腊王；那两眼之间的大角就是第一个王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那多毛的公山羊就是希腊王；那两眼之间的大角就是第一个王。
verses.textZhCuv: 那公山羊就是希腊王 ；两眼当中的大角就是头一王。
verses.textEnNiv: The shaggy goat is the king of Greece, and the large horn between its eyes is the first king.
verses.textEnEsv: And the goat is the king of Greece. And the great horn between his eyes is the first king.
verses.textEnNkjv: And the male goat is the kingdom of Greece. The large horn that is between its eyes is the first king.
verses.textEnNlt: The shaggy male goat represents the king of Greece, and the large horn between his eyes represents the first king of the Greek Empire.
verses.textEnNasb: The shaggy goat represents the kingdom of Greece, and the large horn that is between his eyes is the first king.
verses.textEn: The shaggy goat is the king of Greece, and the large horn between its eyes is the first king.

verses.textZh: 至于代替那折断了的角，在牠原来的地方长出来的四个角，就是四个要从他的国中兴起的王国，只是没有他的权势。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于代替那折断了的角，在牠原来的地方长出来的四个角，就是四个要从他的国中兴起的王国，只是没有他的权势。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于那折断了的角，在其根上又长出四角，这四角就是四国，必从这国里兴起来，只是权势都不及他。
verses.textEnNiv: The four horns that replaced the one that was broken off represent four kingdoms that will emerge from his nation but will not have the same power.
verses.textEnEsv: As for the horn that was broken, in place of which four others arose, four kingdoms shall arise from his nation, but not with his power.
verses.textEnNkjv: As for the broken horn and the four that stood up in its place, four kingdoms shall arise out of that nation, but not with its power.
verses.textEnNlt: The four prominent horns that replaced the one large horn show that the Greek Empire will break into four kingdoms, but none as great as the first.
verses.textEnNasb: The broken horn and the four horns that came up in its place represent four kingdoms which will arise from his nation, although not with his power.
verses.textEn: The four horns that replaced the one that was broken off represent four kingdoms that will emerge from his nation but will not have the same power.

verses.textZh: "在这四国的后期， 犯罪的人恶贯满盈的时候， 必有一个面貌凶恶的王兴起， 他诡计多端。
verses.textZhCnvs: "在这四国的后期， 犯罪的人恶贯满盈的时候， 必有一个面貌凶恶的王兴起， 他诡计多端。
verses.textZhCuv: 这四国末时，犯法的人罪恶满盈，必有一王兴起，面貌凶恶，能用双关的诈语。
verses.textEnNiv: "In the latter part of their reign, when rebels have become completely wicked, a fierce-looking king, a master of intrigue, will arise.
verses.textEnEsv: And at the latter end of their kingdom, when the transgressors have reached their limit, a king of bold face, one who understands riddles, shall arise.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And in the latter time of their kingdom, When the transgressors have reached their fullness, A king shall arise, Having fierce features, Who understands sinister schemes.
verses.textEnNlt: "At the end of their rule, when their sin is at its height, a fierce king, a master of intrigue, will rise to power.
verses.textEnNasb: "And in the latter period of their dominion, When the wrongdoers have run their course, A king will arise, Insolent and skilled in intrigue.
verses.textEn: "In the latter part of their reign, when rebels have become completely wicked, a fierce-looking king, a master of intrigue, will arise.

verses.textZh: 他的权势强大，却不是出于自己的能力； 他必造成惊人的毁灭； 他任意而行，凡事顺利； 他必毁灭有强力的， 又毁灭圣民。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的权势强大，却不是出于自己的能力； 他必造成惊人的毁灭； 他任意而行，凡事顺利； 他必毁灭有强力的， 又毁灭圣民。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的权柄必大，却不是因自己的能力；他必行非常的毁灭，事情顺利，任意而行；又必毁灭有能力的和圣民。
verses.textEnNiv: He will become very strong, but not by his own power. He will cause astounding devastation and will succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy those who are mighty, the holy people.
verses.textEnEsv: His power shall be great— but not by his own power; and he shall cause fearful destruction and shall succeed in what he does, and destroy mighty men and the people who are the saints.
verses.textEnNkjv: His power shall be mighty, but not by his own power; He shall destroy fearfully, And shall prosper and thrive; He shall destroy the mighty, and also the holy people.
verses.textEnNlt: He will become very strong, but not by his own power. He will cause a shocking amount of destruction and succeed in everything he does. He will destroy powerful leaders and devastate the holy people.
verses.textEnNasb: "And his power will be mighty, but not by his own power, And he will destroy to an extraordinary degree And be successful and do as he pleases; He will destroy mighty men and the holy people.
verses.textEn: He will become very strong, but not by his own power. He will cause astounding devastation and will succeed in whatever he does. He will destroy those who are mighty, the holy people.

verses.textZh: 他运用诡计， 行骗无往而不利； 他心里狂妄自大； 他必乘人不备的时候，毁灭许多人； 他要起来攻击万君之君， 最后却非因人的手被毁灭。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他运用诡计， 行骗无往而不利； 他心里狂妄自大； 他必乘人不备的时候，毁灭许多人； 他要起来攻击万君之君， 最后却非因人的手被毁灭。
verses.textZhCuv: 他用权术成就手中的诡计，心里自高自大，在人坦然无备的时候，毁灭多人；又要站起来攻击万君之君，至终却非因人手而灭亡。
verses.textEnNiv: He will cause deceit to prosper, and he will consider himself superior. When they feel secure, he will destroy many and take his stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be destroyed, but not by human power.
verses.textEnEsv: By his cunning he shall make deceit prosper under his hand, and in his own mind he shall become great. Without warning he shall destroy many. And he shall even rise up against the Prince of princes, and he shall be broken—but by no human hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Through his cunning He shall cause deceit to prosper under his rule; And he shall exalt himself in his heart. He shall destroy many in their prosperity. He shall even rise against the Prince of princes; But he shall be broken without human means.
verses.textEnNlt: He will be a master of deception and will become arrogant; he will destroy many without warning. He will even take on the Prince of princes in battle, but he will be broken, though not by human power.
verses.textEnNasb: "And through his shrewdness He will make deceit a success by his influence; And he will make himself great in his own mind, And he will destroy many while they are at ease. He will even oppose the Prince of princes, But he will be broken without human agency.
verses.textEn: He will cause deceit to prosper, and he will consider himself superior. When they feel secure, he will destroy many and take his stand against the Prince of princes. Yet he will be destroyed, but not by human power.

verses.textZh: 关于所说二千三百个晚上和早晨的异象是真的， 但你要把这异象封住， 因为那是关于将来许多的年日的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 关于所说二千三百个晚上和早晨的异象是真的， 但你要把这异象封住， 因为那是关于将来许多的年日的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 所说二千三百日的异象是真的，但你要将这异象封住，因为关乎后来许多的日子。」
verses.textEnNiv: "The vision of the evenings and mornings that has been given you is true, but seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future."
verses.textEnEsv: The vision of the evenings and the mornings that has been told is true, but seal up the vision, for it refers to many days from now."
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the vision of the evenings and mornings Which was told is true; Therefore seal up the vision, For itrefers to many days inthefuture."
verses.textEnNlt: "This vision about the 2,300 evenings and mornings is true. But none of these things will happen for a long time, so keep this vision a secret."
verses.textEnNasb: "And the vision of the evenings and mornings Which has been told is true; But as for you, keep the vision secret, Because it pertains to many days in the future."
