verses.textEn: "The vision of the evenings and mornings that has been given you is true, but seal up the vision, for it concerns the distant future."

verses.textZh: 我但以理精疲力竭，病了几天，后来我起来，办理王的事务，但我仍因这异象惊骇不已，不明白它的意思。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我但以理精疲力竭，病了几天，后来我起来，办理王的事务，但我仍因这异象惊骇不已，不明白它的意思。
verses.textZhCuv: 于是我－但以理昏迷不醒，病了数日，然后起来办理王的事务。我因这异象惊奇，却无人能明白其中的意思。
verses.textEnNiv: I, Daniel, was worn out. I lay exhausted for several days. Then I got up and went about the king’s business. I was appalled by the vision; it was beyond understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: And I, Daniel, was overcome and lay sick for some days. Then I rose and went about the king’s business, but I was appalled by the vision and did not understand it.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, Daniel, fainted and was sick for days; afterward I arose and went about the king’s business. I was astonished by the vision, but no one understood it.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I, Daniel, was overcome and lay sick for several days. Afterward I got up and performed my duties for the king, but I was greatly troubled by the vision and could not understand it.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I, Daniel, was exhausted and sick for days. Then I got up and carried on the king’s business; but I was astounded at the vision, and there was no one to explain it.
verses.textEn: I, Daniel, was worn out. I lay exhausted for several days. Then I got up and went about the king’s business. I was appalled by the vision; it was beyond understanding.

verses.textZh: 玛代人亚哈随鲁的儿子大利乌被立为王，统治迦勒底国的第一年，
verses.textZhCnvs: 玛代人亚哈随鲁的儿子大利乌被立为王，统治迦勒底国的第一年，
verses.textZhCuv: 米底亚族亚哈随鲁的儿子大流士立为迦勒底国的王元年，
verses.textEnNiv: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes (a Mede by descent), who was made ruler over the Babylonian kingdom—
verses.textEnEsv: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, by descent a Mede, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—
verses.textEnNkjv: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of the lineage of the Medes, who was made king over the realm of the Chaldeans—
verses.textEnNlt: It was the first year of the reign of Darius the Mede, the son of Ahasuerus, who became king of the Babylonians.
verses.textEnNasb: In the first year of Darius the son of Ahasuerus, of Median descent, who was made king over the kingdom of the Chaldeans—
verses.textEn: In the first year of Darius son of Xerxes (a Mede by descent), who was made ruler over the Babylonian kingdom—

verses.textZh: 就是他作王的第一年，我但以理从经书上留意到耶和华临到耶利米先知的话，指出耶路撒冷荒废的年数必满七十年。
verses.textZhCnvs: 就是他作王的第一年，我但以理从经书上留意到耶和华临到耶利米先知的话，指出耶路撒冷荒废的年数必满七十年。
verses.textZhCuv: 就是他在位第一年，我－但以理从书上得知耶和华的话临到先知耶利米，论耶路撒冷荒凉的年数，七十年为满。
verses.textEnNiv: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the Scriptures, according to the word of the Lord given to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.
verses.textEnEsv: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, perceived in the books the number of years that, according to the word of the Lord to Jeremiah the prophet, must pass before the end of the desolations of Jerusalem, namely, seventy years.
verses.textEnNkjv: in the first year of his reign I, Daniel, understood by the books the number of the years specified by the word of the Lord through Jeremiah the prophet, that He would accomplish seventy years in the desolations of Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: During the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, learned from reading the word of the Lord , as revealed to Jeremiah the prophet, that Jerusalem must lie desolate for seventy years.
verses.textEnNasb: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, observed in the books the number of the years which was revealed as the word of the Lord to Jeremiah the prophet for the completion of the desolations of Jerusalem, namely, seventy years.
verses.textEn: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the Scriptures, according to the word of the Lord given to Jeremiah the prophet, that the desolation of Jerusalem would last seventy years.

verses.textZh: 于是我转向主神，禁食，披麻蒙灰，藉祈祷和恳求寻求他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是我转向主神，禁食，披麻蒙灰，藉祈祷和恳求寻求他。
verses.textZhCuv: 我便禁食，披麻蒙灰，定意向主神祈祷恳求。
verses.textEnNiv: So I turned to the Lord God and pleaded with him in prayer and petition, in fasting, and in sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I turned my face to the Lord God, seeking him by prayer and pleas for mercy with fasting and sackcloth and ashes.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I set my face toward the Lord God to make request by prayer and supplications, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
verses.textEnNlt: So I turned to the Lord God and pleaded with him in prayer and fasting. I also wore rough burlap and sprinkled myself with ashes.
verses.textEnNasb: So I gave my attention to the Lord God, to seek Him by prayer and pleading, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
verses.textEn: So I turned to the Lord God and pleaded with him in prayer and petition, in fasting, and in sackcloth and ashes.

verses.textZh: 我向耶和华我的神祷告、认罪，说："主啊！伟大可畏的神，你向那些爱你 ，遵守你 诫命的人守约施慈爱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我向耶和华我的神祷告、认罪，说："主啊！伟大可畏的神，你向那些爱你 ，遵守你 诫命的人守约施慈爱。
verses.textZhCuv: 我向耶和华－我的神祈祷、认罪，说：「主啊，大而可畏的神，向爱主、守主诫命的人守约施慈爱。
verses.textEnNiv: I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed: "Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,
verses.textEnEsv: I prayed to the Lord my God and made confession, saying, "O Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps covenant and steadfast love with those who love him and keep his commandments,
verses.textEnNkjv: And I prayed to the Lord my God, and made confession, and said, "O Lord, great and awesome God, who keeps His covenant and mercy with those who love Him, and with those who keep His commandments,
verses.textEnNlt: I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed: "O Lord, you are a great and awesome God! You always fulfill your covenant and keep your promises of unfailing love to those who love you and obey your commands.
verses.textEnNasb: I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed, and said, "Oh, Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps His covenant and faithfulness for those who love Him and keep His commandments,
verses.textEn: I prayed to the Lord my God and confessed: "Lord, the great and awesome God, who keeps his covenant of love with those who love him and keep his commandments,

verses.textZh: 我们犯了罪，行了不义，作了恶，背叛了你，偏离了你的诫命典章；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们犯了罪，行了不义，作了恶，背叛了你，偏离了你的诫命典章；
verses.textZhCuv: 我们犯罪作孽，行恶叛逆，偏离你的诫命典章，
verses.textEnNiv: we have sinned and done wrong. We have been wicked and have rebelled; we have turned away from your commands and laws.
verses.textEnEsv: we have sinned and done wrong and acted wickedly and rebelled, turning aside from your commandments and rules.
verses.textEnNkjv: we have sinned and committed iniquity, we have done wickedly and rebelled, even by departing from Your precepts and Your judgments.
verses.textEnNlt: But we have sinned and done wrong. We have rebelled against you and scorned your commands and regulations.
verses.textEnNasb: we have sinned, we have done wrong, and acted wickedly and rebelled, even turning aside from Your commandments and ordinances.
verses.textEn: we have sinned and done wrong. We have been wicked and have rebelled; we have turned away from your commands and laws.

verses.textZh: 没有听从你的仆人众先知，他们奉你的名向我们的君王、领袖、列祖和国中所有的人民说话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 没有听从你的仆人众先知，他们奉你的名向我们的君王、领袖、列祖和国中所有的人民说话。
verses.textZhCuv: 没有听从你仆人众先知奉你名向我们君王、首领、列祖，和国中一切百姓所说的话。
verses.textEnNiv: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes and our ancestors, and to all the people of the land.
verses.textEnEsv: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, and to all the people of the land.
verses.textEnNkjv: Neither have we heeded Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings and our princes, to our fathers and all the people of the land.
verses.textEnNlt: We have refused to listen to your servants the prophets, who spoke on your authority to our kings and princes and ancestors and to all the people of the land.
verses.textEnNasb: Moreover, we have not listened to Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings, our leaders, our fathers, and all the people of the land.
verses.textEn: We have not listened to your servants the prophets, who spoke in your name to our kings, our princes and our ancestors, and to all the people of the land.

verses.textZh: 主啊！你是公义的；我们满面羞愧，正如今日的光景；我们犹大人、耶路撒冷的居民，和被你赶逐到远近各地的以色列众人，都因对你不忠而满面羞愧。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！你是公义的；我们满面羞愧，正如今日的光景；我们犹大人、耶路撒冷的居民，和被你赶逐到远近各地的以色列众人，都因对你不忠而满面羞愧。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，你是公义的，我们是脸上蒙羞的；因我们犹大人和耶路撒冷的居民，并以色列众人，或在近处，或在远处，被你赶到各国的人，都得罪了你，正如今日一样。
verses.textEnNiv: "Lord, you are righteous, but this day we are covered with shame—the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and all Israel, both near and far, in all the countries where you have scattered us because of our unfaithfulness to you.
verses.textEnEsv: To you, O Lord, belongs righteousness, but to us open shame, as at this day, to the men of Judah, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to all Israel, those who are near and those who are far away, in all the lands to which you have driven them, because of the treachery that they have committed against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, righteousness belongs to You, but to us shame of face, as itis this day—to the men of Judah, to the inhabitants of Jerusalem and all Israel, those near and those far off in all the countries to which You have driven them, because of the unfaithfulness which they have committed against You.
verses.textEnNlt: "Lord, you are in the right; but as you see, our faces are covered with shame. This is true of all of us, including the people of Judah and Jerusalem and all Israel, scattered near and far, wherever you have driven us because of our disloyalty to you.
verses.textEnNasb: "Righteousness belongs to You, Lord, but to us open shame, as it is this day—to the men of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and all Israel, those who are nearby and those who are far away in all the countries to which You have driven them, because of their unfaithful deeds which they have committed against You.
verses.textEn: "Lord, you are righteous, but this day we are covered with shame—the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem and all Israel, both near and far, in all the countries where you have scattered us because of our unfaithfulness to you.

verses.textZh: 耶和华啊！我们和我们的君王、领袖、列祖，都满面羞愧，因为我们得罪了你。
verses.textZhCnvs: 耶和华啊！我们和我们的君王、领袖、列祖，都满面羞愧，因为我们得罪了你。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，我们和我们的君王、首领、列祖因得罪了你，就都脸上蒙羞。
verses.textEnNiv: We and our kings, our princes and our ancestors are covered with shame, Lord , because we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnEsv: To us, O Lord , belongs open shame, to our kings, to our princes, and to our fathers, because we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Lord, to us belongs shame of face, to our kings, our princes, and our fathers, because we have sinned against You.
verses.textEnNlt: O Lord , we and our kings, princes, and ancestors are covered with shame because we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnNasb: Open shame belongs to us, Lord, to our kings, our leaders, and our fathers, because we have sinned against You.
verses.textEn: We and our kings, our princes and our ancestors are covered with shame, Lord , because we have sinned against you.

verses.textZh: 虽然我们背叛了主我们的神，他仍是满有怜悯和饶恕。
verses.textZhCnvs: 虽然我们背叛了主我们的神，他仍是满有怜悯和饶恕。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－我们的神是怜悯饶恕人的，我们却违背了他，
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him;
verses.textEnEsv: To the Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against him
verses.textEnNkjv: To the Lord our God belong mercy and forgiveness, though we have rebelled against Him.
verses.textEnNlt: But the Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him.
verses.textEnNasb: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, because we have rebelled against Him;
verses.textEn: The Lord our God is merciful and forgiving, even though we have rebelled against him;

verses.textZh: 我们没有听从耶和华我们神的话，没有遵行他借着他的仆人众先知向我们颁布的律法。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我们没有听从耶和华我们神的话，没有遵行他借着他的仆人众先知向我们颁布的律法。
verses.textZhCuv: 也没有听从耶和华－我们神的话，没有遵行他藉仆人众先知向我们所陈明的律法。
verses.textEnNiv: we have not obeyed the Lord our God or kept the laws he gave us through his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnEsv: and have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God by walking in his laws, which he set before us by his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNkjv: We have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in His laws, which He set before us by His servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNlt: We have not obeyed the Lord our God, for we have not followed the instructions he gave us through his servants the prophets.
verses.textEnNasb: and we have not obeyed the voice of the Lord our God, to walk in His teachings which He set before us through His servants the prophets.
verses.textEn: we have not obeyed the Lord our God or kept the laws he gave us through his servants the prophets.

verses.textZh: 以色列众人都违背了你的律法，偏离了你，不听从你的话，因此，神的仆人摩西的律法书上所记载的咒诅和誓言，都倾倒在我们身上；我们实在得罪了神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 以色列众人都违背了你的律法，偏离了你，不听从你的话，因此，神的仆人摩西的律法书上所记载的咒诅和誓言，都倾倒在我们身上；我们实在得罪了神。
verses.textZhCuv: 以色列众人都犯了你的律法，偏行，不听从你的话；因此，在你仆人摩西律法上所写的咒诅和誓言都倾在我们身上，因我们得罪了神。
verses.textEnNiv: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned away, refusing to obey you. "Therefore the curses and sworn judgments written in the Law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against you.
verses.textEnEsv: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned aside, refusing to obey your voice. And the curse and oath that are written in the Law of Moses the servant of God have been poured out upon us, because we have sinned against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, all Israel has transgressed Your law, and has departed so as not to obey Your voice; therefore the curse and the oath written in the Law of Moses the servant of God have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against Him.
verses.textEnNlt: All Israel has disobeyed your instruction and turned away, refusing to listen to your voice. "So now the solemn curses and judgments written in the Law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured down on us because of our sin.
verses.textEnNasb: Indeed, all Israel has violated Your Law and turned aside, not obeying Your voice; so the curse has gushed forth on us, along with the oath which is written in the Law of Moses the servant of God, because we have sinned against Him.
verses.textEn: All Israel has transgressed your law and turned away, refusing to obey you. "Therefore the curses and sworn judgments written in the Law of Moses, the servant of God, have been poured out on us, because we have sinned against you.

verses.textZh: 他实现了他的预言，按着他向我们和那些治理我们的官长所说过的话，使大灾祸临到我们身上；耶路撒冷所遇的灾祸是在普天之下从未发生过的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他实现了他的预言，按着他向我们和那些治理我们的官长所说过的话，使大灾祸临到我们身上；耶路撒冷所遇的灾祸是在普天之下从未发生过的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他使大灾祸临到我们，成就了警戒我们和审判我们官长的话；原来在普天之下未曾行过像在耶路撒冷所行的。
verses.textEnNiv: You have fulfilled the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing on us great disaster. Under the whole heaven nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnEsv: He has confirmed his words, which he spoke against us and against our rulers who ruled us, by bringing upon us a great calamity. For under the whole heaven there has not been done anything like what has been done against Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNkjv: And He has confirmed His words, which He spoke against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing upon us a great disaster; for under the whole heaven such has never been done as what has been done to Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNlt: You have kept your word and done to us and our rulers exactly as you warned. Never has there been such a disaster as happened in Jerusalem.
verses.textEnNasb: So He has confirmed His words which He had spoken against us and against our rulers who ruled us, to bring on us great disaster; for under the entire heaven there has not been done anything like what was done in Jerusalem.
verses.textEn: You have fulfilled the words spoken against us and against our rulers by bringing on us great disaster. Under the whole heaven nothing has ever been done like what has been done to Jerusalem.

verses.textZh: 这一切灾祸是按着摩西的律法书上所记载的，临到了我们身上，但我们仍没有恳求耶和华我们的神施恩，使我们离开罪孽，明白你的真理。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这一切灾祸是按着摩西的律法书上所记载的，临到了我们身上，但我们仍没有恳求耶和华我们的神施恩，使我们离开罪孽，明白你的真理。
verses.textZhCuv: 这一切灾祸临到我们身上是照摩西律法上所写的，我们却没有求耶和华－我们神的恩典，使我们回头离开罪孽，明白你的真理。
verses.textEnNiv: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come on us, yet we have not sought the favor of the Lord our God by turning from our sins and giving attention to your truth.
verses.textEnEsv: As it is written in the Law of Moses, all this calamity has come upon us; yet we have not entreated the favor of the Lord our God, turning from our iniquities and gaining insight by your truth.
verses.textEnNkjv: "As itis written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come upon us; yet we have not made our prayer before the Lord our God, that we might turn from our iniquities and understand Your truth.
verses.textEnNlt: Every curse written against us in the Law of Moses has come true. Yet we have refused to seek mercy from the Lord our God by turning from our sins and recognizing his truth.
verses.textEnNasb: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come on us; yet we have not sought the favor of the Lord our God by turning from our wrongdoing and giving attention to Your truth.
verses.textEn: Just as it is written in the Law of Moses, all this disaster has come on us, yet we have not sought the favor of the Lord our God by turning from our sins and giving attention to your truth.

verses.textZh: 所以耶和华留意使这灾祸临到我们身上，因为耶和华我们的神在他所行的一切事上都是公义的，我们却没有听从他的话。
verses.textZhCnvs: 所以耶和华留意使这灾祸临到我们身上，因为耶和华我们的神在他所行的一切事上都是公义的，我们却没有听从他的话。
verses.textZhCuv: 所以耶和华留意使这灾祸临到我们身上，因为耶和华－我们的神在他所行的事上都是公义；我们并没有听从他的话。
verses.textEnNiv: The Lord did not hesitate to bring the disaster on us, for the Lord our God is righteous in everything he does; yet we have not obeyed him.
verses.textEnEsv: Therefore the Lord has kept ready the calamity and has brought it upon us, for the Lord our God is righteous in all the works that he has done, and we have not obeyed his voice.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore the Lord has kept the disaster in mind, and brought it upon us; for the Lord our God is righteous in all the works which He does, though we have not obeyed His voice.
verses.textEnNlt: Therefore, the Lord has brought upon us the disaster he prepared. The Lord our God was right to do all of these things, for we did not obey him.
verses.textEnNasb: So the Lord has kept the disaster in store and brought it on us; for the Lord our God is righteous with respect to all His deeds which He has done, but we have not obeyed His voice.
verses.textEn: The Lord did not hesitate to bring the disaster on us, for the Lord our God is righteous in everything he does; yet we have not obeyed him.

verses.textZh: 主我们的神啊！你曾用强而有力的手把你的子民从埃及地领出来，使你自己得了名，好象今天一样。现在，我们犯了罪，作了恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主我们的神啊！你曾用强而有力的手把你的子民从埃及地领出来，使你自己得了名，好象今天一样。现在，我们犯了罪，作了恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 主－我们的神啊，你曾用大能的手领你的子民出埃及地，使自己得了名，正如今日一样。我们犯了罪，作了恶。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, Lord our God, who brought your people out of Egypt with a mighty hand and who made for yourself a name that endures to this day, we have sinned, we have done wrong.
verses.textEnEsv: And now, O Lord our God, who brought your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and have made a name for yourself, as at this day, we have sinned, we have done wickedly.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now, O Lord our God, who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand, and made Yourself a name, as itis this day—we have sinned, we have done wickedly!
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord our God, you brought lasting honor to your name by rescuing your people from Egypt in a great display of power. But we have sinned and are full of wickedness.
verses.textEnNasb: "And now, Lord, our God, You who brought Your people out of the land of Egypt with a mighty hand and made a name for Yourself, as it is this day—we have sinned, we have been wicked.
verses.textEn: "Now, Lord our God, who brought your people out of Egypt with a mighty hand and who made for yourself a name that endures to this day, we have sinned, we have done wrong.

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你按着你的一切公义，使你的怒气和忿怒转离你的城耶路撒冷，就是你的圣山；因我们的罪和我们列祖的罪孽的缘故，耶路撒冷和你的子民成了在我们四围的人羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你按着你的一切公义，使你的怒气和忿怒转离你的城耶路撒冷，就是你的圣山；因我们的罪和我们列祖的罪孽的缘故，耶路撒冷和你的子民成了在我们四围的人羞辱的对象。
verses.textZhCuv: 主啊，求你按你的大仁大义，使你的怒气和忿怒转离你的城耶路撒冷，就是你的圣山。耶路撒冷和你的子民，因我们的罪恶和我们列祖的罪孽被四围的人羞辱。
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, in keeping with all your righteous acts, turn away your anger and your wrath from Jerusalem, your city, your holy hill. Our sins and the iniquities of our ancestors have made Jerusalem and your people an object of scorn to all those around us.
verses.textEnEsv: "O Lord, according to all your righteous acts, let your anger and your wrath turn away from your city Jerusalem, your holy hill, because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and your people have become a byword among all who are around us.
verses.textEnNkjv: "O Lord, according to all Your righteousness, I pray, let Your anger and Your fury be turned away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; because for our sins, and for the iniquities of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people are a reproach to all those around us.
verses.textEnNlt: In view of all your faithful mercies, Lord, please turn your furious anger away from your city Jerusalem, your holy mountain. All the neighboring nations mock Jerusalem and your people because of our sins and the sins of our ancestors.
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, in accordance with all Your righteous acts, let now Your anger and Your wrath turn away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain; for because of our sins and the wrongdoings of our fathers, Jerusalem and Your people have become an object of taunting to all those around us.
verses.textEn: Lord, in keeping with all your righteous acts, turn away your anger and your wrath from Jerusalem, your city, your holy hill. Our sins and the iniquities of our ancestors have made Jerusalem and your people an object of scorn to all those around us.

verses.textZh: 现在，我们的神啊！求你垂听你仆人的祷告和恳求；主啊！为了你自己的缘故，使你的脸光照你这荒凉了的圣所。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在，我们的神啊！求你垂听你仆人的祷告和恳求；主啊！为了你自己的缘故，使你的脸光照你这荒凉了的圣所。
verses.textZhCuv: 我们的神啊，现在求你垂听仆人的祈祷恳求，为自己使脸光照你荒凉的圣所。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of your servant. For your sake, Lord, look with favor on your desolate sanctuary.
verses.textEnEsv: Now therefore, O our God, listen to the prayer of your servant and to his pleas for mercy, and for your own sake, O Lord, make your face to shine upon your sanctuary, which is desolate.
verses.textEnNkjv: Now therefore, our God, hear the prayer of Your servant, and his supplications, and for the Lord’s sake cause Your face to shine on Your sanctuary, which is desolate.
verses.textEnNlt: "O our God, hear your servant’s prayer! Listen as I plead. For your own sake, Lord, smile again on your desolate sanctuary.
verses.textEnNasb: So now, our God, listen to the prayer of Your servant and to his pleas, and for Your sake, Lord, let Your face shine on Your desolate sanctuary.
verses.textEn: "Now, our God, hear the prayers and petitions of your servant. For your sake, Lord, look with favor on your desolate sanctuary.

verses.textZh: 我的神啊！求你侧耳而听，睁眼垂顾我们的荒凉，和那称为你名下的城；因为我们向你恳求，并不是因着自己的义，而是因着你的大怜悯。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我的神啊！求你侧耳而听，睁眼垂顾我们的荒凉，和那称为你名下的城；因为我们向你恳求，并不是因着自己的义，而是因着你的大怜悯。
verses.textZhCuv: 我的神啊，求你侧耳而听，睁眼而看，眷顾我们荒凉之地和称为你名下的城。我们在你面前恳求，原不是因自己的义，乃因你的大怜悯。
verses.textEnNiv: Give ear, our God, and hear; open your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears your Name. We do not make requests of you because we are righteous, but because of your great mercy.
verses.textEnEsv: O my God, incline your ear and hear. Open your eyes and see our desolations, and the city that is called by your name. For we do not present our pleas before you because of our righteousness, but because of your great mercy.
verses.textEnNkjv: O my God, incline Your ear and hear; open Your eyes and see our desolations, and the city which is called by Your name; for we do not present our supplications before You because of our righteous deeds, but because of Your great mercies.
verses.textEnNlt: "O my God, lean down and listen to me. Open your eyes and see our despair. See how your city—the city that bears your name—lies in ruins. We make this plea, not because we deserve help, but because of your mercy.
verses.textEnNasb: My God, incline Your ear and hear! Open Your eyes and see our desolations and the city which is called by Your name; for we are not presenting our pleas before You based on any merits of our own, but based on Your great compassion.
verses.textEn: Give ear, our God, and hear; open your eyes and see the desolation of the city that bears your Name. We do not make requests of you because we are righteous, but because of your great mercy.

verses.textZh: 主啊！求你垂听。主啊！求你赦免。主啊！求你应允而行。我的神啊！为了你自己的缘故，求你不要耽延。因为你的城和你的子民都是称为你名下的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 主啊！求你垂听。主啊！求你赦免。主啊！求你应允而行。我的神啊！为了你自己的缘故，求你不要耽延。因为你的城和你的子民都是称为你名下的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 求主垂听，求主赦免，求主应允而行，为你自己不要迟延。我的神啊，因这城和这民都是称为你名下的。」
verses.textEnNiv: Lord, listen! Lord, forgive! Lord, hear and act! For your sake, my God, do not delay, because your city and your people bear your Name."
verses.textEnEsv: O Lord, hear; O Lord, forgive. O Lord, pay attention and act. Delay not, for your own sake, O my God, because your city and your people are called by your name."
verses.textEnNkjv: O Lord, hear! O Lord, forgive! O Lord, listen and act! Do not delay for Your own sake, my God, for Your city and Your people are called by Your name."
verses.textEnNlt: "O Lord, hear. O Lord, forgive. O Lord, listen and act! For your own sake, do not delay, O my God, for your people and your city bear your name."
verses.textEnNasb: Lord, hear! Lord, forgive! Lord, listen and take action! For Your own sake, my God, do not delay, because Your city and Your people are called by Your name."
verses.textEn: Lord, listen! Lord, forgive! Lord, hear and act! For your sake, my God, do not delay, because your city and your people bear your Name."

verses.textZh: 我还在说话、祷告、承认我的罪和我同胞以色列人的罪，为我神的圣山，向耶和华我的神恳求的时候；
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还在说话、祷告、承认我的罪和我同胞以色列人的罪，为我神的圣山，向耶和华我的神恳求的时候；
verses.textZhCuv: 我说话，祷告，承认我的罪和本国之民以色列的罪，为我神的圣山，在耶和华－我神面前恳求。
verses.textEnNiv: While I was speaking and praying, confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel and making my request to the Lord my God for his holy hill—
verses.textEnEsv: While I was speaking and praying, confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my plea before the Lord my God for the holy hill of my God,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now while I was speaking, praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my supplication before the Lord my God for the holy mountain of my God,
verses.textEnNlt: I went on praying and confessing my sin and the sin of my people, pleading with the Lord my God for Jerusalem, his holy mountain.
verses.textEnNasb: While I was still speaking and praying, and confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and presenting my plea before the Lord my God in behalf of the holy mountain of my God,
verses.textEn: While I was speaking and praying, confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel and making my request to the Lord my God for his holy hill—

verses.textZh: 我还在祷告说话的时候，我先前在异象中所见的那位样貌像人的加百列，约在献晚祭的时候，快速地飞 到我面前来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我还在祷告说话的时候，我先前在异象中所见的那位样貌像人的加百列，约在献晚祭的时候，快速地飞 到我面前来。
verses.textZhCuv: 我正祷告的时候，先前在异象中所见的那位加百列，奉命迅速飞来，约在献晚祭的时候，按手在我身上。
verses.textEnNiv: while I was still in prayer, Gabriel, the man I had seen in the earlier vision, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnEsv: while I was speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the first, came to me in swift flight at the time of the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnNkjv: yes, while I was speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at the beginning, being caused to fly swiftly, reached me about the time of the evening offering.
verses.textEnNlt: As I was praying, Gabriel, whom I had seen in the earlier vision, came swiftly to me at the time of the evening sacrifice.
verses.textEnNasb: while I was still speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision previously, came to me in my extreme weariness about the time of the evening offering.
verses.textEn: while I was still in prayer, Gabriel, the man I had seen in the earlier vision, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening sacrifice.

verses.textZh: 他向我解释，说："但以理啊！现在我来，要使你有智慧，有聪明。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他向我解释，说："但以理啊！现在我来，要使你有智慧，有聪明。
verses.textZhCuv: 他指教我说：「但以理啊，现在我出来要使你有智慧，有聪明。
verses.textEnNiv: He instructed me and said to me, "Daniel, I have now come to give you insight and understanding.
verses.textEnEsv: He made me understand, speaking with me and saying, "O Daniel, I have now come out to give you insight and understanding.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he informed me, and talked with me, and said, "O Daniel, I have now come forth to give you skill to understand.
verses.textEnNlt: He explained to me, "Daniel, I have come here to give you insight and understanding.
verses.textEnNasb: And he instructed me and talked with me and said, "Daniel, I have come now to give you insight with understanding.
verses.textEn: He instructed me and said to me, "Daniel, I have now come to give you insight and understanding.

verses.textZh: 你开始恳求的时候，就有命令发出。因为你是大蒙眷爱的，所以我来告诉你；你要留意这信息，明白这异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你开始恳求的时候，就有命令发出。因为你是大蒙眷爱的，所以我来告诉你；你要留意这信息，明白这异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 你初恳求的时候，就发出命令，我来告诉你，因你大蒙眷爱；所以你要思想明白这以下的事和异象。
verses.textEnNiv: As soon as you began to pray, a word went out, which I have come to tell you, for you are highly esteemed. Therefore, consider the word and understand the vision:
verses.textEnEsv: At the beginning of your pleas for mercy a word went out, and I have come to tell it to you, for you are greatly loved. Therefore consider the word and understand the vision.
verses.textEnNkjv: At the beginning of your supplications the command went out, and I have come to tell you, for you are greatly beloved; therefore consider the matter, and understand the vision:
verses.textEnNlt: The moment you began praying, a command was given. And now I am here to tell you what it was, for you are very precious to God. Listen carefully so that you can understand the meaning of your vision.
verses.textEnNasb: At the beginning of your pleas the command was issued, and I have come to tell you, because you are highly esteemed; so pay attention to the message and gain understanding of the vision.
verses.textEn: As soon as you began to pray, a word went out, which I have come to tell you, for you are highly esteemed. Therefore, consider the word and understand the vision:

verses.textZh: "为你的同胞和你的圣城，已经定了七十个七，要结束过犯，终止罪恶，遮盖罪孽，引进永义，封住异象和预言，并且膏抹至圣所 。
verses.textZhCnvs: "为你的同胞和你的圣城，已经定了七十个七，要结束过犯，终止罪恶，遮盖罪孽，引进永义，封住异象和预言，并且膏抹至圣所 。
verses.textZhCuv: 「为你本国之民和你圣城，已经定了七十个七。要止住罪过，除净罪恶，赎尽罪孽，引进 永义，封住异象和预言，并膏至圣者 。
verses.textEnNiv: "Seventy ‘sevens’ are decreed for your people and your holy city to finish transgression, to put an end to sin, to atone for wickedness, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnEsv: "Seventy weeks are decreed about your people and your holy city, to finish the transgression, to put an end to sin, and to atone for iniquity, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal both vision and prophet, and to anoint a most holy place.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Seventy weeks are determined For your people and for your holy city, To finish the transgression, To make an end of sins, To make reconciliation for iniquity, To bring in everlasting righteousness, To seal up vision and prophecy, And to anoint the Most Holy.
verses.textEnNlt: "A period of seventy sets of seven has been decreed for your people and your holy city to finish their rebellion, to put an end to their sin, to atone for their guilt, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to confirm the prophetic vision, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEnNasb: "Seventy weeks have been decreed for your people and your holy city, to finish the wrongdoing, to make an end of sin, to make atonement for guilt, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy, and to anoint the Most Holy Place.
verses.textEn: "Seventy ‘sevens’ are decreed for your people and your holy city to finish transgression, to put an end to sin, to atone for wickedness, to bring in everlasting righteousness, to seal up vision and prophecy and to anoint the Most Holy Place.

verses.textZh: 你要知道，也要明白，从发出命令恢复和重建耶路撒冷，直到受膏君的时候，必有七个七；又有六十二个七 ，耶路撒冷连广场和濠沟，都必重新建造起来；那是一段困苦的时期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 你要知道，也要明白，从发出命令恢复和重建耶路撒冷，直到受膏君的时候，必有七个七；又有六十二个七 ，耶路撒冷连广场和濠沟，都必重新建造起来；那是一段困苦的时期。
verses.textZhCuv: 你当知道，当明白，从出令重新建造耶路撒冷，直到有受膏君的时候，必有七个七和六十二个七。正在艰难的时候，耶路撒冷城连街带濠都必重新建造。
verses.textEnNiv: "Know and understand this: From the time the word goes out to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Anointed One, the ruler, comes, there will be seven ‘sevens,’ and sixty-two ‘sevens.’ It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of trouble.
verses.textEnEsv: Know therefore and understand that from the going out of the word to restore and build Jerusalem to the coming of an anointed one, a prince, there shall be seven weeks. And for sixty-two weeks it shall be built again with squares and moat, but in a troubled time.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Know therefore and understand, That from the going forth of the command To restore and build Jerusalem Until Messiah the Prince, Thereshallbe seven weeks and sixty-two weeks; The street shall be built again, and the wall, Even in troublesome times.
verses.textEnNlt: Now listen and understand! Seven sets of seven plus sixty-two sets of seven will pass from the time the command is given to rebuild Jerusalem until a ruler—the Anointed One —comes. Jerusalem will be rebuilt with streets and strong defenses, despite the perilous times.
verses.textEnNasb: So you are to know and understand that from the issuing of a decree to restore and rebuild Jerusalem, until Messiah the Prince, there will be seven weeks and sixty-two weeks; it will be built again, with streets and moat, even in times of distress.
verses.textEn: "Know and understand this: From the time the word goes out to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until the Anointed One, the ruler, comes, there will be seven ‘sevens,’ and sixty-two ‘sevens.’ It will be rebuilt with streets and a trench, but in times of trouble.

verses.textZh: 六十二个七以后，受膏者必被剪除，一无所有 ；那将要来的领袖的人民必毁灭这城和圣所。结局必像洪水而来；必有争战直到末了；荒凉的事已经定了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 六十二个七以后，受膏者必被剪除，一无所有 ；那将要来的领袖的人民必毁灭这城和圣所。结局必像洪水而来；必有争战直到末了；荒凉的事已经定了。
verses.textZhCuv: 过了六十二个七，那 受膏者必被剪除，一无所有；必有一王的民来毁灭这城和圣所，至终必如洪水冲没。必有争战，一直到底，荒凉的事已经定了。
verses.textEnNiv: After the sixty-two ‘sevens,’ the Anointed One will be put to death and will have nothing. The people of the ruler who will come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end will come like a flood: War will continue until the end, and desolations have been decreed.
verses.textEnEsv: And after the sixty-two weeks, an anointed one shall be cut off and shall have nothing. And the people of the prince who is to come shall destroy the city and the sanctuary. Its end shall come with a flood, and to the end there shall be war. Desolations are decreed.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And after the sixty-two weeks Messiah shall be cut off, but not for Himself; And the people of the prince who is to come Shall destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end of it shallbe with a flood, And till the end of the war desolations are determined.
verses.textEnNlt: "After this period of sixty-two sets of seven, the Anointed One will be killed, appearing to have accomplished nothing, and a ruler will arise whose armies will destroy the city and the Temple. The end will come with a flood, and war and its miseries are decreed from that time to the very end.
verses.textEnNasb: Then after the sixty-two weeks, the Messiah will be cut off and have nothing, and the people of the prince who is to come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. And its end will come with a flood; even to the end there will be war; desolations are determined.
verses.textEn: After the sixty-two ‘sevens,’ the Anointed One will be put to death and will have nothing. The people of the ruler who will come will destroy the city and the sanctuary. The end will come like a flood: War will continue until the end, and desolations have been decreed.

verses.textZh: 一七之内，他必和许多人坚立盟约；一七之半，他必使献祭和供物终止；他必在殿里 ；设立那使地荒凉的可憎的像 ，直到指定的结局倾倒在那造成荒凉的人身上。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 一七之内，他必和许多人坚立盟约；一七之半，他必使献祭和供物终止；他必在殿里 ；设立那使地荒凉的可憎的像 ，直到指定的结局倾倒在那造成荒凉的人身上。"
verses.textZhCuv: 一七之内，他必与许多人坚定盟约；一七之半，他必使祭祀与供献止息。那行毁坏可憎的 如飞而来，并且有忿怒倾在那行毁坏的身上 ，直到所定的结局。」
verses.textEnNiv: He will confirm a covenant with many for one ‘seven.’ In the middle of the ‘seven’ he will put an end to sacrifice and offering. And at the temple he will set up an abomination that causes desolation, until the end that is decreed is poured out on him. "
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall make a strong covenant with many for one week, and for half of the week he shall put an end to sacrifice and offering. And on the wing of abominations shall come one who makes desolate, until the decreed end is poured out on the desolator."
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall confirm a covenant with many for one week; But in the middle of the week He shall bring an end to sacrifice and offering. And on the wing of abominations shall be one who makes desolate, Even until the consummation, which is determined, Is poured out on the desolate."
verses.textEnNlt: The ruler will make a treaty with the people for a period of one set of seven, but after half this time, he will put an end to the sacrifices and offerings. And as a climax to all his terrible deeds, he will set up a sacrilegious object that causes desecration, until the fate decreed for this defiler is finally poured out on him."
verses.textEnNasb: And he will confirm a covenant with the many for one week, but in the middle of the week he will put a stop to sacrifice and grain offering; and on the wing of abominations will come the one who makes desolate, until a complete destruction, one that is decreed, gushes forth on the one who makes desolate."
verses.textEn: He will confirm a covenant with many for one ‘seven.’ In the middle of the ‘seven’ he will put an end to sacrifice and offering. And at the temple he will set up an abomination that causes desolation, until the end that is decreed is poured out on him. "

verses.textZh: 波斯王古列第三年，有一个信息启示给那称为伯提沙撒的但以理。这信息是真的，是关于一场大战争；但以理明白这信息，了解这异象。
verses.textZhCnvs: 波斯王古列第三年，有一个信息启示给那称为伯提沙撒的但以理。这信息是真的，是关于一场大战争；但以理明白这信息，了解这异象。
verses.textZhCuv: 波斯王塞鲁士第三年，有事显给称为伯提沙撒的但以理。这事是真的，是指着大争战；但以理通达这事，明白这异象。
verses.textEnNiv: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a revelation was given to Daniel (who was called Belteshazzar). Its message was true and it concerned a great war. The understanding of the message came to him in a vision.
verses.textEnEsv: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a word was revealed to Daniel, who was named Belteshazzar. And the word was true, and it was a great conflict. And he understood the word and had understanding of the vision.
verses.textEnNkjv: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a message was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar. The message was true, but the appointed time was long; and he understood the message, and had understanding of the vision.
verses.textEnNlt: In the third year of the reign of King Cyrus of Persia, Daniel (also known as Belteshazzar) had another vision. He understood that the vision concerned events certain to happen in the future—times of war and great hardship.
verses.textEnNasb: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a message was revealed to Daniel, who was named Belteshazzar; and the message was true and it concerned great conflict, but he understood the message and had an understanding of the vision.
verses.textEn: In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia, a revelation was given to Daniel (who was called Belteshazzar). Its message was true and it concerned a great war. The understanding of the message came to him in a vision.

verses.textZh: 那时，我但以理悲伤了三个星期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那时，我但以理悲伤了三个星期。
verses.textZhCuv: 当那时，我－但以理悲伤了三个七日。
verses.textEnNiv: At that time I, Daniel, mourned for three weeks.
verses.textEnEsv: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks.
verses.textEnNkjv: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning three full weeks.
verses.textEnNlt: When this vision came to me, I, Daniel, had been in mourning for three whole weeks.
verses.textEnNasb: In those days, I, Daniel, had been mourning for three entire weeks.
verses.textEn: At that time I, Daniel, mourned for three weeks.

verses.textZh: 美味的食物我没有吃，肉和酒没有入我的口，我也没有用膏油抹身，整整三个星期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 美味的食物我没有吃，肉和酒没有入我的口，我也没有用膏油抹身，整整三个星期。
verses.textZhCuv: 美味我没有吃，酒肉没有入我的口，也没有用油抹我的身，直到满了三个七日。
verses.textEnNiv: I ate no choice food; no meat or wine touched my lips; and I used no lotions at all until the three weeks were over.
verses.textEnEsv: I ate no delicacies, no meat or wine entered my mouth, nor did I anoint myself at all, for the full three weeks.
verses.textEnNkjv: I ate no pleasant food, no meat or wine came into my mouth, nor did I anoint myself at all, till three whole weeks were fulfilled.
verses.textEnNlt: All that time I had eaten no rich food. No meat or wine crossed my lips, and I used no fragrant lotions until those three weeks had passed.
verses.textEnNasb: I did not eat any tasty food, nor did meat or wine enter my mouth, nor did I use any ointment at all until the entire three weeks were completed.
verses.textEn: I ate no choice food; no meat or wine touched my lips; and I used no lotions at all until the three weeks were over.

verses.textZh: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河边的时候，
verses.textZhCnvs: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河边的时候，
verses.textZhCuv: 正月二十四日，我在底格里斯大河边，
verses.textEnNiv: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,
verses.textEnEsv: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river ( that is, the Tigris)
verses.textEnNkjv: Now on the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was by the side of the great river, that is, the Tigris,
verses.textEnNlt: On April 23, as I was standing on the bank of the great Tigris River,
verses.textEnNasb: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, while I was by the bank of the great river, that is, the Tigris,
verses.textEn: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, as I was standing on the bank of the great river, the Tigris,

verses.textZh: 我举目观看，看见有一个人身穿细麻衣，腰束乌法纯金的带。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我举目观看，看见有一个人身穿细麻衣，腰束乌法纯金的带。
verses.textZhCuv: 举目观看，见有一人身穿细麻衣，腰束乌法精金带。
verses.textEnNiv: I looked up and there before me was a man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.
verses.textEnEsv: I lifted up my eyes and looked, and behold, a man clothed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.
verses.textEnNkjv: I lifted my eyes and looked, and behold, a certain man clothed in linen, whose waist was girded with gold of Uphaz!
verses.textEnNlt: I looked up and saw a man dressed in linen clothing, with a belt of pure gold around his waist.
verses.textEnNasb: I raised my eyes and looked, and behold, there was a man dressed in linen, whose waist had a belt of pure gold of Uphaz.
verses.textEn: I looked up and there before me was a man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.

verses.textZh: 他的身像水苍玉，面貌像闪电的样子，眼睛像火把，手臂和腿像擦亮的铜那么闪耀，说话的声音像群众喊叫的声音。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的身像水苍玉，面貌像闪电的样子，眼睛像火把，手臂和腿像擦亮的铜那么闪耀，说话的声音像群众喊叫的声音。
verses.textZhCuv: 他身体如水苍玉，面貌如闪电，眼目如火把，手和脚如光明的铜，说话的声音如大众的声音。
verses.textEnNiv: His body was like topaz, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of burnished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.
verses.textEnEsv: His body was like beryl, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of burnished bronze, and the sound of his words like the sound of a multitude.
verses.textEnNkjv: His body was like beryl, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like torches of fire, his arms and feet like burnished bronze in color, and the sound of his words like the voice of a multitude.
verses.textEnNlt: His body looked like a precious gem. His face flashed like lightning, and his eyes flamed like torches. His arms and feet shone like polished bronze, and his voice roared like a vast multitude of people.
verses.textEnNasb: His body also was like topaz, his face had the appearance of lightning, his eyes were like flaming torches, his arms and feet like the gleam of polished bronze, and the sound of his words like the sound of a multitude.
verses.textEn: His body was like topaz, his face like lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and legs like the gleam of burnished bronze, and his voice like the sound of a multitude.

verses.textZh: 独有我但以理看见这异象，那些和我在一起的人都没有看见，不过他们却大大惊慌，逃跑躲藏起来了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 独有我但以理看见这异象，那些和我在一起的人都没有看见，不过他们却大大惊慌，逃跑躲藏起来了。
verses.textZhCuv: 这异象惟有我－但以理一人看见，同着我的人没有看见。他们却大大战兢，逃跑隐藏，
verses.textEnNiv: I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision; those who were with me did not see it, but such terror overwhelmed them that they fled and hid themselves.
verses.textEnEsv: And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me did not see the vision, but a great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide themselves.
verses.textEnNkjv: And I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, for the men who were with me did not see the vision; but a great terror fell upon them, so that they fled to hide themselves.
verses.textEnNlt: Only I, Daniel, saw this vision. The men with me saw nothing, but they were suddenly terrified and ran away to hide.
verses.textEnNasb: Now I, Daniel, alone saw the vision, while the men who were with me did not see the vision; nevertheless, a great fear fell on them, and they ran away to hide themselves.
verses.textEn: I, Daniel, was the only one who saw the vision; those who were with me did not see it, but such terror overwhelmed them that they fled and hid themselves.

verses.textZh: 因此，只有我一人留下来；我看见了这大异象，就全身无力，脸色大变，一点力气都没有。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因此，只有我一人留下来；我看见了这大异象，就全身无力，脸色大变，一点力气都没有。
verses.textZhCuv: 只剩下我一人。我见了这大异象便浑身无力，面貌失色，毫无气力。
verses.textEnNiv: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision; I had no strength left, my face turned deathly pale and I was helpless.
verses.textEnEsv: So I was left alone and saw this great vision, and no strength was left in me. My radiant appearance was fearfully changed, and I retained no strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: Therefore I was left alone when I saw this great vision, and no strength remained in me; for my vigor was turned to frailty in me, and I retained no strength.
verses.textEnNlt: So I was left there all alone to see this amazing vision. My strength left me, my face grew deathly pale, and I felt very weak.
verses.textEnNasb: So I was left alone and saw this great vision; yet no strength was left in me, for my complexion turned to a deathly pallor, and I retained no strength.
verses.textEn: So I was left alone, gazing at this great vision; I had no strength left, my face turned deathly pale and I was helpless.

verses.textZh: 我却仍听见他说话的声音；我一听见他说话的声音，就沉睡了，脸伏在地。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我却仍听见他说话的声音；我一听见他说话的声音，就沉睡了，脸伏在地。
verses.textZhCuv: 我却听见他说话的声音，一听见就面伏在地沉睡了。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I heard him speaking, and as I listened to him, I fell into a deep sleep, my face to the ground.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I heard the sound of his words, and as I heard the sound of his words, I fell on my face in deep sleep with my face to the ground.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yet I heard the sound of his words; and while I heard the sound of his words I was in a deep sleep on my face, with my face to the ground.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I heard the man speak, and when I heard the sound of his voice, I fainted and lay there with my face to the ground.
verses.textEnNasb: But I heard the sound of his words; and as soon as I heard the sound of his words, I fell into a deep sleep on my face, with my face to the ground.
verses.textEn: Then I heard him speaking, and as I listened to him, I fell into a deep sleep, my face to the ground.

verses.textZh: 忽然有一只手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌勉强支持着要站起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然有一只手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌勉强支持着要站起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 忽然，有一手按在我身上，使我用膝和手掌支持微起。
verses.textEnNiv: A hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, a hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.
verses.textEnNkjv: Suddenly, a hand touched me, which made me tremble on my knees and on the palms of my hands.
verses.textEnNlt: Just then a hand touched me and lifted me, still trembling, to my hands and knees.
verses.textEnNasb: Then behold, a hand touched me and shook me on my hands and knees.
verses.textEn: A hand touched me and set me trembling on my hands and knees.

verses.textZh: 他对我说："大蒙眷爱的但以理啊！你应当留意我要对你说的话。你只管站起来，因为我现在奉差遣到你这里来。"他和我说这话的时候，我就战战兢兢地站起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他对我说："大蒙眷爱的但以理啊！你应当留意我要对你说的话。你只管站起来，因为我现在奉差遣到你这里来。"他和我说这话的时候，我就战战兢兢地站起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 他对我说：「大蒙眷爱的但以理啊，要明白我与你所说的话，只管站起来，因为我现在奉差遣来到你这里。」他对我说这话，我便战战兢兢地立起来。
verses.textEnNiv: He said, "Daniel, you who are highly esteemed, consider carefully the words I am about to speak to you, and stand up, for I have now been sent to you." And when he said this to me, I stood up trembling.
verses.textEnEsv: And he said to me, "O Daniel, man greatly loved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for now I have been sent to you." And when he had spoken this word to me, I stood up trembling.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said to me, "O Daniel, man greatly beloved, understand the words that I speak to you, and stand upright, for I have now been sent to you." While he was speaking this word to me, I stood trembling.
verses.textEnNlt: And the man said to me, "Daniel, you are very precious to God, so listen carefully to what I have to say to you. Stand up, for I have been sent to you." When he said this to me, I stood up, still trembling.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said to me, "Daniel, you who are treasured, understand the words that I am about to tell you and stand at your place, for I have now been sent to you." And when he had spoken this word to me, I stood up trembling.
verses.textEn: He said, "Daniel, you who are highly esteemed, consider carefully the words I am about to speak to you, and stand up, for I have now been sent to you." And when he said this to me, I stood up trembling.

verses.textZh: 他又对我说："但以理啊！不要惧怕，因为自从你第一天决心要明白这些事，又在你的神面前谦卑自己，你祷告的话已蒙垂听了；我就是因你祷告的话而来的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又对我说："但以理啊！不要惧怕，因为自从你第一天决心要明白这些事，又在你的神面前谦卑自己，你祷告的话已蒙垂听了；我就是因你祷告的话而来的。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就说：「但以理啊，不要惧怕！因为从你第一日专心求明白将来的事，又在你神面前刻苦己心，你的言语已蒙应允；我是因你的言语而来。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he continued, "Do not be afraid, Daniel. Since the first day that you set your mind to gain understanding and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to them.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said to me, "Fear not, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand and humbled yourself before your God, your words have been heard, and I have come because of your words.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said to me, "Do not fear, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart to understand, and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard; and I have come because of your words.
verses.textEnNlt: Then he said, "Don’t be afraid, Daniel. Since the first day you began to pray for understanding and to humble yourself before your God, your request has been heard in heaven. I have come in answer to your prayer.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said to me, "Do not be afraid, Daniel, for from the first day that you set your heart on understanding this and on humbling yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to your words.
verses.textEn: Then he continued, "Do not be afraid, Daniel. Since the first day that you set your mind to gain understanding and to humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come in response to them.

verses.textZh: 但波斯国的护卫天使拦阻我二十一天；后来有护卫天使长中的一位米迦勒来帮助我，我就留他在那里 ，和波斯众王在一起。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但波斯国的护卫天使拦阻我二十一天；后来有护卫天使长中的一位米迦勒来帮助我，我就留他在那里 ，和波斯众王在一起。
verses.textZhCuv: 但波斯国的魔君拦阻我二十一日。忽然有大君 中的一位米迦勒来帮助我，我就停留在波斯诸王那里。
verses.textEnNiv: But the prince of the Persian kingdom resisted me twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, because I was detained there with the king of Persia.
verses.textEnEsv: The prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days, but Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, for I was left there with the kings of Persia,
verses.textEnNkjv: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia withstood me twenty-one days; and behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, for I had been left alone there with the kings of Persia.
verses.textEnNlt: But for twenty-one days the spirit prince of the kingdom of Persia blocked my way. Then Michael, one of the archangels, came to help me, and I left him there with the spirit prince of the kingdom of Persia.
verses.textEnNasb: But the prince of the kingdom of Persia was standing in my way for twenty-one days; then behold, Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, for I had been left there with the kings of Persia.
verses.textEn: But the prince of the Persian kingdom resisted me twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, because I was detained there with the king of Persia.

verses.textZh: 现在我来是要使你明白日后所要发生在你的同胞身上的事，因为这异象是关于将来许多的年日的。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我来是要使你明白日后所要发生在你的同胞身上的事，因为这异象是关于将来许多的年日的。"
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我来，要使你明白本国之民日后必遭遇的事，因为这异象关乎后来许多的日子。」
verses.textEnNiv: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the future, for the vision concerns a time yet to come."
verses.textEnEsv: and came to make you understand what is to happen to your people in the latter days. For the vision is for days yet to come."
verses.textEnNkjv: Now I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision refers to many days yet tocome."
verses.textEnNlt: Now I am here to explain what will happen to your people in the future, for this vision concerns a time yet to come."
verses.textEnNasb: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the latter days, because the vision pertains to the days still future."
verses.textEn: Now I have come to explain to you what will happen to your people in the future, for the vision concerns a time yet to come."

verses.textZh: 他和我说这些话的时候，我就脸伏在地，默默无声。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他和我说这些话的时候，我就脸伏在地，默默无声。
verses.textZhCuv: 他向我这样说，我就脸面朝地，哑口无声。
verses.textEnNiv: While he was saying this to me, I bowed with my face toward the ground and was speechless.
verses.textEnEsv: When he had spoken to me according to these words, I turned my face toward the ground and was mute.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he had spoken such words to me, I turned my face toward the ground and became speechless.
verses.textEnNlt: While he was speaking to me, I looked down at the ground, unable to say a word.
verses.textEnNasb: When he had spoken to me according to these words, I turned my face toward the ground and became speechless.
verses.textEn: While he was saying this to me, I bowed with my face toward the ground and was speechless.

verses.textZh: 忽然有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我就开口和那站在我面前的交谈，说："我主啊！因着这异象，我非常痛苦，毫无气力。
verses.textZhCnvs: 忽然有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我就开口和那站在我面前的交谈，说："我主啊！因着这异象，我非常痛苦，毫无气力。
verses.textZhCuv: 不料，有一位像人的，摸我的嘴唇，我便开口向那站在我面前的说：「我主啊，因见这异象，我大大愁苦，毫无气力。
verses.textEnNiv: Then one who looked like a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and began to speak. I said to the one standing before me, "I am overcome with anguish because of the vision, my lord, and I feel very weak.
verses.textEnEsv: And behold, one in the likeness of the children of man touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth and spoke. I said to him who stood before me, "O my lord, by reason of the vision pains have come upon me, and I retain no strength.
verses.textEnNkjv: And suddenly, one having the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips; then I opened my mouth and spoke, saying to him who stood before me, "My lord, because of the vision my sorrows have overwhelmed me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the one who looked like a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and began to speak. I said to the one standing in front of me, "I am filled with anguish because of the vision I have seen, my lord, and I am very weak.
verses.textEnNasb: And behold, one who resembled a human was touching my lips. Then I opened my mouth and spoke and said to him who was standing before me, "My lord, due to the vision anguish has come upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.textEn: Then one who looked like a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and began to speak. I said to the one standing before me, "I am overcome with anguish because of the vision, my lord, and I feel very weak.

verses.textZh: 我主的仆人怎能和我主说话呢？我现在全身无力，没有气息。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我主的仆人怎能和我主说话呢？我现在全身无力，没有气息。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我主的仆人怎能与我主说话呢？我一见异象就浑身无力，毫无气息。」
verses.textEnNiv: How can I, your servant, talk with you, my lord? My strength is gone and I can hardly breathe."
verses.textEnEsv: How can my lord’s servant talk with my lord? For now no strength remains in me, and no breath is left in me."
verses.textEnNkjv: For how can this servant of my lord talk with you, my lord? As for me, no strength remains in me now, nor is any breath left in me."
verses.textEnNlt: How can someone like me, your servant, talk to you, my lord? My strength is gone, and I can hardly breathe."
verses.textEnNasb: For how can such a servant of my lord talk with such as my lord? As for me, there remains just now no strength in me, nor has any breath been left in me."
verses.textEn: How can I, your servant, talk with you, my lord? My strength is gone and I can hardly breathe."

verses.textZh: 那位像人的再摸我，使我有力量。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那位像人的再摸我，使我有力量。
verses.textZhCuv: 有一位形状像人的又摸我，使我有力量。
verses.textEnNiv: Again the one who looked like a man touched me and gave me strength.
verses.textEnEsv: Again one having the appearance of a man touched me and strengthened me.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then again, theone having the likeness of a man touched me and strengthened me.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the one who looked like a man touched me again, and I felt my strength returning.
verses.textEnNasb: Then this one with human appearance touched me again and strengthened me.
verses.textEn: Again the one who looked like a man touched me and gave me strength.

verses.textZh: 他说："大蒙眷爱的人哪！不要惧怕，愿你平安，你要大大刚强。"他和我说话的时候，我就刚强起来；于是我说："我主请说，因为你刚强了我。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："大蒙眷爱的人哪！不要惧怕，愿你平安，你要大大刚强。"他和我说话的时候，我就刚强起来；于是我说："我主请说，因为你刚强了我。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「大蒙眷爱的人哪，不要惧怕，愿你平安！你总要坚强。」他一向我说话，我便觉得有力量，说：「我主请说，因你使我有力量。」
verses.textEnNiv: "Do not be afraid, you who are highly esteemed," he said. "Peace! Be strong now; be strong." When he spoke to me, I was strengthened and said, "Speak, my lord, since you have given me strength."
verses.textEnEsv: And he said, "O man greatly loved, fear not, peace be with you; be strong and of good courage." And as he spoke to me, I was strengthened and said, "Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me."
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "O man greatly beloved, fear not! Peace be to you; be strong, yes, be strong!" So when he spoke to me I was strengthened, and said, "Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me."
verses.textEnNlt: "Don’t be afraid," he said, "for you are very precious to God. Peace! Be encouraged! Be strong!" As he spoke these words to me, I suddenly felt stronger and said to him, "Please speak to me, my lord, for you have strengthened me."
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, " You who are treasured, do not be afraid. Peace be to you; take courage and be courageous!" Now as soon as he spoke to me, I felt strengthened and said, "May my lord speak, for you have strengthened me."
verses.textEn: "Do not be afraid, you who are highly esteemed," he said. "Peace! Be strong now; be strong." When he spoke to me, I was strengthened and said, "Speak, my lord, since you have given me strength."

verses.textZh: 他说："现在我要回去和波斯的护卫天使作战；我一离去，希腊的护卫天使就要来。但你知道我为甚么到你这里来吗？
verses.textZhCnvs: 他说："现在我要回去和波斯的护卫天使作战；我一离去，希腊的护卫天使就要来。但你知道我为甚么到你这里来吗？
verses.textZhCuv: 他就说：「你知道我为何来见你吗？现在我要回去与波斯的魔君争战，我去后，希腊 的魔君必来。
verses.textEnNiv: So he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? Soon I will return to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I go, the prince of Greece will come;
verses.textEnEsv: Then he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? But now I will return to fight against the prince of Persia; and when I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? And now I must return to fight with the prince of Persia; and when I have gone forth, indeed the prince of Greece will come.
verses.textEnNlt: He replied, "Do you know why I have come? Soon I must return to fight against the spirit prince of the kingdom of Persia, and after that the spirit prince of the kingdom of Greece will come.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he said, "Do you understand why I came to you? But I shall now return to fight against the prince of Persia; so I am leaving, and behold, the prince of Greece is about to come.
verses.textEn: So he said, "Do you know why I have come to you? Soon I will return to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I go, the prince of Greece will come;

verses.textZh: 我来是要把那记录在真理书上的事告诉你。除了你们的护卫天使米迦勒之外，没有一个帮助我，和我一起抵挡他们。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我来是要把那记录在真理书上的事告诉你。除了你们的护卫天使米迦勒之外，没有一个帮助我，和我一起抵挡他们。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但我要将那录在真确书上的事告诉你。除了你们的大君米迦勒之外，没有帮助我抵挡这两魔君的。」
verses.textEnNiv: but first I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. (No one supports me against them except Michael, your prince.
verses.textEnEsv: But I will tell you what is inscribed in the book of truth: there is none who contends by my side against these except Michael, your prince.
verses.textEnNkjv: But I will tell you what is noted in the Scripture of Truth. (No one upholds me against these, except Michael your prince.
verses.textEnNlt: Meanwhile, I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. (No one helps me against these spirit princes except Michael, your spirit prince.
verses.textEnNasb: However, I will tell you what is recorded in the writing of truth. Yet there is no one who stands firmly with me against these forces except Michael your prince.
verses.textEn: but first I will tell you what is written in the Book of Truth. (No one supports me against them except Michael, your prince.

verses.textZh: "玛代人大利乌王第一年，我曾经起来帮助米迦勒，使他坚强。
verses.textZhCnvs: "玛代人大利乌王第一年，我曾经起来帮助米迦勒，使他坚强。
verses.textZhCuv: 又说：「当米底亚王大流士元年，我曾起来扶助米迦勒，使他坚强。」
verses.textEnNiv: And in the first year of Darius the Mede, I took my stand to support and protect him.)
verses.textEnEsv: "And as for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also in the first year of Darius the Mede, I, even I, stood up to confirm and strengthen him.)
verses.textEnNlt: I have been standing beside Michael to support and strengthen him since the first year of the reign of Darius the Mede.)
verses.textEnNasb: "In the first year of Darius the Mede, I arose to be of assistance and a protection for him.
verses.textEn: And in the first year of Darius the Mede, I took my stand to support and protect him.)

verses.textZh: 现在我要把真理告诉你。看哪！在波斯还有三个王要兴起；第四个王必非常富有，远超过所有的王；他因富足成为强盛以后，就必煽动众民攻击希腊国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 现在我要把真理告诉你。看哪！在波斯还有三个王要兴起；第四个王必非常富有，远超过所有的王；他因富足成为强盛以后，就必煽动众民攻击希腊国。
verses.textZhCuv: 现在我将真事指示你： 「波斯还有三王兴起，第四王必富足远胜诸王。他因富足成为强盛，就必激动大众攻击希腊国。
verses.textEnNiv: "Now then, I tell you the truth: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. When he has gained power by his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
verses.textEnEsv: "And now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings shall arise in Persia, and a fourth shall be far richer than all of them. And when he has become strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the kingdom of Greece.
verses.textEnNkjv: And now I will tell you the truth: Behold, three more kings will arise in Persia, and the fourth shall be far richer than them all; by his strength, through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.
verses.textEnNlt: "Now then, I will reveal the truth to you. Three more Persian kings will reign, to be succeeded by a fourth, far richer than the others. He will use his wealth to stir up everyone to fight against the kingdom of Greece.
verses.textEnNasb: And now I will tell you the truth. Behold, three more kings are going to arise in Persia. Then a fourth will gain far more riches than all of them; as soon as he becomes strong through his riches, he will stir up the entire empire against the realm of Greece.
verses.textEn: "Now then, I tell you the truth: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. When he has gained power by his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.

verses.textZh: 后来必有一个英勇的王兴起，他必执掌大权，任意而行。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来必有一个英勇的王兴起，他必执掌大权，任意而行。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有一个勇敢的王兴起，执掌大权，随意而行。
verses.textEnNiv: Then a mighty king will arise, who will rule with great power and do as he pleases.
verses.textEnEsv: Then a mighty king shall arise, who shall rule with great dominion and do as he wills.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then a mighty king shall arise, who shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then a mighty king will rise to power who will rule with great authority and accomplish everything he sets out to do.
verses.textEnNasb: And a mighty king will arise, and he will rule with great authority and do as he pleases.
verses.textEn: Then a mighty king will arise, who will rule with great power and do as he pleases.

verses.textZh: 他兴起的时候，他的国就破裂，向天的四方 分开，却不归给他的后代，国势也不及他掌权的时候；因为他的国必被拔出，归给他后代以外的人。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他兴起的时候，他的国就破裂，向天的四方 分开，却不归给他的后代，国势也不及他掌权的时候；因为他的国必被拔出，归给他后代以外的人。
verses.textZhCuv: 他兴起的时候，他的国必破裂，向天的四方 分开，却不归他的后裔，治国的权势也都不及他；因为他的国必被拔出，归与他后裔之外的人。
verses.textEnNiv: After he has arisen, his empire will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the power he exercised, because his empire will be uprooted and given to others.
verses.textEnEsv: And as soon as he has arisen, his kingdom shall be broken and divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not to his posterity, nor according to the authority with which he ruled, for his kingdom shall be plucked up and go to others besides these.
verses.textEnNkjv: And when he has arisen, his kingdom shall be broken up and divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not among his posterity nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom shall be uprooted, even for others besides these.
verses.textEnNlt: But at the height of his power, his kingdom will be broken apart and divided into four parts. It will not be ruled by the king’s descendants, nor will the kingdom hold the authority it once had. For his empire will be uprooted and given to others.
verses.textEnNasb: But as soon as he has arisen, his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four points of the compass, though not to his own descendants, nor according to his authority which he wielded, because his sovereignty will be removed and given to others besides them.
verses.textEn: After he has arisen, his empire will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the power he exercised, because his empire will be uprooted and given to others.

verses.textZh: "南方的王必强盛，他的将领中必有一个比他更强盛的，这人必掌权，他的权势很大。
verses.textZhCnvs: "南方的王必强盛，他的将领中必有一个比他更强盛的，这人必掌权，他的权势很大。
verses.textZhCuv: 「南方的王必强盛，他将帅中必有一个比他更强盛，执掌权柄，他的权柄甚大。
verses.textEnNiv: "The king of the South will become strong, but one of his commanders will become even stronger than he and will rule his own kingdom with great power.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then the king of the south shall be strong, but one of his princes shall be stronger than he and shall rule, and his authority shall be a great authority.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also the king of the South shall become strong, as well as one of his princes; and he shall gain power over him and have dominion. His dominion shallbe a great dominion.
verses.textEnNlt: "The king of the south will increase in power, but one of his own officials will become more powerful than he and will rule his kingdom with great strength.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the king of the South will grow strong, along with one of his princes who will gain ascendancy over him and rule; his domain will be a great realm indeed.
verses.textEn: "The king of the South will become strong, but one of his commanders will become even stronger than he and will rule his own kingdom with great power.

verses.textZh: 过了多年，南方王的女儿必到北方王那里去修好，他们必互相结盟。但这女子的势力必存留不住；王和他的势力也站立不住；她连同那些带她来的、那生她的，和那帮助她的，都被交出处死。
verses.textZhCnvs: 过了多年，南方王的女儿必到北方王那里去修好，他们必互相结盟。但这女子的势力必存留不住；王和他的势力也站立不住；她连同那些带她来的、那生她的，和那帮助她的，都被交出处死。
verses.textZhCuv: 过些年后，他们必互相连合，南方王的女儿必就了北方王来立约；但这女子帮助之力存立不住，王和他所倚靠之力也不能存立。这女子和引导她来的，并生她的，以及当时扶助她的，都必交与死地。
verses.textEnNiv: After some years, they will become allies. The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to make an alliance, but she will not retain her power, and he and his power will not last. In those days she will be betrayed, together with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.
verses.textEnEsv: After some years they shall make an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement. But she shall not retain the strength of her arm, and he and his arm shall not endure, but she shall be given up, and her attendants, he who fathered her, and he who supported her in those times.
verses.textEnNkjv: And at the end of some years they shall join forces, for the daughter of the king of the South shall go to the king of the North to make an agreement; but she shall not retain the power of her authority, and neither he nor his authority shall stand; but she shall be given up, with those who brought her, and with him who begot her, and with him who strengthened her in those times.
verses.textEnNlt: "Some years later an alliance will be formed between the king of the north and the king of the south. The daughter of the king of the south will be given in marriage to the king of the north to secure the alliance, but she will lose her influence over him, and so will her father. She will be abandoned along with her supporters.
verses.textEnNasb: And after some years they will form an alliance, and the daughter of the king of the South will come to the king of the North to reach an agreement. But she will not keep her position of power, nor will he remain with his power, but she will be given up, along with those who brought her in and the one who fathered her as well as he who supported her in those times.
verses.textEn: After some years, they will become allies. The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to make an alliance, but she will not retain her power, and he and his power will not last. In those days she will be betrayed, together with her royal escort and her father and the one who supported her.

verses.textZh: 但这女子的本家 必另有一个儿子 兴起，继承父位；他必来攻击北方王的军队，进入北方王的堡垒，攻打他们，而且得胜。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但这女子的本家 必另有一个儿子 兴起，继承父位；他必来攻击北方王的军队，进入北方王的堡垒，攻打他们，而且得胜。
verses.textZhCuv: 但这女子的本家 必另生一子 继续王位，他必率领军队进入北方王的保障，攻击他们，而且得胜；
verses.textEnNiv: "One from her family line will arise to take her place. He will attack the forces of the king of the North and enter his fortress; he will fight against them and be victorious.
verses.textEnEsv: "And from a branch from her roots one shall arise in his place. He shall come against the army and enter the fortress of the king of the north, and he shall deal with them and shall prevail.
verses.textEnNkjv: But from a branch of her roots one shall arise in his place, who shall come with an army, enter the fortress of the king of the North, and deal with them and prevail.
verses.textEnNlt: But when one of her relatives becomes king of the south, he will raise an army and enter the fortress of the king of the north and defeat him.
verses.textEnNasb: But one of the descendants of her line will arise in his place, and he will come against their army and enter the fortress of the king of the North, and he will deal with them and prevail.
verses.textEn: "One from her family line will arise to take her place. He will attack the forces of the king of the North and enter his fortress; he will fight against them and be victorious.

verses.textZh: 他又把他们的神像、铸成的偶像，连同金银的宝器，都一起掳掠到了埃及去。此后数年之久，他不再去攻击北方王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他又把他们的神像、铸成的偶像，连同金银的宝器，都一起掳掠到了埃及去。此后数年之久，他不再去攻击北方王。
verses.textZhCuv: 并将他们的神像和铸成的偶像，与金银的宝器掠到埃及去。数年之内，他不去攻击北方的王。
verses.textEnNiv: He will also seize their gods, their metal images and their valuable articles of silver and gold and carry them off to Egypt. For some years he will leave the king of the North alone.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall also carry off to Egypt their gods with their metal images and their precious vessels of silver and gold, and for some years he shall refrain from attacking the king of the north.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall also carry their gods captive to Egypt, with their princes and their precious articles of silver and gold; and he shall continue more years than the king of the North.
verses.textEnNlt: When he returns to Egypt, he will carry back their idols with him, along with priceless articles of gold and silver. For some years afterward he will leave the king of the north alone.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will also take into captivity to Egypt their gods with their cast metal images and their precious vessels of silver and gold, and he on his part will refrain from attacking the king of the North for some years.
verses.textEn: He will also seize their gods, their metal images and their valuable articles of silver and gold and carry them off to Egypt. For some years he will leave the king of the North alone.

verses.textZh: 后来北方王必侵入南方王的国土，然后撤退归回本国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来北方王必侵入南方王的国土，然后撤退归回本国。
verses.textZhCuv: 北方的王 必入南方王的国，却要仍回本地。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king of the North will invade the realm of the king of the South but will retreat to his own country.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the latter shall come into the realm of the king of the south but shall return to his own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Also thekingoftheNorth shall come to the kingdom of the king of the South, but shall return to his own land.
verses.textEnNlt: "Later the king of the north will invade the realm of the king of the south but will soon return to his own land.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the latter will enter the realm of the king of the South, but will return to his own land.
verses.textEn: Then the king of the North will invade the realm of the king of the South but will retreat to his own country.

verses.textZh: "北方王的众子必备战，招集大军；这大军前进，如洪水泛滥，横扫南方王的国土；之后他又再去争战，直到南方王的堡垒。
verses.textZhCnvs: "北方王的众子必备战，招集大军；这大军前进，如洪水泛滥，横扫南方王的国土；之后他又再去争战，直到南方王的堡垒。
verses.textZhCuv: 「北方王 的二子必动干戈，招聚许多军兵。这军兵前去，如洪水氾滥，又必再去争战，直到南方王的保障。
verses.textEnNiv: His sons will prepare for war and assemble a great army, which will sweep on like an irresistible flood and carry the battle as far as his fortress.
verses.textEnEsv: "His sons shall wage war and assemble a multitude of great forces, which shall keep coming and overflow and pass through, and again shall carry the war as far as his fortress.
verses.textEnNkjv: However his sons shall stir up strife, and assemble a multitude of great forces; and one shall certainly come and overwhelm and pass through; then he shall return to his fortress and stir up strife.
verses.textEnNlt: However, the sons of the king of the north will assemble a mighty army that will advance like a flood and carry the battle as far as the enemy’s fortress.
verses.textEnNasb: "And his sons will mobilize and assemble a multitude of great forces; and one of them will keep on coming and overflow and pass through, so that he may again wage war up to his fortress.
verses.textEn: His sons will prepare for war and assemble a great army, which will sweep on like an irresistible flood and carry the battle as far as his fortress.

verses.textZh: 南方王必发大怒，出来和北方王交战；北方王必摆列大军，但这大军必交在南方王的手里。
verses.textZhCnvs: 南方王必发大怒，出来和北方王交战；北方王必摆列大军，但这大军必交在南方王的手里。
verses.textZhCuv: 南方王必发烈怒，出来与北方王争战，摆列大军；北方王的军兵必交付他手。
verses.textEnNiv: "Then the king of the South will march out in a rage and fight against the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be defeated.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of the south, moved with rage, shall come out and fight against the king of the north. And he shall raise a great multitude, but it shall be given into his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And the king of the South shall be moved with rage, and go out and fight with him, with the king of the North, who shall muster a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into the hand of his enemy.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then, in a rage, the king of the south will rally against the vast forces assembled by the king of the north and will defeat them.
verses.textEnNasb: And the king of the South will be enraged and go out and fight with the king of the North. Then the latter will raise a great multitude, but that multitude will be handed over to the former.
verses.textEn: "Then the king of the South will march out in a rage and fight against the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be defeated.

verses.textZh: 这大军被扫除以后，南方王就心高气傲；他虽然使千万人倒毙，他的胜利却不能持久。
verses.textZhCnvs: 这大军被扫除以后，南方王就心高气傲；他虽然使千万人倒毙，他的胜利却不能持久。
verses.textZhCuv: 他的众军高傲，他的心也必自高；他虽使数万人仆倒，却不得常胜。
verses.textEnNiv: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be filled with pride and will slaughter many thousands, yet he will not remain triumphant.
verses.textEnEsv: And when the multitude is taken away, his heart shall be exalted, and he shall cast down tens of thousands, but he shall not prevail.
verses.textEnNkjv: When he has taken away the multitude, his heart will be lifted up; and he will cast down tens of thousands, but he will not prevail.
verses.textEnNlt: After the enemy army is swept away, the king of the south will be filled with pride and will execute many thousands of his enemies. But his success will be short lived.
verses.textEnNasb: When the multitude is carried away, his heart will be haughty, and he will cause tens of thousands to fall; yet he will not prevail.
