verses.textEn: When the army is carried off, the king of the South will be filled with pride and will slaughter many thousands, yet he will not remain triumphant.

verses.textZh: 北方王必再招聚大军，比先前的更多；时机成熟的时候 ，他就率领装备好了的大军而来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北方王必再招聚大军，比先前的更多；时机成熟的时候 ，他就率领装备好了的大军而来。
verses.textZhCuv: 「北方王必回来摆列大军，比先前的更多。满了所定的年数，他必率领大军，带极多的军装来。
verses.textEnNiv: For the king of the North will muster another army, larger than the first; and after several years, he will advance with a huge army fully equipped.
verses.textEnEsv: For the king of the north shall again raise a multitude, greater than the first. And after some years he shall come on with a great army and abundant supplies.
verses.textEnNkjv: For the king of the North will return and muster a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come at the end of some years with a great army and much equipment.
verses.textEnNlt: "A few years later the king of the north will return with a fully equipped army far greater than before.
verses.textEnNasb: For the king of the North will again raise a greater multitude than the former, and after an interval of some years he will press on with a great army and much equipment.
verses.textEn: For the king of the North will muster another army, larger than the first; and after several years, he will advance with a huge army fully equipped.

verses.textZh: "那时，必有许多人起来攻击南方王，并且你同胞中的强暴人必挺身而起，要使那异象应验，但他们必失败。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，必有许多人起来攻击南方王，并且你同胞中的强暴人必挺身而起，要使那异象应验，但他们必失败。
verses.textZhCuv: 那时，必有许多人起来攻击南方王，并且你本国的强暴人必兴起，要应验那异象，他们却要败亡。
verses.textEnNiv: "In those times many will rise against the king of the South. Those who are violent among your own people will rebel in fulfillment of the vision, but without success.
verses.textEnEsv: "In those times many shall rise against the king of the south, and the violent among your own people shall lift themselves up in order to fulfill the vision, but they shall fail.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Now in those times many shall rise up against the king of the South. Also, violent men of your people shall exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision, but they shall fall.
verses.textEnNlt: At that time there will be a general uprising against the king of the south. Violent men among your own people will join them in fulfillment of this vision, but they will not succeed.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now in those times many will rise up against the king of the South; the violent ones among your people will also raise themselves up to fulfill the vision, but they will fall down.
verses.textEn: "In those times many will rise against the king of the South. Those who are violent among your own people will rebel in fulfillment of the vision, but without success.

verses.textZh: 北方王必来，堆土筑垒攻取坚固城。南方的军力必抵挡不住，甚至精锐的部队也无力抵抗。
verses.textZhCnvs: 北方王必来，堆土筑垒攻取坚固城。南方的军力必抵挡不住，甚至精锐的部队也无力抵抗。
verses.textZhCuv: 北方王必来筑垒攻取坚固城；南方的军兵必站立不住，就是选择的精兵 也无力站住。
verses.textEnNiv: Then the king of the North will come and build up siege ramps and will capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will be powerless to resist; even their best troops will not have the strength to stand.
verses.textEnEsv: Then the king of the north shall come and throw up siegeworks and take a well-fortified city. And the forces of the south shall not stand, or even his best troops, for there shall be no strength to stand.
verses.textEnNkjv: So the king of the North shall come and build a siege mound, and take a fortified city; and the forces of the South shall not withstand him. Even his choice troops shallhave no strength to resist.
verses.textEnNlt: Then the king of the north will come and lay siege to a fortified city and capture it. The best troops of the south will not be able to stand in the face of the onslaught.
verses.textEnNasb: Then the king of the North will come, pile up an assault ramp, and capture a well-fortified city; and the forces of the South will not stand their ground, not even their choicest troops, for there will be no strength to make a stand.
verses.textEn: Then the king of the North will come and build up siege ramps and will capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will be powerless to resist; even their best troops will not have the strength to stand.

verses.textZh: 那来攻击南方王的，必任意而行；没有人能在他面前站立得住；他必站在那荣美之地，手握毁坏之权。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那来攻击南方王的，必任意而行；没有人能在他面前站立得住；他必站在那荣美之地，手握毁坏之权。
verses.textZhCuv: 来攻击他的，必任意而行，无人在北方王 面前站立得住。他必站在那荣美之地，用手施行毁灭。
verses.textEnNiv: The invader will do as he pleases; no one will be able to stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land and will have the power to destroy it.
verses.textEnEsv: But he who comes against him shall do as he wills, and none shall stand before him. And he shall stand in the glorious land, with destruction in his hand.
verses.textEnNkjv: But he who comes against him shall do according to his own will, and no one shall stand against him. He shall stand in the Glorious Land with destruction in his power.
verses.textEnNlt: "The king of the north will march onward unopposed; none will be able to stop him. He will pause in the glorious land of Israel, intent on destroying it.
verses.textEnNasb: But he who comes against him will do as he pleases, and no one will be able to withstand him; he will also stay for a time in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
verses.textEn: The invader will do as he pleases; no one will be able to stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land and will have the power to destroy it.

verses.textZh: 他决意倾全国的力量而来，但他先和南方王修好，把自己的女儿给南方王为妻，好毁灭南国；可是他的计划没有成功，他自己也得不到甚么好处。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他决意倾全国的力量而来，但他先和南方王修好，把自己的女儿给南方王为妻，好毁灭南国；可是他的计划没有成功，他自己也得不到甚么好处。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他必定意用全国之力而来，立公正的约，照约而行，将自己的女儿给南方王为妻，想要败坏他 ，这计却不得成就，与自己毫无益处。
verses.textEnNiv: He will determine to come with the might of his entire kingdom and will make an alliance with the king of the South. And he will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plans will not succeed or help him.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and he shall bring terms of an agreement and perform them. He shall give him the daughter of women to destroy the kingdom, but it shall not stand or be to his advantage.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do. And he shall give him the daughter of women to destroy it; but she shall not stand withhim, or be for him.
verses.textEnNlt: He will make plans to come with the might of his entire kingdom and will form an alliance with the king of the south. He will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom from within, but his plan will fail.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will set his mind on coming with the power of his entire kingdom, bringing with him a proposal of peace which he will put into effect; he will also give him the daughter of women to ruin it. But she will not take a stand for him or be on his side.
verses.textEn: He will determine to come with the might of his entire kingdom and will make an alliance with the king of the South. And he will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plans will not succeed or help him.

verses.textZh: 后来他必转向沿海的岛屿，夺取了许多海岛。但有一个将领要制止他的骄横，并且使他的骄横归回他身上。
verses.textZhCnvs: 后来他必转向沿海的岛屿，夺取了许多海岛。但有一个将领要制止他的骄横，并且使他的骄横归回他身上。
verses.textZhCuv: 其后他必转回夺取了许多海岛。但有一大帅，除掉他令人受的羞辱，并且使这羞辱归他本身。
verses.textEnNiv: Then he will turn his attention to the coastlands and will take many of them, but a commander will put an end to his insolence and will turn his insolence back on him.
verses.textEnEsv: Afterward he shall turn his face to the coastlands and shall capture many of them, but a commander shall put an end to his insolence. Indeed, he shall turn his insolence back upon him.
verses.textEnNkjv: After this he shall turn his face to the coastlands, and shall take many. But a ruler shall bring the reproach against them to an end; and with the reproach removed, he shall turn back on him.
verses.textEnNlt: "After this, he will turn his attention to the coastland and conquer many cities. But a commander from another land will put an end to his insolence and cause him to retreat in shame.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many. But a commander will put a stop to his taunting against him; moreover, he will repay him for his taunting.
verses.textEn: Then he will turn his attention to the coastlands and will take many of them, but a commander will put an end to his insolence and will turn his insolence back on him.

verses.textZh: 于是他转向自己国中的堡垒，终于绊跌仆倒，不再存在了。
verses.textZhCnvs: 于是他转向自己国中的堡垒，终于绊跌仆倒，不再存在了。
verses.textZhCuv: 他就必转向本地的保障，却要绊跌仆倒，归于无有。
verses.textEnNiv: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own country but will stumble and fall, to be seen no more.
verses.textEnEsv: Then he shall turn his face back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then he shall turn his face toward the fortress of his own land; but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.
verses.textEnNlt: He will take refuge in his own fortresses but will stumble and fall and be seen no more.
verses.textEnNasb: So he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and fall and not be found.
verses.textEn: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own country but will stumble and fall, to be seen no more.

verses.textZh: "那时，必有一个人兴起来代替他；这人要派一个横征暴敛的人，为了王国的荣华，走遍全地；可是不多几日，这人就必被毁灭，不是因为忿怒，也不是因为战争。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时，必有一个人兴起来代替他；这人要派一个横征暴敛的人，为了王国的荣华，走遍全地；可是不多几日，这人就必被毁灭，不是因为忿怒，也不是因为战争。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，必有一人兴起接续他为王，使横征暴敛的人通行国中的荣美地。这王不多日就必灭亡，却不因忿怒，也不因争战。」
verses.textEnNiv: "His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. In a few years, however, he will be destroyed, yet not in anger or in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: "Then shall arise in his place one who shall send an exactor of tribute for the glory of the kingdom. But within a few days he shall be broken, neither in anger nor in battle.
verses.textEnNkjv: "There shall arise in his place one who imposes taxes on the glorious kingdom; but within a few days he shall be destroyed, but not in anger or in battle.
verses.textEnNlt: "His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. But after a very brief reign, he will die, though not from anger or in battle.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then in his place one will arise who will allow an oppressor to pass through the Jewel of his kingdom; yet within a few days he will be broken, though not in anger nor in battle.
verses.textEn: "His successor will send out a tax collector to maintain the royal splendor. In a few years, however, he will be destroyed, yet not in anger or in battle.

verses.textZh: 必另有一个卑鄙的人兴起来代替他；虽然人未曾把王国的尊荣给这人，这人却乘人不备的时候来到，用奉承的话夺得了王国。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必另有一个卑鄙的人兴起来代替他；虽然人未曾把王国的尊荣给这人，这人却乘人不备的时候来到，用奉承的话夺得了王国。
verses.textZhCuv: 「必有一个卑鄙的人兴起接续为王，人未曾将国的尊荣给他，他却趁人坦然无备的时候，用谄媚的话得国。
verses.textEnNiv: "He will be succeeded by a contemptible person who has not been given the honor of royalty. He will invade the kingdom when its people feel secure, and he will seize it through intrigue.
verses.textEnEsv: In his place shall arise a contemptible person to whom royal majesty has not been given. He shall come in without warning and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
verses.textEnNkjv: And in his place shall arise a vile person, to whom they will not give the honor of royalty; but he shall come in peaceably, and seize the kingdom by intrigue.
verses.textEnNlt: "The next to come to power will be a despicable man who is not in line for royal succession. He will slip in when least expected and take over the kingdom by flattery and intrigue.
verses.textEnNasb: And in his place a despicable person will arise, on whom the majesty of kingship has not been conferred; but he will come in a time of tranquility and seize the kingdom by intrigue.
verses.textEn: "He will be succeeded by a contemptible person who has not been given the honor of royalty. He will invade the kingdom when its people feel secure, and he will seize it through intrigue.

verses.textZh: 必有无数的军兵在他面前像洪水冲没，并且溃败；立约的君也必这样。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有无数的军兵在他面前像洪水冲没，并且溃败；立约的君也必这样。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有无数的军兵势如洪水，在他面前冲没败坏；同盟的君也必如此。
verses.textEnNiv: Then an overwhelming army will be swept away before him; both it and a prince of the covenant will be destroyed.
verses.textEnEsv: Armies shall be utterly swept away before him and broken, even the prince of the covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: With the force of a flood they shall be swept away from before him and be broken, and also the prince of the covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: Before him great armies will be swept away, including a covenant prince.
verses.textEnNasb: And the overflowing forces will be flooded away from him and smashed, and also the prince of the covenant.
verses.textEn: Then an overwhelming army will be swept away before him; both it and a prince of the covenant will be destroyed.

verses.textZh: 他结盟以后，就必行诡诈；他虽然只有少数的国民，却渐渐强盛起来。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他结盟以后，就必行诡诈；他虽然只有少数的国民，却渐渐强盛起来。
verses.textZhCuv: 与那君结盟之后，他必行诡诈，因为他必上来以微小的军 成为强盛。
verses.textEnNiv: After coming to an agreement with him, he will act deceitfully, and with only a few people he will rise to power.
verses.textEnEsv: And from the time that an alliance is made with him he shall act deceitfully, and he shall become strong with a small people.
verses.textEnNkjv: And after the league ismade with him he shall act deceitfully, for he shall come up and become strong with a small numberof people.
verses.textEnNlt: With deceitful promises, he will make various alliances. He will become strong despite having only a handful of followers.
verses.textEnNasb: After an alliance is made with him he will practice deception, and he will go up and gain power with a small force of people.
verses.textEn: After coming to an agreement with him, he will act deceitfully, and with only a few people he will rise to power.

verses.textZh: 他必乘人不备的时候，侵入省内最富庶的地区，行他列祖和他列祖的祖先所未曾行过的；他把掳掠之物和财物分给自己的部属；又必设下计谋攻打堡垒，只是这都是暂时的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必乘人不备的时候，侵入省内最富庶的地区，行他列祖和他列祖的祖先所未曾行过的；他把掳掠之物和财物分给自己的部属；又必设下计谋攻打堡垒，只是这都是暂时的。
verses.textZhCuv: 趁人坦然无备的时候，他必来到国中极肥美之地，行他列祖和他列祖之祖所未曾行的，将掳物、掠物，和财宝散给众人，又要设计攻打保障，然而这都是暂时的。
verses.textEnNiv: When the richest provinces feel secure, he will invade them and will achieve what neither his fathers nor his forefathers did. He will distribute plunder, loot and wealth among his followers. He will plot the overthrow of fortresses—but only for a time.
verses.textEnEsv: Without warning he shall come into the richest parts of the province, and he shall do what neither his fathers nor his fathers’ fathers have done, scattering among them plunder, spoil, and goods. He shall devise plans against strongholds, but only for a time.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall enter peaceably, even into the richest places of the province; and he shall do what his fathers have not done, nor his forefathers: he shall disperse among them the plunder, spoil, and riches; and he shall devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.
verses.textEnNlt: Without warning he will enter the richest areas of the land. Then he will distribute among his followers the plunder and wealth of the rich—something his predecessors had never done. He will plot the overthrow of strongholds, but this will last for only a short while.
verses.textEnNasb: In a time of tranquility he will enter the richest parts of the realm, and he will accomplish what his fathers did not, nor his ancestors; he will distribute plunder, spoils, and possessions among them, and he will devise his schemes against strongholds, but only for a time.
verses.textEn: When the richest provinces feel secure, he will invade them and will achieve what neither his fathers nor his forefathers did. He will distribute plunder, loot and wealth among his followers. He will plot the overthrow of fortresses—but only for a time.

verses.textZh: 他必竭尽己力，鼓起勇气，率领大军攻击南方王；南方王也必带领极强大的军队奋起还击，却抵挡不住，因为有人设下计谋陷害南方王。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必竭尽己力，鼓起勇气，率领大军攻击南方王；南方王也必带领极强大的军队奋起还击，却抵挡不住，因为有人设下计谋陷害南方王。
verses.textZhCuv: 「他必奋勇向前，率领大军攻击南方王；南方王也必以极大极强的军兵与他争战，却站立不住，因为有人设计谋害南方王。
verses.textEnNiv: "With a large army he will stir up his strength and courage against the king of the South. The king of the South will wage war with a large and very powerful army, but he will not be able to stand because of the plots devised against him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall stir up his power and his heart against the king of the south with a great army. And the king of the south shall wage war with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he shall not stand, for plots shall be devised against him.
verses.textEnNkjv: "He shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South with a great army. And the king of the South shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand, for they shall devise plans against him.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then he will stir up his courage and raise a great army against the king of the south. The king of the south will go to battle with a mighty army, but to no avail, for there will be plots against him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will stir up his strength and courage against the king of the South with a large army; so the king of the South will mobilize an extremely large and mighty army for war; but he will not stand, because schemes will be devised against him.
verses.textEn: "With a large army he will stir up his strength and courage against the king of the South. The king of the South will wage war with a large and very powerful army, but he will not be able to stand because of the plots devised against him.

verses.textZh: 那些吃王膳的必毁灭他；他的军队必被冲没，受重伤而倒毙的很多。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些吃王膳的必毁灭他；他的军队必被冲没，受重伤而倒毙的很多。
verses.textZhCuv: 吃王膳的，必败坏他；他的军队必被冲没，而且被杀的甚多。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who eat from the king’s provisions will try to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall in battle.
verses.textEnEsv: Even those who eat his food shall break him. His army shall be swept away, and many shall fall down slain.
verses.textEnNkjv: Yes, those who eat of the portion of his delicacies shall destroy him; his army shall be swept away, and many shall fall down slain.
verses.textEnNlt: His own household will cause his downfall. His army will be swept away, and many will be killed.
verses.textEnNasb: Those who eat his choice food will destroy him, and his army will overflow, but many will fall down slain.
verses.textEn: Those who eat from the king’s provisions will try to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall in battle.

verses.textZh: 至于那两个王，他们都存心不良；他们同桌吃饭，也彼此说谎；他们的阴谋却不成功，因为要到了指定的时候，结局才会来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 至于那两个王，他们都存心不良；他们同桌吃饭，也彼此说谎；他们的阴谋却不成功，因为要到了指定的时候，结局才会来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 至于这二王，他们心怀恶计，同席说谎，计谋却不成就；因为到了定期，事就了结。
verses.textEnNiv: The two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will sit at the same table and lie to each other, but to no avail, because an end will still come at the appointed time.
verses.textEnEsv: And as for the two kings, their hearts shall be bent on doing evil. They shall speak lies at the same table, but to no avail, for the end is yet to be at the time appointed.
verses.textEnNkjv: Both these kings’ hearts shallbe bent on evil, and they shall speak lies at the same table; but it shall not prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.
verses.textEnNlt: Seeking nothing but each other’s harm, these kings will plot against each other at the conference table, attempting to deceive each other. But it will make no difference, for the end will come at the appointed time.
verses.textEnNasb: As for both kings, their hearts will be intent on evil, and they will speak lies to each other at the same table; but it will not succeed, because the end is still to come at the appointed time.
verses.textEn: The two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will sit at the same table and lie to each other, but to no avail, because an end will still come at the appointed time.

verses.textZh: "北方王必带着大批财物返回自己的国土去；他的心既然反对圣约，必任意而行，然后返回自己的国土去。
verses.textZhCnvs: "北方王必带着大批财物返回自己的国土去；他的心既然反对圣约，必任意而行，然后返回自己的国土去。
verses.textZhCuv: 北方王 必带许多财宝回往本国，他的心反对圣约，任意而行，回到本地。
verses.textEnNiv: The king of the North will return to his own country with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant. He will take action against it and then return to his own country.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall return to his land with great wealth, but his heart shall be set against the holy covenant. And he shall work his will and return to his own land.
verses.textEnNkjv: While returning to his land with great riches, his heart shall be moved against the holy covenant; so he shall do damage and return to his own land.
verses.textEnNlt: "The king of the north will then return home with great riches. On the way he will set himself against the people of the holy covenant, doing much damage before continuing his journey.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he will return to his land with much plunder; but his heart will be set against the holy covenant, and he will take action and then return to his own land.
verses.textEn: The king of the North will return to his own country with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant. He will take action against it and then return to his own country.

verses.textZh: "到了指定的时候，他必回来，再侵入南方的王国，不过这次的情况却不像前一次。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到了指定的时候，他必回来，再侵入南方的王国，不过这次的情况却不像前一次。
verses.textZhCuv: 「到了定期，他必返回，来到南方。后一次却不如前一次，
verses.textEnNiv: "At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time the outcome will be different from what it was before.
verses.textEnEsv: "At the time appointed he shall return and come into the south, but it shall not be this time as it was before.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At the appointed time he shall return and go toward the south; but it shall not be like the former or the latter.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then at the appointed time he will once again invade the south, but this time the result will be different.
verses.textEnNasb: "At the appointed time he will return and come into the South, but this last time it will not turn out the way it did before.
verses.textEn: "At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time the outcome will be different from what it was before.

verses.textZh: 因为基提的战船必来攻击他，他就丧胆而回；他又恼恨圣约，任意而行；他必回来，听取那些背弃圣约的人的建议。
verses.textZhCnvs: 因为基提的战船必来攻击他，他就丧胆而回；他又恼恨圣约，任意而行；他必回来，听取那些背弃圣约的人的建议。
verses.textZhCuv: 因为基提战船必来攻击他，他就丧胆而回，又要恼恨圣约，任意而行；他必回来联络背弃圣约的人。
verses.textEnNiv: Ships of the western coastlands will oppose him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and vent his fury against the holy covenant. He will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.
verses.textEnEsv: For ships of Kittim shall come against him, and he shall be afraid and withdraw, and shall turn back and be enraged and take action against the holy covenant. He shall turn back and pay attention to those who forsake the holy covenant.
verses.textEnNkjv: For ships from Cyprus shall come against him; therefore he shall be grieved, and return in rage against the holy covenant, and do damage. "So he shall return and show regard for those who forsake the holy covenant.
verses.textEnNlt: For warships from western coastlands will scare him off, and he will withdraw and return home. But he will vent his anger against the people of the holy covenant and reward those who forsake the covenant.
verses.textEnNasb: For ships of Kittim will come against him; therefore he will withdraw in fear and will return and curse the holy covenant and take action; so he will come back and pay attention to those who abandon the holy covenant.
verses.textEn: Ships of the western coastlands will oppose him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and vent his fury against the holy covenant. He will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.

verses.textZh: 他的军队必起来，亵渎圣殿，就是那堡垒，废除常献祭，又在殿里设立了那使地荒凉的可憎的像。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他的军队必起来，亵渎圣殿，就是那堡垒，废除常献祭，又在殿里设立了那使地荒凉的可憎的像。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必兴兵，这兵必亵渎圣地，就是保障，除掉常献的燔祭，设立那行毁坏可憎的。
verses.textEnNiv: "His armed forces will rise up to desecrate the temple fortress and will abolish the daily sacrifice. Then they will set up the abomination that causes desolation.
verses.textEnEsv: Forces from him shall appear and profane the temple and fortress, and shall take away the regular burnt offering. And they shall set up the abomination that makes desolate.
verses.textEnNkjv: And forces shall be mustered by him, and they shall defile the sanctuary fortress; then they shall take away the daily sacrifices, and place there the abomination of desolation.
verses.textEnNlt: "His army will take over the Temple fortress, pollute the sanctuary, put a stop to the daily sacrifices, and set up the sacrilegious object that causes desecration.
verses.textEnNasb: Forces from him will arise, desecrate the sanctuary fortress, and do away with the regular sacrifice. And they will set up the abomination of desolation.
verses.textEn: "His armed forces will rise up to desecrate the temple fortress and will abolish the daily sacrifice. Then they will set up the abomination that causes desolation.

verses.textZh: 那些作恶违背圣约的人，他必用奉承的话败坏他们；但认识神的人民，必刚强行事。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些作恶违背圣约的人，他必用奉承的话败坏他们；但认识神的人民，必刚强行事。
verses.textZhCuv: 作恶违背圣约的人，他必用巧言勾引；惟独认识神的子民必刚强行事。
verses.textEnNiv: With flattery he will corrupt those who have violated the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall seduce with flattery those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God shall stand firm and take action.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who do wickedly against the covenant he shall corrupt with flattery; but the people who know their God shall be strong, and carry out greatexploits.
verses.textEnNlt: He will flatter and win over those who have violated the covenant. But the people who know their God will be strong and will resist him.
verses.textEnNasb: And by smooth words he will turn to godlessness those who act wickedly toward the covenant, but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.
verses.textEn: With flattery he will corrupt those who have violated the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.

verses.textZh: 民中的智慧人必使许多人明白是非；但他们必有很多日子倒在刀剑之下，或被火烧，或被掳去，或被抢掠。
verses.textZhCnvs: 民中的智慧人必使许多人明白是非；但他们必有很多日子倒在刀剑之下，或被火烧，或被掳去，或被抢掠。
verses.textZhCuv: 民间的智慧人必训诲多人；然而他们多日必倒在刀下，或被火烧，或被掳掠抢夺。
verses.textEnNiv: "Those who are wise will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by the sword or be burned or captured or plundered.
verses.textEnEsv: And the wise among the people shall make many understand, though for some days they shall stumble by sword and flame, by captivity and plunder.
verses.textEnNkjv: And those of the people who understand shall instruct many; yet formany days they shall fall by sword and flame, by captivity and plundering.
verses.textEnNlt: "Wise leaders will give instruction to many, but these teachers will die by fire and sword, or they will be jailed and robbed.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who have insight among the people will give understanding to the many; yet they will fall by sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder for many days.
verses.textEn: "Those who are wise will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by the sword or be burned or captured or plundered.

verses.textZh: 他们仆倒的时候，必得到一些援助，必有许多人用奉承的话要和他们联盟。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他们仆倒的时候，必得到一些援助，必有许多人用奉承的话要和他们联盟。
verses.textZhCuv: 他们仆倒的时候，稍得扶助，却有许多人用谄媚的话亲近他们。
verses.textEnNiv: When they fall, they will receive a little help, and many who are not sincere will join them.
verses.textEnEsv: When they stumble, they shall receive a little help. And many shall join themselves to them with flattery,
verses.textEnNkjv: Now when they fall, they shall be aided with a little help; but many shall join with them by intrigue.
verses.textEnNlt: During these persecutions, little help will arrive, and many who join them will not be sincere.
verses.textEnNasb: Now when they fall they will be granted a little help, and many will join with them in hypocrisy.
verses.textEn: When they fall, they will receive a little help, and many who are not sincere will join them.

verses.textZh: 智慧人中有些仆倒的，为要锻炼他们，洁净他们，使他们成为雪白，直到末了，因为要到了指定的时候，结局才会来到。
verses.textZhCnvs: 智慧人中有些仆倒的，为要锻炼他们，洁净他们，使他们成为雪白，直到末了，因为要到了指定的时候，结局才会来到。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人中有些仆倒的，为要熬炼其余的人，使他们清净洁白，直到末了；因为到了定期，事就了结。
verses.textEnNiv: Some of the wise will stumble, so that they may be refined, purified and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
verses.textEnEsv: and some of the wise shall stumble, so that they may be refined, purified, and made white, until the time of the end, for it still awaits the appointed time.
verses.textEnNkjv: And some of those of understanding shall fall, to refine them, purify them, and make them white, until the time of the end; because itis still for the appointed time.
verses.textEnNlt: And some of the wise will fall victim to persecution. In this way, they will be refined and cleansed and made pure until the time of the end, for the appointed time is still to come.
verses.textEnNasb: And some of those who have insight will fall, to refine, purge, and cleanse them until the end time; because it is still to come at the appointed time.
verses.textEn: Some of the wise will stumble, so that they may be refined, purified and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.

verses.textZh: "那王必任意而行，自高自大，超过所有的神，又说一些怪诞的话攻击万神之神。他必行事顺利，直到神的忿怒完毕；因为所定的事必会实现。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那王必任意而行，自高自大，超过所有的神，又说一些怪诞的话攻击万神之神。他必行事顺利，直到神的忿怒完毕；因为所定的事必会实现。
verses.textZhCuv: 「王必任意而行，自高自大，超过所有的神，又用奇异的话攻击万神之神。他必行事亨通，直到主的忿怒完毕，因为所定的事必然成就。
verses.textEnNiv: "The king will do as he pleases. He will exalt and magnify himself above every god and will say unheard-of things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been determined must take place.
verses.textEnEsv: "And the king shall do as he wills. He shall exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak astonishing things against the God of gods. He shall prosper till the indignation is accomplished; for what is decreed shall be done.
verses.textEnNkjv: "Then the king shall do according to his own will: he shall exalt and magnify himself above every god, shall speak blasphemies against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the wrath has been accomplished; for what has been determined shall be done.
verses.textEnNlt: "The king will do as he pleases, exalting himself and claiming to be greater than every god, even blaspheming the God of gods. He will succeed, but only until the time of wrath is completed. For what has been determined will surely take place.
verses.textEnNasb: "Then the king will do as he pleases, and he will exalt himself and boast against every god and will speak dreadful things against the God of gods; and he will be successful until the indignation is finished, because that which is determined will be done.
verses.textEn: "The king will do as he pleases. He will exalt and magnify himself above every god and will say unheard-of things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been determined must take place.

verses.textZh: 他必不尊重他列祖所拜的神，也不尊重妇女所爱慕的神，无论甚么神他都不尊重，因为他必自大，高过一切。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必不尊重他列祖所拜的神，也不尊重妇女所爱慕的神，无论甚么神他都不尊重，因为他必自大，高过一切。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必不顾他列祖的神，也不顾妇女所羡慕的神，无论何神他都不顾；因为他必自大，高过一切。
verses.textEnNiv: He will show no regard for the gods of his ancestors or for the one desired by women, nor will he regard any god, but will exalt himself above them all.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall pay no attention to the gods of his fathers, or to the one beloved by women. He shall not pay attention to any other god, for he shall magnify himself above all.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall regard neither the God of his fathers nor the desire of women, nor regard any god; for he shall exalt himself above them all.
verses.textEnNlt: He will have no respect for the gods of his ancestors, or for the god loved by women, or for any other god, for he will boast that he is greater than them all.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will show no regard for the gods of his fathers or for the desire of women, nor will he show regard for any other god; for he will boast against them all.
verses.textEn: He will show no regard for the gods of his ancestors or for the one desired by women, nor will he regard any god, but will exalt himself above them all.

verses.textZh: 他倒要敬拜堡垒的神，用金银宝石和各样珍宝去敬拜他列祖所不认识的神。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他倒要敬拜堡垒的神，用金银宝石和各样珍宝去敬拜他列祖所不认识的神。
verses.textZhCuv: 他倒要敬拜保障的神，用金、银、宝石和可爱之物敬奉他列祖所不认识的神。
verses.textEnNiv: Instead of them, he will honor a god of fortresses; a god unknown to his ancestors he will honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and costly gifts.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall honor the god of fortresses instead of these. A god whom his fathers did not know he shall honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and costly gifts.
verses.textEnNkjv: But in their place he shall honor a god of fortresses; and a god which his fathers did not know he shall honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and pleasant things.
verses.textEnNlt: Instead of these, he will worship the god of fortresses—a god his ancestors never knew—and lavish on him gold, silver, precious stones, and expensive gifts.
verses.textEnNasb: But instead he will honor a god of fortresses, a god whom his fathers did not know; he will honor him with gold, silver, precious stones, and treasures.
verses.textEn: Instead of them, he will honor a god of fortresses; a god unknown to his ancestors he will honor with gold and silver, with precious stones and costly gifts.

verses.textZh: 他必得着外族神的帮助，攻破坚固的堡垒；凡承认他的，他必使他们大得尊荣，又使他们管辖许多人，并且把土地分给他们作赏赐。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必得着外族神的帮助，攻破坚固的堡垒；凡承认他的，他必使他们大得尊荣，又使他们管辖许多人，并且把土地分给他们作赏赐。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必靠外邦神的帮助，攻破最坚固的保障。凡承认他的，他必将荣耀加给他们，使他们管辖许多人，又为贿赂分地与他们。
verses.textEnNiv: He will attack the mightiest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him. He will make them rulers over many people and will distribute the land at a price.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall deal with the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god. Those who acknowledge him he shall load with honor. He shall make them rulers over many and shall divide the land for a price.
verses.textEnNkjv: Thus he shall act against the strongest fortresses with a foreign god, which he shall acknowledge, and advance its glory; and he shall cause them to rule over many, and divide the land for gain.
verses.textEnNlt: Claiming this foreign god’s help, he will attack the strongest fortresses. He will honor those who submit to him, appointing them to positions of authority and dividing the land among them as their reward.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will take action against the strongest of fortresses with the help of a foreign god; he will give great honor to those who acknowledge him and will make them rulers over the many, and will parcel out land for a price.
verses.textEn: He will attack the mightiest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him. He will make them rulers over many people and will distribute the land at a price.

verses.textZh: "到了末期，南方王要和他交战；北方王必带着战车、骑兵和大批战船，像暴风一般来到他那里；他必侵入列国，如洪水泛滥，横扫而过。
verses.textZhCnvs: "到了末期，南方王要和他交战；北方王必带着战车、骑兵和大批战船，像暴风一般来到他那里；他必侵入列国，如洪水泛滥，横扫而过。
verses.textZhCuv: 「到末了，南方王要与他交战。北方王必用战车、马兵，和许多战船，势如暴风来攻击他，也必进入列国，如洪水氾滥。
verses.textEnNiv: "At the time of the end the king of the South will engage him in battle, and the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots and cavalry and a great fleet of ships. He will invade many countries and sweep through them like a flood.
verses.textEnEsv: "At the time of the end, the king of the south shall attack him, but the king of the north shall rush upon him like a whirlwind, with chariots and horsemen, and with many ships. And he shall come into countries and shall overflow and pass through.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At the time of the end the king of the South shall attack him; and the king of the North shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter the countries, overwhelm them, and pass through.
verses.textEnNlt: "Then at the time of the end, the king of the south will attack the king of the north. The king of the north will storm out with chariots, charioteers, and a vast navy. He will invade various lands and sweep through them like a flood.
verses.textEnNasb: "And at the end time the king of the South will wage war with him, and the king of the North will storm against him with chariots, horsemen, and with many ships; and he will enter countries, overflow them, and pass through.
verses.textEn: "At the time of the end the king of the South will engage him in battle, and the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots and cavalry and a great fleet of ships. He will invade many countries and sweep through them like a flood.

verses.textZh: 他也必侵入那荣美之地；必有许多国倾覆；但那些以东人、摩押人和亚扪人的首领，必被拯救脱离他的手。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他也必侵入那荣美之地；必有许多国倾覆；但那些以东人、摩押人和亚扪人的首领，必被拯救脱离他的手。
verses.textZhCuv: 又必进入那荣美之地，有许多国就被倾覆，但以东人、摩押人，和一大半亚扪人必脱离他的手。
verses.textEnNiv: He will also invade the Beautiful Land. Many countries will fall, but Edom, Moab and the leaders of Ammon will be delivered from his hand.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall come into the glorious land. And tens of thousands shall fall, but these shall be delivered out of his hand: Edom and Moab and the main part of the Ammonites.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall also enter the Glorious Land, and many countries shall be overthrown; but these shall escape from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the prominent people of Ammon.
verses.textEnNlt: He will enter the glorious land of Israel, and many nations will fall, but Moab, Edom, and the best part of Ammon will escape.
verses.textEnNasb: He will also enter the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall; but these will be rescued out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the foremost of the sons of Ammon.
verses.textEn: He will also invade the Beautiful Land. Many countries will fall, but Edom, Moab and the leaders of Ammon will be delivered from his hand.

verses.textZh: 他必伸手攻击列国，埃及地也不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必伸手攻击列国，埃及地也不能逃脱。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必伸手攻击列国；埃及地也不得脱离。
verses.textEnNiv: He will extend his power over many countries; Egypt will not escape.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall stretch out his hand against the countries, and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall stretch out his hand against the countries, and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
verses.textEnNlt: He will conquer many countries, and even Egypt will not escape.
verses.textEnNasb: Then he will reach out with his hand against other countries, and the land of Egypt will not escape.
verses.textEn: He will extend his power over many countries; Egypt will not escape.

verses.textZh: 他必掌管埃及的金银宝藏和一切珍宝；吕彼亚人和古实人都必追随他。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必掌管埃及的金银宝藏和一切珍宝；吕彼亚人和古实人都必追随他。
verses.textZhCuv: 他必把持埃及的金银财宝和各样的宝物。利比亚人和古实人都必跟从他。
verses.textEnNiv: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and all the riches of Egypt, with the Libyans and Cushites in submission.
verses.textEnEsv: He shall become ruler of the treasures of gold and of silver, and all the precious things of Egypt, and the Libyans and the Cushites shall follow in his train.
verses.textEnNkjv: He shall have power over the treasures of gold and silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; also the Libyans and Ethiopians shallfollow at his heels.
verses.textEnNlt: He will gain control over the gold, silver, and treasures of Egypt, and the Libyans and Ethiopians will be his servants.
verses.textEnNasb: But he will gain control over the hidden treasures of gold and silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and Libyans and Ethiopians will follow at his heels.
verses.textEn: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and all the riches of Egypt, with the Libyans and Cushites in submission.

verses.textZh: 但从东方和北方必有消息传来，使他惊惶，他就在烈怒之下出兵，要把许多人杀尽灭绝。
verses.textZhCnvs: 但从东方和北方必有消息传来，使他惊惶，他就在烈怒之下出兵，要把许多人杀尽灭绝。
verses.textZhCuv: 但从东方和北方必有消息扰乱他，他就大发烈怒出去，要将多人杀灭净尽。
verses.textEnNiv: But reports from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will set out in a great rage to destroy and annihilate many.
verses.textEnEsv: But news from the east and the north shall alarm him, and he shall go out with great fury to destroy and devote many to destruction.
verses.textEnNkjv: But news from the east and the north shall trouble him; therefore he shall go out with great fury to destroy and annihilate many.
verses.textEnNlt: "But then news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will set out in great anger to destroy and obliterate many.
verses.textEnNasb: But rumors from the East and from the North will terrify him, and he will go out with great wrath to eliminate and annihilate many.
verses.textEn: But reports from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will set out in a great rage to destroy and annihilate many.

verses.textZh: 他必在海和荣美的圣山之间支搭如宫殿一般的帐幕；然而他们的结局来到，必没有人能帮助他。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 他必在海和荣美的圣山之间支搭如宫殿一般的帐幕；然而他们的结局来到，必没有人能帮助他。"
verses.textZhCuv: 他必在海和荣美的圣山中间设立他如宫殿的帐幕；然而到了他的结局，必无人能帮助他。」
verses.textEnNiv: He will pitch his royal tents between the seas at the beautiful holy mountain. Yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
verses.textEnEsv: And he shall pitch his palatial tents between the sea and the glorious holy mountain. Yet he shall come to his end, with none to help him.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he shall plant the tents of his palace between the seas and the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and no one will help him.
verses.textEnNlt: He will stop between the glorious holy mountain and the sea and will pitch his royal tents. But while he is there, his time will suddenly run out, and no one will help him.
verses.textEnNasb: And he will pitch the tents of his royal pavilion between the seas and the beautiful Holy Mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
verses.textEn: He will pitch his royal tents between the seas at the beautiful holy mountain. Yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.

verses.textZh: "那时保护你同胞的伟大护卫天使米迦勒必站起来；并且必有患难的时期，是立国以来直到那时未曾有过的。那时你的同胞中名字记录在册上的，都必得拯救。
verses.textZhCnvs: "那时保护你同胞的伟大护卫天使米迦勒必站起来；并且必有患难的时期，是立国以来直到那时未曾有过的。那时你的同胞中名字记录在册上的，都必得拯救。
verses.textZhCuv: 「那时，保佑你本国之民的天使长 米迦勒必站起来，并且有大艰难，从有国以来直到此时，没有这样的。你本国的民中，凡名录在册上的，必得拯救。
verses.textEnNiv: "At that time Michael, the great prince who protects your people, will arise. There will be a time of distress such as has not happened from the beginning of nations until then. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.
verses.textEnEsv: "At that time shall arise Michael, the great prince who has charge of your people. And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never has been since there was a nation till that time. But at that time your people shall be delivered, everyone whose name shall be found written in the book.
verses.textEnNkjv: "At that time Michael shall stand up, The great prince who stands watch over the sons of your people; And there shall be a time of trouble, Such as never was since there was a nation, Even to that time. And at that time your people shall be delivered, Every one who is found written in the book.
verses.textEnNlt: "At that time Michael, the archangel who stands guard over your nation, will arise. Then there will be a time of anguish greater than any since nations first came into existence. But at that time every one of your people whose name is written in the book will be rescued.
verses.textEnNasb: "Now at that time Michael, the great prince who stands guard over the sons of your people, will arise. And there will be a time of distress such as never occurred since there was a nation until that time; and at that time your people, everyone who is found written in the book, will be rescued.
verses.textEn: "At that time Michael, the great prince who protects your people, will arise. There will be a time of distress such as has not happened from the beginning of nations until then. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.

verses.textZh: 必有许多睡在尘土中的人醒过来，有的要得永生，有的要受羞辱，永远被憎恶。
verses.textZhCnvs: 必有许多睡在尘土中的人醒过来，有的要得永生，有的要受羞辱，永远被憎恶。
verses.textZhCuv: 睡在尘埃中的，必有多人复醒。其中有得永生的，有受羞辱永远被憎恶的。
verses.textEnNiv: Multitudes who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake: some to everlasting life, others to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.textEnEsv: And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.textEnNkjv: And many of those who sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, Some to everlasting life, Some to shame and everlasting contempt.
verses.textEnNlt: Many of those whose bodies lie dead and buried will rise up, some to everlasting life and some to shame and everlasting disgrace.
verses.textEnNasb: And many of those who sleep in the dust of the ground will awake, these to everlasting life, but the others to disgrace and everlasting contempt.
verses.textEn: Multitudes who sleep in the dust of the earth will awake: some to everlasting life, others to shame and everlasting contempt.

verses.textZh: 那些有智慧的必发光，好象穹苍的光体；那些使许多人归义的必发光，如同星星，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCnvs: 那些有智慧的必发光，好象穹苍的光体；那些使许多人归义的必发光，如同星星，直到永永远远。
verses.textZhCuv: 智慧人必发光如同天上的光；那使多人归义的，必发光如星，直到永永远远。
verses.textEnNiv: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars for ever and ever.
verses.textEnEsv: And those who are wise shall shine like the brightness of the sky above; and those who turn many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
verses.textEnNkjv: Those who are wise shall shine Like the brightness of the firmament, And those who turn many to righteousness Like the stars forever and ever.
verses.textEnNlt: Those who are wise will shine as bright as the sky, and those who lead many to righteousness will shine like the stars forever.
verses.textEnNasb: And those who have insight will shine like the glow of the expanse of heaven, and those who lead the many to righteousness, like the stars forever and ever.
verses.textEn: Those who are wise will shine like the brightness of the heavens, and those who lead many to righteousness, like the stars for ever and ever.

verses.textZh: 但以理啊！你要隐藏这些话，把这书密封，直到末期，必有许多人来往奔跑，知识增多。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 但以理啊！你要隐藏这些话，把这书密封，直到末期，必有许多人来往奔跑，知识增多。"
verses.textZhCuv: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑 ，知识就必增长。」
verses.textEnNiv: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge."
verses.textEnEsv: But you, Daniel, shut up the words and seal the book, until the time of the end. Many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you, Daniel, shut up the words, and seal the book until the time of the end; many shall run to and fro, and knowledge shall increase."
verses.textEnNlt: But you, Daniel, keep this prophecy a secret; seal up the book until the time of the end, when many will rush here and there, and knowledge will increase."
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, Daniel, keep these words secret and seal up the book until the end of time; many will roam about, and knowledge will increase."
verses.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge."

verses.textZh: 我但以理观看，看见另有两个天使，一个站在河岸的这边，一个站在河岸的那边。
verses.textZhCnvs: 我但以理观看，看见另有两个天使，一个站在河岸的这边，一个站在河岸的那边。
verses.textZhCuv: 我－但以理观看，见另有两个人站立：一个在河这边，一个在河那边。
verses.textEnNiv: Then I, Daniel, looked, and there before me stood two others, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.
verses.textEnEsv: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on this bank of the stream and one on that bank of the stream.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I, Daniel, looked; and there stood two others, one on this riverbank and the other on that riverbank.
verses.textEnNlt: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing on opposite banks of the river.
verses.textEnNasb: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others were standing, one on this bank of the stream and the other on that bank of the stream.
verses.textEn: Then I, Daniel, looked, and there before me stood two others, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.

verses.textZh: 有一个问那身穿细麻衣、站在河水以上的人，说："这些奇异的事的结局几时才到呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 有一个问那身穿细麻衣、站在河水以上的人，说："这些奇异的事的结局几时才到呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 有一个问那站在河水以上、穿细麻衣的说：「这奇异的事到几时才应验呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: One of them said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, "How long will it be before these astonishing things are fulfilled?"
verses.textEnEsv: And someone said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the stream, "How long shall it be till the end of these wonders?"
verses.textEnNkjv: And one said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, "How long shall the fulfillment of these wonders be?"
verses.textEnNlt: One of them asked the man dressed in linen, who was now standing above the river, "How long will it be until these shocking events are over?"
verses.textEnNasb: And someone said to the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the stream, "How long will it be until the end of these wonders?"
verses.textEn: One of them said to the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, "How long will it be before these astonishing things are fulfilled?"

verses.textZh: 我听见那身穿细麻衣、站在河水以上的人，向天举起左右手，指着活到永远的主起誓，说："要经过一载、二载、半载 ；在他们完全粉碎圣民的势力的时候，这一切事就都要完成。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见那身穿细麻衣、站在河水以上的人，向天举起左右手，指着活到永远的主起誓，说："要经过一载、二载、半载 ；在他们完全粉碎圣民的势力的时候，这一切事就都要完成。"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见那站在河水以上、穿细麻衣的，向天举起左右手，指着活到永远的主起誓说：「要到一载、二载、半载，打破圣民权力的时候，这一切事就都应验了。」
verses.textEnNiv: The man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, lifted his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by him who lives forever, saying, "It will be for a time, times and half a time. When the power of the holy people has been finally broken, all these things will be completed."
verses.textEnEsv: And I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the stream; he raised his right hand and his left hand toward heaven and swore by him who lives forever that it would be for a time, times, and half a time, and that when the shattering of the power of the holy people comes to an end all these things would be finished.
verses.textEnNkjv: Then I heard the man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, when he held up his right hand and his left hand to heaven, and swore by Him who lives forever, that itshallbe for a time, times, and half atime; and when the power of the holy people has been completely shattered, all these things shall be finished.
verses.textEnNlt: The man dressed in linen, who was standing above the river, raised both his hands toward heaven and took a solemn oath by the One who lives forever, saying, "It will go on for a time, times, and half a time. When the shattering of the holy people has finally come to an end, all these things will have happened."
verses.textEnNasb: And I heard the man dressed in linen, who was above the waters of the stream, as he raised his right hand and his left toward heaven, and swore by Him who lives forever that it would be for a time, times, and half a time; and as soon as they finish smashing the power of the holy people, all these events will be completed.
verses.textEn: The man clothed in linen, who was above the waters of the river, lifted his right hand and his left hand toward heaven, and I heard him swear by him who lives forever, saying, "It will be for a time, times and half a time. When the power of the holy people has been finally broken, all these things will be completed."

verses.textZh: 我听见，却不明白，我就问："我主啊，这些事的结局是怎样呢？"
verses.textZhCnvs: 我听见，却不明白，我就问："我主啊，这些事的结局是怎样呢？"
verses.textZhCuv: 我听见这话，却不明白，就说：「我主啊，这些事的结局是怎样呢？」
verses.textEnNiv: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, "My lord, what will the outcome of all this be?"
verses.textEnEsv: I heard, but I did not understand. Then I said, "O my lord, what shall be the outcome of these things?"
verses.textEnNkjv: Although I heard, I did not understand. Then I said, "My lord, what shallbe the end of these things?"
verses.textEnNlt: I heard what he said, but I did not understand what he meant. So I asked, "How will all this finally end, my lord?"
verses.textEnNasb: But as for me, I heard but did not understand; so I said, "My lord, what will be the outcome of these events?"
verses.textEn: I heard, but I did not understand. So I asked, "My lord, what will the outcome of all this be?"

verses.textZh: 他回答："但以理啊！你只管去吧，因为这些话已经隐藏密封，直到末期。
verses.textZhCnvs: 他回答："但以理啊！你只管去吧，因为这些话已经隐藏密封，直到末期。
verses.textZhCuv: 他说：「但以理啊，你只管去；因为这话已经隐藏封闭，直到末时。
verses.textEnNiv: He replied, "Go your way, Daniel, because the words are rolled up and sealed until the time of the end.
verses.textEnEsv: He said, "Go your way, Daniel, for the words are shut up and sealed until the time of the end.
verses.textEnNkjv: And he said, "Go yourway, Daniel, for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.
verses.textEnNlt: But he said, "Go now, Daniel, for what I have said is kept secret and sealed until the time of the end.
verses.textEnNasb: And he said, "Go your way, Daniel, for these words will be kept secret and sealed up until the end time.
verses.textEn: He replied, "Go your way, Daniel, because the words are rolled up and sealed until the time of the end.

verses.textZh: 许多人必洁净自己，使自己洁白，并且被熬炼。可是恶人仍然作恶。所有恶人都不明白，只有那些使人有智慧的才能明白。
verses.textZhCnvs: 许多人必洁净自己，使自己洁白，并且被熬炼。可是恶人仍然作恶。所有恶人都不明白，只有那些使人有智慧的才能明白。
verses.textZhCuv: 必有许多人使自己清净洁白，且被熬炼；但恶人仍必行恶，一切恶人都不明白，惟独智慧人能明白。
verses.textEnNiv: Many will be purified, made spotless and refined, but the wicked will continue to be wicked. None of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.
verses.textEnEsv: Many shall purify themselves and make themselves white and be refined, but the wicked shall act wickedly. And none of the wicked shall understand, but those who are wise shall understand.
verses.textEnNkjv: Many shall be purified, made white, and refined, but the wicked shall do wickedly; and none of the wicked shall understand, but the wise shall understand.
verses.textEnNlt: Many will be purified, cleansed, and refined by these trials. But the wicked will continue in their wickedness, and none of them will understand. Only those who are wise will know what it means.
verses.textEnNasb: Many will be purged, cleansed, and refined, but the wicked will act wickedly; and none of the wicked will understand, but those who have insight will understand.
verses.textEn: Many will be purified, made spotless and refined, but the wicked will continue to be wicked. None of the wicked will understand, but those who are wise will understand.

verses.textZh: 从废除常献祭，并设立那使地荒凉的可憎的像的时候起，必有一千二百九十天。
verses.textZhCnvs: 从废除常献祭，并设立那使地荒凉的可憎的像的时候起，必有一千二百九十天。
verses.textZhCuv: 从除掉常献的燔祭，并设立那行毁坏可憎之物的时候，必有一千二百九十日。
verses.textEnNiv: "From the time that the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination that causes desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.
verses.textEnEsv: And from the time that the regular burnt offering is taken away and the abomination that makes desolate is set up, there shall be 1,290 days.
verses.textEnNkjv: "And from the time that the daily sacrifice is taken away, and the abomination of desolation is set up, thereshallbe one thousand two hundred and ninety days.
verses.textEnNlt: "From the time the daily sacrifice is stopped and the sacrilegious object that causes desecration is set up to be worshiped, there will be 1,290 days.
verses.textEnNasb: And from the time that the regular sacrifice is abolished and the abomination of desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.
verses.textEn: "From the time that the daily sacrifice is abolished and the abomination that causes desolation is set up, there will be 1,290 days.

verses.textZh: 等候到一千三百三十五日的，那人是有福的。
verses.textZhCnvs: 等候到一千三百三十五日的，那人是有福的。
verses.textZhCuv: 等到一千三百三十五日的，那人便为有福。
verses.textEnNiv: Blessed is the one who waits for and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.
verses.textEnEsv: Blessed is he who waits and arrives at the 1,335 days.
verses.textEnNkjv: Blessed is he who waits, and comes to the one thousand three hundred and thirty-five days.
verses.textEnNlt: And blessed are those who wait and remain until the end of the 1,335 days!
verses.textEnNasb: Blessed is the one who is patient and attains to the 1,335 days!
verses.textEn: Blessed is the one who waits for and reaches the end of the 1,335 days.

verses.textZh: 你应去等待结局！你必安歇；到了末日，你必起来，承受你的分。"
verses.textZhCnvs: 你应去等待结局！你必安歇；到了末日，你必起来，承受你的分。"
verses.textZhCuv: 「你且去等候结局，因为你必安歇。到了末期，你必起来，享受你的福分。」
verses.textEnNiv: "As for you, go your way till the end. You will rest, and then at the end of the days you will rise to receive your allotted inheritance."
verses.textEnEsv: But go your way till the end. And you shall rest and shall stand in your allotted place at the end of the days."
verses.textEnNkjv: "But you, go yourway till the end; for you shall rest, and will arise to your inheritance at the end of the days."
verses.textEnNlt: "As for you, go your way until the end. You will rest, and then at the end of the days, you will rise again to receive the inheritance set aside for you."
verses.textEnNasb: But as for you, go your way to the end; then you will rest and rise for your allotted portion at the end of the age."
verses.textEn: "As for you, go your way till the end. You will rest, and then at the end of the days you will rise to receive your allotted inheritance."
